AD1-001.question: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when this card digivolves into a card with [Garurumon] in its name?
What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
AD1-001.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

AD1-002.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [End of Attack] [On Deletion] effect without trashing a card from my hand?
Does a digivolution requirement that digivolves from a Tamer mean that the Tamer that will become a digivolution card is treated as a Digimon when it digivolves?
AD1-002.answer:
No, it digivolves from the Tamer as-is. It isn't treated as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.
In addition, this digivolution requirement can be used to digivolve a Tamer even if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates.

AD1-002.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
AD1-002.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

AD1-002.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
AD1-002.answer:
This card has <Rush>, so it can attack.
Unless the other cards have an effect that allows them to attack the turn they were played, they can't attack.

AD1-002.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
AD1-002.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

AD1-002.question: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?

AD1-003.question: This card, [Takato Matsuki], and [Guilmon] are in [Gallantmon]'s digivolution cards. When that Digimon would leave the battle area other than by my effects, can I activate this card's inherited effect and play just 1 [Takato Matsuki] or 1 [Guilmon] from this card's digivolution cards?
AD1-003.answer:
No, you can't.
You must play 1 [Takato Matsuki] and 1 [Guilmon] whenever possible.

AD1-003.question: Only this card and [Takato Matsuki] are in [Gallantmon]'s digivolution cards. When that Digimon would leave the battle area other than by my effects, can I activate this card's inherited effect and play just [Takato Matsuki] from this card's digivolution cards?

AD1-004.question: When a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards but without [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name attacks, does this card’s inherited effect activate?
AD1-004.answer:
Yes. You must activate this card’s inherited effect and use up its [Once Per Turn], even if the attacking Digimon doesn't have [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name.
However, if the attacking Digimon doesn't have [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name, you can't reference DP or delete a Digimon.

AD1-006.question: Does the Digimon card played by this card's [All Turns] effect have to be a [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait card?
AD1-006.answer: Yes. Only a [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait card can be played.

AD1-006.question: I activated this card's [All Turns] effect, placed cards from this card's digivolution cards under a Tamer, then attempted to play 1 card. If I then choose the cards placed under the Tamer for a DigiXros on the card to be played, can I choose the cards placed under the Tamer by this effect?
When I activate this card's [All Turns] effect and would play cards from its digivolution cards, if I would choose this card for a DigiXros on those cards, can I choose this card in the battle area?
I have a Tamer. Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect and play 1 card without placing any cards from this card's digivolution cards under the Tamer?
AD1-006.answer:
No, you can't.
If you activate this card's [All Turns] effect, you must place at least 1 card from digivolution cards under a Tamer when possible and play 1 card.
However, if there is only 1 digivolution card, you can first place that card under a Tamer, then no card will be played.

AD1-006.question: I have no Tamers. Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect and play 1 card from this card's digivolution cards?

AD1-007.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
AD1-007.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

AD1-007.question: Can I place just 1 card with [Gammamon] in its text in digivolution cards for the conditions of this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
AD1-007.answer:
No, you can't.
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.
The conditions for this [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect require you to place the specified number of cards in digivolution cards.

AD1-008.question: Can I activate BT12-089 [Takato Matsuki]'s [Main] effect and digivolve a [Hero] trait Guilmon into this card for a digivolution cost of 3?
AD1-008.answer:
Yes, it can digivolve for a digivolution cost of 3.
If you reference this card's 3rd digivolution requirement to digivolve, ignoring level, the digivolution cost will be 3.

AD1-008.question: What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
AD1-008.answer:
This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects.
For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

AD1-008.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
AD1-008.answer:
Yes, it can be chosen.
For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

AD1-008.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
AD1-008.answer:
Yes, it can.
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect.
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

AD1-008.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
AD1-008.answer: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

AD1-008.question: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
AD1-008.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

AD1-008.question: A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
AD1-008.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

AD1-009.question: When exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw when a digivolution would occur by this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?
AD1-009.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when a card is placed on top of the Digimon to digivolve.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

AD1-017.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation.
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation.
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

AD1-017.question: If this card is checked from a security stack, does its [Security] effect activate, then does it battle with the attacking Digimon?

AD1-021.question: This card has [Agumon] in its name, but is it also treated as a Digimon card or a Digimon?
AD1-021.answer:
No, it isn't.
It will only be treated as a Digimon if an effect treats it as a Digimon.

AD1-021.question: What does an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect do, exactly?
AD1-021.answer:
It causes that card to also be treated as a Digimon with X000 DP.
For example, if a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon, it can attack like a standard Digimon, and it will gain inherited effects from cards stacked under it.
However, even if a Tamer is played and then treated as a Digimon in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn.

AD1-021.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, is it no longer considered a Tamer?
AD1-021.answer: No, it is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer.

AD1-021.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect and it activates an effect, is it treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect?
AD1-021.answer:
Yes, it's treated as an effect of both.
Because the card is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the activated effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect.

AD1-021.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
AD1-021.answer: Yes, it's deleted upon the rule check timing.

AD1-021.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?
AD1-021.answer:
If an effect has triggered and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the play cost, level, and DP are overwritten by the newer effect.
However, if an effect has already activated and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the already activated effect will be overwritten.
Any other effects such as <Rush> that are later gained will be added.

AD1-021.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
AD1-021.answer:
Yes, you can.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

AD1-021.question: If an opponent's card has "isn't affected by Digimon effects" and it's chosen for an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" Tamer effect that treats it as a Digimon, will the chosen opponent Digimon be affected by effects?
AD1-021.answer:
No, it won't be affected by effects.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore the chosen opponent Digimon won't be affected by effects.

AD1-021.question: I have this card and 1 [Marcus Damon] in the battle area. I place BT21-044 [RizeGreymon] in the battle area by playing or digivolving, and the memory moved to 1 or more on my opponent's side. Can I use BT21-044 [RizeGreymon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to have 1 of my Digimon attack, resolve the attack, then use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to have 1 of my Digimon attack?
AD1-021.answer:
Yes, you can.
Even if you pay a cost and the memory moves to 1 or more on the opponent's side during the main phase, first any effects that triggered during that timing must resolve, then the end of the turn timing occurs.
In this case, once all of the attacks from [RizeGreymon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect have resolved, then the end of the turn timing will occur. Because the attack has already resolved and isn't currently occurring, you can activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect and have 1 of your Digimon attack.

AD1-021.question: I have 2 copies of this card in the battle area. At the end of my turn, I used the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. Can I then use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card to attack?
AD1-021.answer:
No, an attack using the 2nd effect isn't possible. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack.
In this case, the [End of Your Turn] effects on both copies of this card trigger simultaneously at the end of your turn, and you use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack.
The 2nd [End of Your Turn] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.

AD1-021.question: I have this card and a yellow Digimon with [Agumon] or [Greymon] in its name in the battle area. At the end of my turn, can I choose to not activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?
AD1-021.answer:
No, you can't.
If your turn ends while you have a yellow Digimon with [Agumon] or [Greymon] in its name in the battle area, you must choose 1 of your [Marcus Damon]s, and it will gain the "is also treated as a 6000 DP Digimon, gains <Rush>, and can't digivolve" effect.
Then, you choose whether or not 1 of your Digimon will attack using the part of the effect after "then." At such times, [Once Per Turn] is considered to be used, even if you don't have 1 of your Digimon attack using the part of the effect after "then."

AD1-022.question: 2 copies of this card are in the battle area. Can I activate the [Your Turn] effect on both copies of this card and digivolve my Digimon into 1 [ADVENTURE] trait card with the digivolution cost reduced by 2?
AD1-022.answer:

You can't activate multiple digivolving effects at the same time.

AD1-024.question: If I suspend an opponent's Digimon with this card's [All Turns] effect, can I choose to not unsuspend this Digimon?
AD1-024.answer:
No, you can't.
If you suspend an opponent's Digimon with this effect, this Digimon must also unsuspend if it is possible to do so.

AD1-024.question: I activated this card's [All Turns] effect when a method other than an effect played or digivolved a Digimon. Can I then activate this card's [All Turns] effect again when an effect plays or digivolves a Digimon?
AD1-024.answer:
No, you can't.
This effect's [Once Per Turn] has already been used upon the 1st activation, therefore it can't activate again.

AD1-024.question: If this card's [All Turns] effect activates, can I unsuspend this Digimon even if I can't suspend an opponent's Digimon such as in cases where they have no Digimon?
AD1-024.answer: Yes, you can. However, if your opponent has a Digimon that can suspend, you must suspend it when possible.

AD1-025.question: I activated this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?
AD1-025.answer:
Yes, you can.
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

AD1-025.question: When does a "when [...] leaves the battle area" effect trigger?
AD1-025.answer:
It triggers when a card in the battle area is placed in another area.
The following areas are considered other areas:
●Deck
●Digi-Egg deck
●Breeding area
●Hand
●Trash
●Security stack
●Under a card (in a Digimon's digivolution cards or under a Tamer)

AD1-025.question: Does a "when [...] leaves the battle area" effect trigger even if a "when [...] would leave the battle area" effect activates and prevents it from leaving?

BT1-089.question: Does this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect activate when an effect from a card like [BT1-089 Mimi Tachikawa] moves a level 3 Digimon from your opponent's breeding area to their battle area outside of their breeding phase?
If this Digimon is in play, can I move one of my level 3 or higher Digimon from my breeding area to my battle area with [BT1-089 Mimi Tachikawa]'s effect?
BT1-089.answer: Yes. Moving a Digimon out of your breeding area does not count as playing a Digimon.

BT1-089.question: If this Digimon is targeted by an effect such as "1 of your opponent's Digimon gains <Security A. -1>," then this Digimon is moved to the breeding area, what happens to the effect?
BT1-089.answer: If this Digimon is targeted by an effect and then moved to the breeding area, it remains targeted by the effect. However, it isn't affected by that effect. If it's moved back to the battle area using an effect such as [BT1-089 Mimi Tachikawa]'s effect, it will be affected by that effect again.

BT1-089.question: After I activated this Digimon's [End of Your Turn] effect, I used an effect such as [BT1-089 Mimi Tachikawa]'s effect to move this Digimon back to the battle area. Can I activate that Digimon's [End of Your Turn] effect again?
BT1-089.answer:
No, you can't.
Even if a card is moved, once a [Once Per Turn] effect has activated, it can't be activated again.

BT1-090.question: My opponent has this card in play when I activate the effect on a card like [BT1-090 Gravity Crush], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], [BT1-040 WereGarurumon], [BT1-058 Chirinmon], or [BT1-075 Digitamamon]. What happens?
BT1-090.answer: You can't use Option/Digimon card effects to gain memory, but you can still lose memory if a card effect specifies as such.

BT1-090.question: My opponent has this card in play when I activate the effect on a card like [BT1-090 Gravity Crush], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], [BT1-040 WereGarurumon], [BT1-058 Chirinmon], or [BT1-075 Digitamamon]. What happens?
BT1-090.answer: You can't use Option/Digimon card effects to gain memory, but you can still lose memory if a card effect specifies as such.

BT1-090.question: My opponent has this card in play when I activate the effect on a card like [BT1-090 Gravity Crush], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], [BT1-040 WereGarurumon], [BT1-058 Chirinmon], or [BT1-075 Digitamamon]. What happens?
BT1-090.answer: You can't use Option/Digimon card effects to gain memory, but you can still lose memory if a card effect specifies as such.

BT1-090.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. What happens if an effect is activated that causes you to gain memory on activation and lose memory at end of turn? (i.e. [BT1-090 Gravity Crush], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], [BT1-040 WereGarurumon], [BT1-058 Chirinmon], [BT1-075 Digitamamon], etc.)
BT1-090.answer: You can't use Option/Digimon card effects to gain memory, but you can still lose memory if a card effect specifies as such. At the end of the turn, you’ll lose memory as specified by each effect.

BT1-092.question: Can I choose to only trigger <Draw 2> or give one of my Digimon +2000 DP? Do I have to do both?
BT1-092.answer: You have to both draw 2 cards and give a Digimon +2000 DP if possible.

BT1-093.question: Can I choose to give one of my Digimon only +2000 DP or <Security Attack +1>? Do I have to do both?
BT1-093.answer: You have to give the Digimon both +2000 DP and <Security Attack +1> if possible.

BT1-094.question: My opponent has used an Option card or other effect to give one of their Digimon <Blocker>. Can I use this card's effect to delete that Digimon?

BT1-095.question: Can I use this card's effect to give one of my originally unsuspended Digimon <Blocker>?

BT1-099.question: What happens if I activate this card's effect against a Digimon with no digivolution cards?
BT1-099.answer: Nothing happens, but the game still treats it as if you used the Option card.

BT1-100.question: I use this card's effect when my opponent's Digimon has no digivolution cards. If that Digimon later gains digivolution cards, can it attack?

BT1-101.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. I attack my opponent with a Digimon that has <Security Attack +1>, and flip over [BT1-101 Howling Crusher] from their security stack. If its [Security] effect results in the attacking Digimon having no digivolution cards, does the attack end immediately?
BT1-101.answer: No. You've already declared the attack, so even if your attacking Digimon loses its digivolution card, [Hexeblaumon]'s effect doesn't end the attack midway.

BT1-102.question: What happens when I use this card while I have 1 or fewer cards in my security stack?
BT1-102.answer: Nothing happens, but the game still treats it as if you used the Option card.

BT1-104.question: After activating this card's [Main] effect, do Digimon that later enter the battle area by being moved or played also gain this card's effect?
What happens when this card is revealed upon a security check?
A Digimon gains this card's effect and attacks. At such times, can I activate the [When Attacking] effect gained from this card's effect after the attacking Digimon digivolves by another effect?
I play this card, then play a Digimon. Does it receive this card's effect?
I use 2 copies of this card. When I attack with a Digimon, can I activate its When Attacking effect twice in a single attack, giving an opponent's Digimon -4000 DP?

BT1-105.question: What does "original DP" refer to?
BT1-105.answer: The DP value printed on a card is its original DP. This card's effect temporarily allows you to treat the DP value printed on an opponent's Digimon as if it were 3000.

BT1-105.question: I use this card's effect to change the original DP of an opponent's Digimon to 3000. I then use [ST3-11 Seraphimon]'s effect to give an opponent's Digimon -4000 DP. If the opponent's Digimon drops to 0 DP, is it deleted?
BT1-105.answer: Yes, when a Digimon's DP becomes 0, it's deleted.

BT1-105.question: This card's effect has set a Digimon's original DP to 3000. If [ST1-13 Shadow Wing] is used to give that Digimon +3000 DP, is its DP now 6000?
BT1-105.answer: Yes, effects that increase or decrease DP work as normal, raising the Digimon's DP to 6000.

BT1-105.question: If I use this card's effect on a Digimon that's already getting +1000 DP from an effect, does its DP become 3000?
BT1-105.answer: No, its original DP becomes 3000. 3000 DP and 1000 DP (from the effect) add up to 4000 DP.

BT1-105.question: I digivolve a Digimon while this card's effect is active. What happens to the Digimon's DP?
BT1-105.answer: Even after digivolving, the Digimon's DP is treated as 3000 until the end of the turn.

BT1-107.question: I have 1 card in my security stack. My opponent attacks me with a Digimon with <Security Attack +1>, and flips over this card during the security check. Its <Recovery +1 (Deck)> activates, adding a card to my empty security stack. Does my opponent continue the security check?
BT1-107.answer: Yes, they continue by checking the card that was added to your security stack.

BT1-107.question: While this Digimon is in my battle area, my opponent's Digimon checks my security stack and flips over [BT1-107 Holy Wave]. Its [Security] effect activates, adding a card to my security stack. I ended up with the same number of cards in my security stack, but does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect still activate?
BT1-107.answer: Yes, a card was removed from your security stack, so it activates.

BT1-107.question: While this Tamer is in my battle area, my opponent's Digimon checks my security stack and flips over [BT1-107 Holy Wave]. Its [Security] effect activates, adding a card to my security stack. The number of cards in my security stack remained the same, but can I still suspend this card to gain 1 memory?
BT1-107.answer: Yes, because a card was removed from your security stack.

BT1-109.question: I have a level 6 Digimon with a digivolution cost of 3, and use this card's effect to reduce that cost by 4, to -1. Can I digivolve into that Digimon by gaining a memory?
BT1-109.answer: No, digivolution costs can't be reduced to less than zero. You can digivolve the card for free, but you can't gain memory with effects that reduce digivolution costs.

BT1-109.question: Does activating this card's effect also reduce the digivolution cost of cards in my breeding area?
BT1-109.answer: No, it doesn't. Since the card doesn't specify breeding areas, the effect doesn't apply to Digimon there.

BT1-109.question: After using this card, can I reduce the digivolution cost of my level 5 green Digimon digivolving to level 6 when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?

My opponent has this Digimon in play. During my turn, I use an Option card like [BT1-109 Smashed Potatoes] or [EX1-071 Win Rate: 60%!] which has an effect that activates “the next time one of your Digimon digivolves”. After that, all of my opponent’s Digimon become suspended. If I then digivolve one of my Digimon, are the effects from the Option cards I used earlier negated?
BT1-109.answer: No. You already used the Option cards and activated their effects, so this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect can’t negate them.

BT1-110.question: My opponent uses an Option card or other effect to give one of their Digimon <Blocker>. Can I use this card's security effect to suspend that Digimon?
BT1-110.answer: No, if your opponent's Digimon has <Blocker>, it can't be suspended with this card's effect.

BT1-111.question: Can I use this card's effect to suspend both 1 of my opponent's Digimon, and 2 of my opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less?
BT1-111.answer: No. You can either suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, regardless of DP, or 2 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less. You can't mix and match.

BT1-111.question: Can I use this card's effect to suspend 1 of my opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less, and no other Digimon?
BT1-111.answer: Yes, this card's effect allows you to pick 1 Digimon and suspend it, regardless of DP.

BT1-112.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. Can I unsuspend it over and over again every time I use it to delete an opponent's Digimon in battle?
BT1-112.answer: Yes. The effect has no limit to the number of times it can be used. As long as you keep deleting your opponent's Digimon, you can keep using the effect to unsuspend this card.

BT1-112.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. If it deletes an opponent's Security Digimon in battle, can I unsuspend it?
BT1-112.answer: No, the effect doesn't activate in battles with Security Digimon.

BT1-112.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. I attack with it, and my opponent blocks it. If my Digimon deletes the opponent's blocking Digimon and survives, can I unsuspend it?
BT1-112.answer: Yes, if your Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives, you can unsuspend it, even if the opposing Digimon had <Blocker>.

BT1-112.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. I attack an opponent's Digimon with it, and an effect causes one of my opponent's other Digimon to be deleted during the battle. Do I still get to unsuspend my attacking Digimon?
BT1-112.answer: No. You can only unsuspend the Digimon with this effect if it deletes the Digimon it's currently attacking. Other Digimon don't count.

BT1-112.question: I use [BT-112 Dimension Scissor], which allows 1 of my Digimon to unsuspend every time it deletes an opponent's Digimon. If I then use this card and attack an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards, can I unsuspend my Digimon using Dimension Scissor's effect after deleting the opponent's Digimon using this card's effect?
BT1-112.answer: No, Dimension Scissor requires the Digimon to attack and delete an opponent's Digimon and survive the battle. This card's effect deletes the opposing Digimon before the battle begins, so the effect doesn't apply.

BT1-113.question: I use this card's effect on one of my opponent's Digimon, which they then digivolve. Can it now attack and block?
Does this card's security effect also prevent my opponent's suspended Tamers from unsuspending during their unsuspend phase?
BT1-113.answer: No, this card's security effect only affects Digimon. Your opponent's Tamers unsuspend as normal.

BT1-114.question: My opponent has [ST1-09 MetalGreymon], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], and [BT1-114 MetalGreymon] in play in their battle area. I use this card's When Digivolving effect to choose [ST1-09 MetalGreymon]. Are all of my opponent's [MetalGreymon] cards deleted?
BT1-114.answer: Yes. The card numbers may be different, but the names match. All of your opponent's [MetalGreymon] cards are deleted.

BT1-114.question: Can this Digimon attack when I have less than 5 memory?
BT1-114.answer: Yes, it can. Even if this Digimon's attack effect causes your memory to move to 1 or greater on your opponent's side, it doesn't become your opponent's turn until the end of the attack.

BT1-115.question: Does this card's When Attacking effect activate when I have a Tamer that isn't blue in play?
BT1-115.answer: Yes, it does. This card's When Attacking effect doesn't depend upon the color of your Tamers.

BT1-115.question: I have 2 blue Tamers in play. During my turn, does this card's inherited effect grant +2000 DP?
BT1-115.answer: No. No matter how many blue Tamers you have in play, the effect only grants +1000 DP.

BT10-001.question: Does this card's inherited effect give this card +1000 DP when it has a red 2-color card as a digivolution card?
BT10-001.answer:
No, it doesn't.
A red 2-color card isn't considered a "non-red card."

BT10-004.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate when an effect suspends one of my Digimon?

BT10-006.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate even when this card is trashed from digivolution cards by my own effect and not my opponent's?

BT10-008.question: Is it true that both the Digimon card and the Tamer card must have the [Xros Heart] trait in order for this card's effect to be able to add them to my hand?
This card’s effect reveals 3 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a Digimon card or a Tamer card with the [Xros Heart] trait, can I still add a card to my hand?
BT10-008.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait or a Tamer card with the [Xros Heart] trait is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT10-008.question: This card's effect reveals 3 cards. If both Digimon and Tamer cards with the [Xros Heart] trait are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
BT10-008.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 Digimon card and 1 Tamer card [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT10-009.question: Can I choose not to activate this card’s [End of Attack] effect by not performing "placing all digivolution cards from under this Digimon under 1 of your Tamers", thus preventing this Digimon from being deleted?
Can I activate this card's [End of Attack] effect if this Digimon doesn't have any digivolution cards?
BT10-009.answer: No, it doesn't activate unless you can perform "placing all digivolution cards from under this Digimon under 1 of your Tamers."

BT10-009.question: If I activate this card's [End of Attack] effect, can I unsuspend a different Tamer than the Tamer under which I placed the digivolution cards?

BT10-011.question: If more than 1 of my Tamers suspend at the same time, does this card's "+2000 DP" effect activate multiple times?
BT10-011.answer: No, even if multiple Tamers suspend at the same time, this effect will only give +2000 DP.

BT10-011.question: I digivolve a Digimon with [Gammamon] in its name and a [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect into this card. Can I activate the [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect through this card's [All Turns] effect and attack?
BT10-011.answer: Yes, if the memory gauge is now at 1 or greater on your opponent's side, you can activate <Blitz>.

BT10-011.question: I digivolve a [BT8-013 BetelGammamon] into a [BT8-084 Kimeramon] and place this card as one of [BT8-084 Kimeramon]'s digivolution cards with its [When Digivolving] effect. Can I now activate [BT8-013 BetelGammamon]'s [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect through this card's inherited effect and attack?
BT10-011.answer: No, you can't. If this card is added to digivolution cards by [BT8-084 Kimeramon]'s [When Digivolving] effect, you get [BT8-013 BetelGammamon]'s <Blitz> effect through this card, but the time to trigger <Blitz> has already passed, so <Blitz> doesn't activate.

BT10-011.question: If I have multiple digivolution cards with [Gammamon] in their names, does this card's [All Turns] effect and inherited effect give me all of their effects?
BT10-011.answer: Yes, you gain all the effects from every applicable card, even if there are multiple of them.

BT10-011.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect and inherited effect allow me to activate the inherited effect of a digivolution card with [Gammamon] in its name as an effect of this card?
BT10-011.answer: No, this card's [All Turns] effect and inherited effect don't affect the inherited effects of digivolution cards with [Gammamon] in their names.

BT10-011.question: Due to an effect, this Digimon has another [BT10-011 Canoweissmon] and a [BT8-008 Gammamon] under it as its digivolution cards. If I play a red Tamer, how exactly does [BT8-008 Gammamon]'s "When you play a red Tamer, <Draw 1> (Draw 1 card from your deck)" effect work in this situation?
BT10-011.answer: This card's effect and inherited effect mean that this Digimon gains [BT8-008 Gammamon]'s effects twice, so <Draw 1> is activated twice and you draw a total of 2 cards.

BT10-011.question: When a [Dobermon] with [BT10-011 Canoweissmon] and [Gammamon] with an [On Play] effect in its digivolution cards digivolves into this card, does this card's [When Digivolving] effect activate the [On Play] effect on both this card and the [Gammamon] digivolution card?

When a [Cerberusmon] with [BT10-011 Canoweissmon] and [Gammamon] with an [On Play] effect in its digivolution cards digivolves into this card, does this card's [When Digivolving] effect activate the [On Play] effect on both this card and the [Gammamon] digivolution card?

When this Digimon digivolves into BT10-011 [Canoweissmon], I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect after gaining it using BT10-011 [Canoweissmon]'s [All Turns] effect, and I place a card with a [When Digivolving] effect and [Gammamon] in its name from my hand in that Digimon's digivolution cards. Can I activate the placed card's [When Digivolving] effect at such times?

When this Digimon digivolves into BT10-011 [Canoweissmon], I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect after gaining it using BT10-011 [Canoweissmon]'s [All Turns] effect, and I place a card with a [When Digivolving] effect and [Gammamon] in its name from my hand in that Digimon's digivolution cards. Can I activate the placed card's [When Digivolving] effect at such times?

BT10-013.question: Can I use <Material Save> on a Digimon such as BT10-013 [Shoutmon X5] that has [Shoutmon] in its DigiXros requirements to place this card under a Tamer?
BT10-013.answer:
No, you can't.
This card is only treated as [Shoutmon] for a DigiXros.

BT10-013.question: Can I use <Material Save> on a Digimon such as BT10-013 [Shoutmon X5] that has [Starmons] in its DigiXros requirements to place this card under a Tamer?
BT10-013.answer:
No, you can't.
This card is only treated as [Starmons] for a DigiXros.

BT10-013.question: Can I use <Material Save> on a Digimon such as BT10-013 [Shoutmon X5] that has [Dorulumon] in its DigiXros requirements to place this card under a Tamer?
BT10-013.answer:
No, you can't.
This card is only treated as [Dorulumon] for a DigiXros.

BT10-013.question: Can I use <Material Save> on a Digimon such as BT10-013 [Shoutmon X5] that has [Ballistamon] in its DigiXros requirements to place this card under a Tamer?
BT10-013.answer:
No, you can't.
This card is only treated as [Ballistamon] for a DigiXros.

BT10-016.question: I have a [Jesmon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards, and one of my Digimon has [Sistermon] in its name. Do my Digimon get +4000 DP from this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
BT10-016.answer: No, they only get +2000 DP from this effect.

BT10-016.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect reads "all of your Digimon may also attack unsuspended Digimon and get +2000 DP." Does this also affect my Digimon that enter the battle area in the same turn after I've digivolved into this card?
BT10-016.answer: Yes, it does. However, Digimon affected by this effect still can't ignore the rule "Digimon can't attack on the turn that they were played".

BT10-016.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect placed a [BT10-016 Jesmon (X Antibody)] as a digivolution card, then that card's [When Digivolving] effect played a [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc], then I activated <Blitz> in this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack. When does [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc]'s [On Play] effect activate?
BT10-016.answer:
Since both the [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] having been played and this Digimon attacking with <Blitz> happened during this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect, the Digimon being played and the attack are treated as having happened at the same time for the purpose of triggering effects.
The turn player can choose the order in which to activate the [On Play] effect and any potential [When Attacking] and such effects.

BT10-016.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect placed a [BT10-016 Jesmon (X Antibody)] as a digivolution card, then that card's [When Digivolving] effect played a [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc], then I activated <Blitz> in this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack, and when the [When Attacking] effect deleted one of my opponent's Digimon, my [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] was deleted by the [On Deletion] effect of the opponent's Digimon. [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc]'s [On Play] effect hasn't activated yet, so does it activate?
BT10-016.answer:
No, it doesn't activate.
The [On Play] effect from [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] was triggered, but it cannot activate because the [Sistermon Blanc] is deleted before it is able to activate.

BT10-018.question: What does a "your opponent can't play XX by effects" effect do, exactly?
BT10-018.answer:
Such effects prevent your opponent from playing XX by effects.
With this card's effect, your opponent can no longer play Digimon by effects such as BT10-018 [Gaossmon]'s [On Deletion] effect or BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon]'s [When Digivolving] effect.
This effect affects the opponent player.

BT10-018.question: What does a "your opponent can't play XX by effects" effect do, exactly?
BT10-018.answer:
Such effects prevent your opponent from playing XX by effects.
With this card's effect, your opponent can no longer play Digimon or Tamers by effects such as BT10-018 [Gaossmon]'s [On Deletion] effect or BT9-099 [Sunrise Buster]'s [Main] effect.
This effect affects the opponent player.

BT10-019.question: If I have a [Kiriha Aonuma] in play, do I get to choose either "Reveal 4 cards from the top of your deck. Add 2 cards with [Blue Flare] in their traits among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order" or "return 1 [MetalGreymon] from your trash to your hand" for this card's [On Play] effect?
BT10-019.answer: Yes, you can choose one or the other.

BT10-019.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to add a card to my hand when only 1 card with the [Blue Flare] trait is among the 4 revealed cards?
BT10-019.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT10-023.question: In order to <Draw 2> from this card's [When Digivolving] effect, do I need to have 6 or fewer cards in my hand after drawing the digivolution bonus card?
BT10-023.answer: Yes, that's right. <Draw 2> does not activate if you have 7 or more cards in your hand after drawing the digivolution bonus.

BT10-024.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect target the opponent's Digimon that don't have digivolution cards?
An opponent's Digimon was targeted by this card's [On Play] effect, and after that it gained more digivolution cards than this Digimon has, can it now attack and block again?
BT10-024.answer: No. As long as the number of digivolution cards that Digimon had was less than or equal to this Digimon's at the time this effect was activated, this effect stays and it can't attack or block?even if it later gains more digivolution cards.

BT10-027.question: If this Digimon has both level 3 and level 4 Digimon cards in its digivolution cards, can I choose to play just 1 of them with this card's [When Attacking] effect?
BT10-027.answer: No. If you choose to play cards with the [When Attacking] effect, you must play as many cards as possible?so if cards of both levels are in the digivolution cards, you can't play just 1 of them.

BT10-030.question: An opponent's Digimon is targeted by this card's [On Play] effect. If it later becomes level 6 or above, does it lose the <Security Attack -1> gained from this effect?
BT10-030.answer: No. As long as it was level 5 or lower when this effect was activated, the effect remains and it still has <Security Attack -1>?even if it later becomes level 6 or higher.

BT10-032.question: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?
BT10-032.answer: 1 Option card with [Plug-In] in its name and 1 yellow Tamer card.

BT10-032.question: If the "when you use an Option card" effect triggers, what is the timing when it can activate?
BT10-032.answer: It can be activated after activating the used Option card's [Main] effect.

BT10-032.question: Does the "when you use an Option card" effect trigger if an Option card's effect activates by a method other than using the card?
BT10-032.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If an Option card's effect activates without using it, such as activation by a [Security] effect or <Delay>, the "when you use an Option card" effect doesn't trigger.

BT10-032.question: An Option card's use cost is 1 or less when used from the hand due to an effect such as BT2-099 [Glorious Burst] or BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s 1st effect. When such a card is used, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
BT10-032.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If a card's cost itself is reduced when it's used from the hand, it's considered to be using an Option card with a use cost after the reduction is applied. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect doesn't trigger.

BT10-032.question: An Option card has an original use cost of 2 or more, and I use it when the cost to pay is reduced to 1 or less. At such times, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
BT10-032.answer:
Yes, it triggers.
If the card's cost to pay is reduced and not the use cost itself, it's considered to be using an Option card with its original value as its use cost. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect triggers.

BT10-032.question: I used an effect to use an Option card with an original use cost of 2 or more without paying the cost. At such times, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?

BT10-034.question: While this card is in the digivolution cards of a Digimon with [Shoutmon] in its name, do my opponent's Security Digimon get -2000 DP from this card's inherited effect even when they are checked by some other Digimon?
BT10-034.answer: Yes, they get -2000 DP even when checked by some other Digimon than the one that has this in its digivolution cards.

BT10-040.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -5000 DP for the turn" effect and the "gain 2 memory" effect when activating this card's [When Attacking] effect?

BT10-041.question: It's currently my turn after the turn when my opponent activated BT9-103 [Kongou]'s effect. If I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect and use an Option card, can I place that Option card on top of the security stack instead of placing it in the trash?
BT10-041.answer:
No, you can't place it in the trash.
BT9-103 [Kongou]'s effect prevents cards from being added to your security stack, so the used Option card is trashed.

BT10-041.question: I used this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use P-037 [Yellow Memory Boost!], and I use P-037 [Yellow Memory Boost!]'s 1st [Main] effect to place that card in the battle area. What happens to "place the Option card used with this effect on top of your security stack face down instead of placing it in your trash" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect at such times?
BT10-041.answer: P-037 [Yellow Memory Boost!] can't be placed in the trash, therefore it can't be placed on top of the security stack.

BT10-041.question: I used this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use BT4-105 [Tactical Retreat!], then I placed this card itself on top of the security stack. At such times, after using BT4-105 [Tactical Retreat!], will it be placed in the security stack by the "place the Option card used with this effect on top of your security stack face down instead of placing it in your trash" effect?
BT10-041.answer: Yes, it will be placed in the security stack.

BT10-041.question: I used this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use ST22-08 [Offensive Plug-In V], and ST22-08 [Offensive Plug-In V]'s [Main] effect linked that card to a Digimon. What happens to "place the Option card used with this effect on top of your security stack face down instead of placing it in your trash" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect at such times?
BT10-041.answer: ST22-08 [Offensive Plug-In V] can't be placed in the trash, therefore it can't be placed on top of the security stack.

BT10-042.question: Does "can't attack this Digimon and can't activate [When Attacking] and [When Digivolving] effects" in this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect apply to opponent's Digimon with <Security Attack +X> as well as those with <Security Attack -X>?
BT10-042.answer: Yes, all of your opponent's Digimon with either <Security Attack +X> or <Security Attack -X> are affected by "can't attack this Digimon and can't activate [When Attacking] and [When Digivolving] effects."

BT10-042.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play, and I digivolve one of my Digimon into a Digimon card that has <Security Attack +1> and a [When Digivolving] effect. Does that Digimon activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
BT10-042.answer: No, it has <Security Attack +1> as soon as the digivolution is complete, so this card's effect prevents the [When Digivolving] effect from activating.

BT10-042.question: What kind of Digimon does this effect's "Digimon with <Security Attack>" refer to?
BT10-042.answer: It refers to Digimon affected by <Security Attack +> or <Security Attack -> effects.

BT10-042.question: If an opponent's Digimon has both <Security Attack +1> and <Security Attack -1> so the values cancel each other out, is the Digimon treated as not having <Security Attack>, and is it unaffected by "Digimon with <Security Attack> can't attack this Digimon and can't activate [When Attacking] and [When Digivolving] effects"?
BT10-042.answer:
No, <Security Attack> is not canceled even if a Digimon has both <Security Attack +1> and <Security Attack -1>.
The Digimon is considered to have <Security Attack>, so the effect applies to this Digimon.

BT10-042.question: I digivolved one of my [MetalGreymon] into [BT9-015 MetalGreymon (X Antibody)]. It gets <Security Attack+1> and +3000 DP with its [When Digivolving] effect, but does that effect activate when my opponent has this Digimon in play?
BT10-042.answer: Yes, it activates. [BT9-015 MetalGreymon (X Antibody)] gains <Security Attack +1> from the [When Digivolving] effect, so after that effect has activated, this card then prevents further [When Attacking] and [When Digivolving] effects from activating.

BT10-042.question: If a Digimon has a <Security Attack> effect that is only active when certain conditions are met, such as "While this Digimon has X or more digivolution cards, it gains <Security Attack +1>," does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect apply when these conditions aren't met?

My opponent has this Digimon in play. One of my Digimon that doesn't have <Security Attack> attacks it, and then the attacking Digimon gains <Security Attack> from a [When Attacking] effect or an effect such as "when one of your Digimon attacks". What happens to the attack?
BT10-042.answer:
The attack continues.
This effect doesn't end or cancel an attack if the attacking Digimon gains <Security Attack> after the attack has been declared. It prevents Digimon with <Security Attack> from declaring the attack.

BT10-042.question: When a Digimon with <Security Attack> attacks, does this card's effect stop "when this Digimon attacks" effects of those Digimon, such as <Raid>?
BT10-042.answer: No, "When... attacks" effects are not [When Attacking] effects, so this card's effect can't stop them from activating.

BT10-042.question: I have a [Jesmon GX] that has <Security Attack> in play, while my opponent has a [BT10-042 Venusmon] in play. If I use this card and target my [Jesmon GX], can this card's effect activate [Jesmon GX]'s [When Digivolving] effects?
BT10-042.answer: No. Because [Jesmon GX]'s [When Digivolving] and [When Attacking] effects cannot be activated due to your opponent's [BT10-042 Venusmon], even this card can't activate those effects in these circumstances.

BT10-042.question: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to digivolve this card into a [Venusmon] such as BT10-042 [Venusmon] that doesn't meet the digivolution requirements, ignoring level?
BT10-042.answer:
No, you can't.
Digivolution while ignoring level is only possible as long as the digivolution requirements are met.

BT10-046.question: Can this card's effect add cards that have the trait [Ancient Plant] or [Carnivorous Plant], etc.?
This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include 1 card with [Vegetation] or [Plant] in one of its traits or with the [Fairy] trait, can I still add a card to my hand?
BT10-046.answer: Yes, as long as at least 1 card with [Vegetation] or [Plant] in one of its traits or with the [Fairy] trait is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT10-046.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If both a card with [Vegetation] or [Plant] in one of its traits and a card with [Fairy] in one of its traits are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the other at the bottom of my deck?
BT10-046.answer: No. This card's effect does not feature language that would make it optional, so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT10-048.question: I digivolve this card into a card that has <Digisorption> in my hand, and suspend 1 of my Digimon with the <Digisorption> effect. Can I activate this card's inherited effect and <Draw 1>?
BT10-048.answer: No, you can't. The Digimon is suspended by <Digisorption> before the digivolution is complete, so the inherited effect cannot be triggered yet.

BT10-052.question: If this Digimon is suspended, can it itself become the target when its [Opponent's Turn] effect switches the target of an opponent's Digimon's attack?
BT10-052.answer: Yes, you can choose to do so.

BT10-052.question: When one of my opponent's Digimon attacks, in what order do that Digimon's [When Attacking] effect and this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate?
BT10-052.answer: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their [When Attacking] effect first.

BT10-053.question: Can I suspend this card itself to activate this card's [Main] effect?
Does this card's inherited effect activate if 1 of my Digimon attacks with <Blitz> and I suspend it?
BT10-053.answer: No, suspending to declare an attack is not the same as being suspended by an effect even when attacking via <Blitz>, so the inherited effect does not activate.

BT10-056.question: If this Digimon and one of my other Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant], or [Fairy] in one of its traits are deleted at the same time during the opponent's turn, does the [On Deletion] effect gained from this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate?

BT10-057.question: If I have a suspended Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant], or [Fairy] in one of its traits, can I choose to suspend this Digimon itself with this card's [When Digivolving], gain 2 memory, then unsuspend this Digimon and gain <Piercing>?
If I have 4 suspended Digimon, does this Digimon gain +4000 DP and <Security Attack +1> twice?
Does this card itself count as a suspended Digimon for this card's [Your Turn] effect?
BT10-057.answer: Yes, this Digimon counts if it's suspended.

BT10-058.question: What happens to the cards that weren't added to my hand from among the cards revealed by this card’s effects?
BT10-058.answer: You place them at the bottom of your deck in any order. Please see the notices regarding changes to the rules/rulings on the official website.

BT10-058.question: This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include 1 card that is either black with [Knightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] in its name or 1 card with the [Twilight] trait, can I still add a card to my hand?
BT10-058.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT10-058.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If 2 cards that are either black with [Knightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] in their names and/or the [Twilight] trait are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining card at the bottom of my deck?
BT10-058.answer:
No. This card's effect reads “Add 2 cards [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
However, if you have a black card with [Knightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] in its name and the [Twilight] trait among the revealed cards and there are no other cards with [Knightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] in their names, you can treat that card as your card with the [Twilight] trait and add it to your hand. Any other cards that have the [Twilight] trait will then be returned to the bottom of your deck. In such a case, it can be possible to add just 1 of the cards.

BT10-059.question: If my opponent does not have any Digimon in play so there is no target for <De-Digivolve 1>, can I still place this card under 1 of my Digimon that has the [Legend-Arms] or [Xros Heart] trait when activating this card's [On Play] effect?

BT10-061.question: I play this card while DigiXrosing with 2 cards, but there are no cards with [Knightmon] in their name, [DeadlyAxemon], or [Nene Amano] among the cards revealed by the [On Play] effect. Does the "delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 4 or less" effect still activate?

What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon].")
BT10-061.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] names.

BT10-066.question: When this Digimon would be deleted, if neither [SkullKnightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, can I still return 1 level 4 or lower black Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards to my hand when activating this card's [All Turns]?

BT10-067.question: Is digivolution using BT10-067 [Justimon: Critical Arm]'s [When Attacking] effect possible while a "players can't ignore digivolution requirements" effect is activated?

BT10-068.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect reads "all of your Digimon get +2000 DP and your opponent's effects can't return them to hands or decks or reduce their DP." If one of my Digimon's DP is reduced before this effect activates, what happens to that Digimon's DP?
BT10-068.answer: Its original DP is restored by "can't [...] reduce their DP," and it additionally gets +2000 DP from this effect.

BT10-068.question: Can I use this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect to play [BT5-111 Omnimon X Anti-body], [BT10-068 Gankoomon (X Antibody)], and [BT10-086 Omnimon (X Antibody)] from the digivolution cards of my Digimon in the breeding area?

BT10-069.question: If [DarkKnightmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards but I can't delete a Tamer because neither I nor my opponent have any, does this card's [When Digivolving] effect unsuspend this Digimon?
If [DarkKnightmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards but only I have a Tamer, can I choose to not delete my Tamer with this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

BT10-070.question: When one of my opponent's Digimon attacks, in what order do that Digimon's [When Attacking] effect and this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate?
BT10-070.answer: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their [When Attacking] effect first.

BT10-070.question: If this Digimon has 4 or more digivolution cards when I play this card, does <Blitz> activate?
BT10-070.answer:
Yes, it can activate.
This card's [On Play] effect activates <Blitz> if there are 3 or more digivolution cards.

BT10-071.question: I have 9 cards in my trash and a Digimon with this card as a digivolution card is deleted in battle. The deleted cards, including this one, are sent to my trash, and now I have over 10 cards in my trash. Does <Retaliation> in this card's inherited effects activate and delete my opponent's Digimon it battled?
BT10-071.answer: No. You didn't have 10 cards in your trash until after the deletion already took place, so this Digimon's inherited effect could not be active at the time of the deletion.

BT10-073.question: This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include 1 card with the [Bagra Army] trait or a [Yuu Amano], can I still add a card to my hand?
BT10-073.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with the [Bagra Army] trait or a [Yuu Amano] is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT10-073.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If both a card with the [Bagra Army] trait and a [Yuu Amano] are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining card at the bottom of my deck?
BT10-073.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 card [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT10-077.question: One of my opponent's Digimon attacks, <Draw 1> activates twice from both a [When Attacking] effect and an inherited effect, and their hand increases by 2 cards. Will this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect trash 2 of my opponent's cards in their hand?
BT10-077.answer:
No, you can only trash cards equal to the number of cards added by one effect.
Even if they were triggered at the same time, different effects are still separate from each other, and you can only activate this effect for one of them, so in this case you can count only one of the <Draw 1> and only 1 card in your opponent's hand will be trashed.

BT10-077.question: Does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate after an effect that adds and trashes cards in your opponent's hand so that the result is net 0 total cards gained, like "<Draw 2>. Then, trash 2 cards in your hand"?
BT10-077.answer:
Yes, it activates. This card's effect trashes the number of cards that were drawn.
In the example given in the question, after trashing 2 cards from their hand, your opponent would trash an additional 2 cards, for a total of 4 cards trashed.

BT10-077.question: Can I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect when I would choose and trash digivolution cards by activating the [Opponent's Turn] effect on a BT10-077 [MadLeomon] without digivolution cards?
BT10-077.answer:
Yes, you can.
If you were able to choose and trash this card's digivolution cards after the replacement, the condition for BT10-077 [MadLeomon]'s [Opponent's Turn] effect will be met.

BT10-077.question: If my opponent activates BT10-077 [MadLeomon]'s [Opponent's Turn] effect when I used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to draw 5 cards from the top of my deck, how many cards do I trash from my hand?
BT10-077.answer:
5 cards.
BT10-077 [MadLeomon]'s [Opponent's Turn] effect trashes cards equal to the number of cards added.

BT10-080.question: This card was trashed from my hand by one of my effects during my turn. Can I use this card's effect to digivolve one of my Digimon into this card from my trash?

BT10-081.question: I have 9 cards in my trash when this Digimon is deleted. If this results in my having 10 cards in my trash, does this card’s [On Deletion] effect activate?

BT10-084.question: What does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect do, exactly?
BT10-084.answer:
This card's [Opponent’s Turn] effect will replace an effect that would trash digivolution cards.
For example, if you replace a "trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, you trash the bottom digivolution card of this card.
Replacement is possible even when this card doesn't have any digivolution cards.

BT10-084.question: What happens when this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect replaces a "trash all of the digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect?
BT10-084.answer: All of this card's digivolution cards are trashed.

BT10-084.question: What happens when this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect replaces a "trash the top 3 digivolution cards of all of your opponent's Digimon" effect?
BT10-084.answer:
The top 3 digivolution cards of only this card are trashed.
Replacement is still possible if this card has 2 or fewer digivolution cards. In such cases, trash as many as possible.

BT10-084.question: What happens when this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect replaces a "choose 1 digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon and trash it" effect?
BT10-084.answer:
You choose and trash 1 digivolution card of this card.
The player who chooses the card to trash is the player who activated this card's effect.

BT10-084.question: What happens when this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect replaces a "by choosing 5 digivolution cards of this Digimon and trashing them" effect?
BT10-084.answer:
You choose and trash 5 digivolution cards of this card.
If you were able to choose and trash 5 digivolution cards after the replacement, the condition will be met.
You can't meet the "by" condition by performing just some of the actions, therefore the condition won't be met if you trash less than the specified number of cards, such as when you trash 4 cards.

BT10-084.question: If BT8-022 [SnowAgumon]'s [On Play] effect is used to choose a Digimon without digivolution cards, can that effect's trashing be replaced by this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?
BT10-084.answer:
Yes, it can.
Once replaced, you choose and trash 2 digivolution cards of this card.

BT10-084.question: Can I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect when I would choose and trash digivolution cards by activating the [Opponent's Turn] effect on a BT10-077 [MadLeomon] without digivolution cards?
BT10-084.answer:
Yes, you can.
If you were able to choose and trash this card's digivolution cards after the replacement, the condition for BT10-077 [MadLeomon]'s [Opponent's Turn] effect will be met.

BT10-085.question: I have BT10-085 [Sistermon Ciel]. Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to play a BT6-084 [Sistermon Ciel] or ST12-13 [Sistermon Ciel] that's also treated as [Sistermon Noir]?
BT10-085.answer:
No, it can't be played.
"With the same names" also refers to a card with even just 1 of the same name as any of your Digimon.
This effect can't play cards with the same name as [Sistermon Ciel].

BT10-086.question: While my opponent has this card's effect activated, I used [BT10-086 Omnimon (X Antibody)]'s effect to reveal all of my opponent's security cards. After choosing and trashing 1 card among them, can the rest be placed in the security stack?
BT10-086.answer:
Yes, the rest are placed in the security stack.
When returning cards that were revealed from a private area such as the deck or security stack by an effect, it isn't considered adding cards to such areas, therefore this card's effect doesn't apply.

BT10-086.question: Which player chooses which of my opponent's security cards is trashed by this card's [When Digivolving][When Attacking] effect?
BT10-086.answer: The player that activated this effect chooses.

BT10-086.question: My security cards were revealed due to the [When Digivolving] effect of this opponent's card, and 1 of them was trashed. Can I treat this as "when a card is removed from your security stack" and activate [BT4-097 Kari Kamiya]'s effect?
BT10-086.answer:
Yes, you can activate it.
When a revealed card is trashed from the deck or security stack, it is not considered to be trashed from the deck or security stack, but it is considered that a card was removed from the security stack, so [BT4-097 Kari Kamiya]'s effect can be activated.

BT10-086.question: Can I use this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect to play [BT5-111 Omnimon X Anti-body], [BT10-068 Gankoomon (X Antibody)], and [BT10-086 Omnimon (X Antibody)] from the digivolution cards of my Digimon in the breeding area?

BT10-087.question: What does this card's "by suspending this Tamer, you may place cards from under your Tamers as digivolution cards for a DigiXros" effect do, exactly?
BT10-087.answer: When you play a Digimon card with DigiXros requirements, normally you can only DigiXros with Digimon from your hand or battle area. However, this effect also allows you to DigiXros with Digimon cards placed under a Tamer.

BT10-087.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect also allow me to DigiXros with cards placed under a Tamer other than this Tamer?
Does this card's [Your Turn] effect also allow me to DigiXros using the digivolution cards of a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?
If I play 2 or more Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements at the same time, can I activate this card's effect?
BT10-087.answer: No, this card's effect reads "when you would play 1 Digimon with DigiXros requirements", so if you play 2 or more Digimon cards at the same time, the effect cannot be activated.

BT10-087.question: If I play 1 Digimon card with DigiXros requirements and 1 card without DigiXros requirements at the same time, can I activate this card's effect?
BT10-087.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's effect can be activated when you would play 1 Digimon card with DigiXros requirements only.

BT10-088.question: What does this card's "by suspending this Tamer, you may place cards from under your Tamers as digivolution cards for a DigiXros" effect do, exactly?
BT10-088.answer: When you play a Digimon card with DigiXros requirements, normally you can only DigiXros with Digimon from your hand or battle area. However, this effect also allows you to DigiXros with Digimon cards placed under a Tamer.

BT10-088.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect also allow me to DigiXros with cards placed under a Tamer other than this Tamer?
Does this card's [Your Turn] effect also allow me to DigiXros with the digivolution cards of a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?
If I play 2 or more Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements at the same time, can I activate this card's effect?
BT10-088.answer: No, this card's effect reads "when you would play 1 Digimon with DigiXros requirements", so if you play 2 or more Digimon cards at the same time, the effect cannot be activated.

BT10-088.question: If I play 1 Digimon card with DigiXros requirements and 1 card without DigiXros requirements at the same time, can I activate this card's effect?
BT10-088.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's effect can be activated when you would play 1 Digimon card with DigiXros requirements only.

BT10-089.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect play a [Dorulumon] card from the digivolution cards of a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?

BT10-090.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect play a [Ballistamon] card from the digivolution cards of a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?

BT10-092.question: What happens to the cards that weren't added to my hand from among the cards revealed by this card’s effects?
BT10-092.answer: You place them at the bottom of your deck in any order.

BT10-093.question: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to place up to 3 cards from under multiples of my Tamers in the digivolution cards of the Digimon card to be played?
When I would play a [Bagra Army] trait card with DigiXros requirements, do I process this card's [Your Turn] effect or the DigiXros of the card to be played first?
BT10-093.answer:
You process this card's [Your Turn] effect first.
After processing the "when you would play" effect, you can then perform the DigiXros.
Once you use this card's [Your Turn] effect to place cards under the card to be played, then you place the cards for the DigiXros under the cards you just placed for the effect.

BT10-093.question: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect when I would play 2 or more level 4 or higher [Bagra Army] trait Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements at the same time?
BT10-093.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
This card's [Your Turn] effect triggers when you would play 1 level 4 or higher [Bagra Army] trait Digimon card. It doesn't trigger when you would play 2 or more at the same time.

BT10-096.question: If [Taiki Kudo] is among the cards revealed by this card's [Security] effect, can it be played?
If there is no Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait among the three revealed cards, can I still play [Taiki Kudo] from among the revealed cards?
BT10-096.answer: Yes, you can play [Taiki Kudo] even if there isn't a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait.

BT10-096.question: This card's [Security] effect reveals 3 cards. If both a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait and a [Taiki Kudo] are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only activate the effect that adds the Digimon to my hand and not play [Taiki Kudo], or the other way around?
BT10-096.answer: No, if you perform any of this effect you must perform as much of it as possible, so if both a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait and a [Taiki Kudo] are among the 3 cards revealed, you must perform both "add [...] to your hand" and "play 1 [Taiki Kudo]," or you must choose to perform neither.

BT10-097.question: If [Kiriha Aonuma] is among the cards revealed by this card's effect, can it be played?
Can this card's effect add fewer than 2 cards to my hand if it reveals fewer than 2 cards with the [Blue Flare] trait among the 6 revealed cards?
BT10-097.answer: Yes, you can add 1 card if only 1 card is revealed.

BT10-097.question: If there aren't 2 other Digimon cards with the [Blue Flare] trait among the six revealed cards, can I still play [Kiriha Aonuma] from among the revealed cards?
BT10-097.answer: No. For this card's effect you reveal cards, add 2 cards with the [Blue Flare] trait among them to your hand, then play 1 [Kiriha Aonuma] among them. Therefore, if there are 2 or fewer cards with the [Blue Flare] trait including [Kiriha Aonuma] among the revealed cards, you can't play [Kiriha Aonuma] because you would have to add it to your hand.

BT10-097.question: This card's effect reveals 6 cards. If both cards with the [Blue Flare] trait and a [Kiriha Aonuma] are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only activate the effect that adds the cards to my hand and not play [Kiriha Aonuma], or the other way around?
BT10-097.answer: No, if you perform any of this effect you must perform as much of it as possible, so if both cards with the [Blue Flare] trait and a [Kiriha Aonuma] are among the 3 cards revealed, you must perform both "add [...] to your hand" and "play 1 [Kiriha Aonuma]," or you must choose to perform neither.

BT10-100.question: Can I place this card in my battle area even if I don't have a [Pulsemon] in my hand?

BT10-101.question: I have exactly 3 security cards. Do I activate both this card's "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -12000 DP" effect and "place 1 of your opponent's Digimon face down on top of their security stack" effect?
My opponent checked my security when I had 4 security cards, and this card was flipped over. This card's [Security] effect activates, but is my security stack considered to have 3 cards?
BT10-101.answer:
Yes, it's considered to have 3 cards.
Cards revealed by a security check are not considered part of your security stack.

BT10-103.question: After suspending 1 of my opponent's Digimon with this card's [Main] effect, can I return some other Digimon than the one I suspended to the bottom of their deck?

BT10-108.question: Can I activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" effect when this card is revealed from the deck or when searching/looking at this card in the deck?
BT10-108.answer: No, you can't. You can only activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" when this card is directly trashed from the deck.

BT10-110.question: I have a [Jesmon GX] that has <Security Attack> in play, while my opponent has a [BT10-042 Venusmon] in play. If I use this card and target my [Jesmon GX], can this card's effect activate [Jesmon GX]'s [When Digivolving] effects?
BT10-110.answer: No. Because [Jesmon GX]'s [When Digivolving] and [When Attacking] effects cannot be activated due to your opponent's [BT10-042 Venusmon], even this card can't activate those effects in these circumstances.

BT10-111.question: What does "When you would DigiXros this turn, this Digimon may replace 1 of the DigiXros requirements" mean?
BT10-111.answer:
When you would DigiXros, this effect allows you to replace 1 of the cards in that Digimon's DigiXros requirements.
For example, when you would play a card with [Shoutmon X4] × [Beelzemon] in its DigiXros requirements, you may place this Digimon for the DigiXros instead of [Shoutmon X4] or [Beelzemon].

BT10-111.question: When DigiXrosing, can I place all of the cards listed in the DigiXros requirements in the digivolution cards, then additionally DigiXros this card?
BT10-111.answer: No, you can't. This card can only replace 1 card in the DigiXros requirements when DigiXrosing, not add to the DigiXros requirements.

BT10-111.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [Shoutmon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Shoutmon].")
BT10-111.answer: This card's special rule makes it so that it is always treated as if its name was [Shoutmon] as well.

BT10-112.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect reads "You may place 1 card with [Royal Knight] in its traits and a play cost of 13 or less from your hand or trash under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. Activate 1 of that card's [When Digivolving] effects as an effect of this Digimon." At what timing does that [When Digivolving] effect activate?
BT10-112.answer:
The effect is activated directly after placing the play cost 13 or lower [Royal Knight] trait card in its digivolution cards.
The placed card's [When Digivolving] effect is resolved as a part of this effect, and once that is done, you may declare an attack with the <Blitz> from this effect.

BT10-112.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect placed a [BT10-016 Jesmon (X Antibody)] as a digivolution card, then that card's [When Digivolving] effect played a [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc], then I activated <Blitz> in this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack. When does [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc]'s [On Play] effect activate?
BT10-112.answer:
Since both the [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] having been played and this Digimon attacking with <Blitz> happened during this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect, the Digimon being played and the attack are treated as having happened at the same time for the purpose of triggering effects.
The turn player can choose the order in which to activate the [On Play] effect and any potential [When Attacking] and such effects.

BT10-112.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect placed a [BT10-016 Jesmon (X Antibody)] as a digivolution card, then that card's [When Digivolving] effect played a [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc], then I activated <Blitz> in this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack, and when the [When Attacking] effect deleted one of my opponent's Digimon, my [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] was deleted by the [On Deletion] effect of the opponent's Digimon. [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc]'s [On Play] effect hasn't activated yet, so does it activate?
BT10-112.answer:
No, it doesn't activate.
The [On Play] effect from [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] was triggered, but it cannot activate because the [Sistermon Blanc] is deleted before it is able to activate.

BT11-005.question: If both this Digimon with [Greymon] in its name and an opponent's Digimon are deleted at the same time, will this card's inherited effect activate?

BT11-006.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate even when a card is trashed from my hand by my my opponent's effect?

I used [BT7-112 Susanoomon]'s effect to return 10 Tamer cards and/or cards with the [Hybrid] trait to the bottom of my deck, then I chose to trash [BT7-112 Susanoomon] instead of digivolving it. Does this card's inherited effect still activate in such cases?
BT11-006.answer: No. It doesn't activate in such cases because [BT7-112 Susanoomon] is trashed by the rules, not an effect.

BT11-007.question: If the red Tamer cards among the cards revealed from my deck do not have the [Vaccine] trait, does that mean I can't add any cards to my hand?
BT11-007.answer:
No, even if it does not have the [Vaccine] trait, you can add 1 red Tamer card to your hand.
However, you can't add a red Digimon card to your hand if it doesn't have the [Vaccine] trait.

BT11-007.question: This card’s effect reveals 3 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a red Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait or a red Tamer card, can I still add a card to my hand?
BT11-007.answer: Yes, as long as either a red Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait or a red Tamer card is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT11-007.question: This card's effect reveals 3 cards. If both a red Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait and a red Tamer card are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
BT11-007.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 red Digimon card [...] and 1 red Tamer card among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
