BT11-007.question: If both a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and my red Tamer are deleted at the same time, does the "gain 1 memory" effect activate?

BT11-008.question: If I attack my opponent using a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and my opponent blocks, does this card's inherited effect activate?
BT11-008.answer: Yes. Blocking causes the attack target to be switched, so the effect activates.

BT11-009.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "This card/Digimon is also treated as if its name is [Shoutmon] and [Starmons]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Shoutmon] and [Starmons].")
BT11-009.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Shoutmon] and [Starmons] names.

BT11-010.question: If I attack my opponent using a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and my opponent blocks, does this card's inherited effect activate?
BT11-010.answer: Yes. Blocking causes the attack target to be switched, so the effect activates.

BT11-012.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] effect to add a card to my hand when only 1 card with the [Xros Heart] trait or [Blue Flare] trait is among the revealed cards?
BT11-012.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT11-012.question: Is this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect mandatory?

BT11-016.question: Does this card's [My Turn] effect allow this card's [On Deletion] effect to be activated twice when I use one of my Digimon with <Security Attack +1> to check 2 cards in my opponent's security stack?
BT11-016.answer:
No, it doesn't.
This effect is triggered "When a card is removed from your opponent's security stack," so even when you check multiple cards in your opponent's security stack, it is triggered upon the first check, then you choose whether to activate it or not. Also, this is a [Once Per Turn] effect, so if you activate this effect when a card is removed from their security stack upon the first check, you can't activate the effect again upon the next check.

BT11-016.question: Does "with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in one of its traits (other than [Sea Animal])" mean that all traits with the [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] text other than [Sea Animal] are included regardless of other words or pluralizations?
BT11-016.answer: Yes. Other than [Sea Animal], all traits with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] are applicable regardless of other words or pluralizations.

BT11-016.question: What does "For each red Tamer you have in play, add 2000 to the maximum DP of the card you can play by this effect" on this card mean?
BT11-016.answer:
It means that you can use this card's [On Deletion] effect to play "1 red Digimon with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in one of its traits (other than [Sea Animal]), and 3000 DP or less," and if you have a red Tamer when this effect is activated, you add 2000 to the maximum DP for the "3000 DP or less" restriction.
For example, you can play 1 Digimon card with 5000 DP or less if you have 1 red Tamer, and you can play 1 Digimon card with 7000 DP or less if you have 2 red Tamers.

BT11-016.question: Can I use this card's "For each red Tamer you have in play, add 2000 to the maximum DP of the card you can play by this effect" effect to add 2000 to the maximum DP of my Digimon played with effects other than this card's effects?
BT11-016.answer:
No, you can't.
It only affects the [On Deletion] effect on this card itself.

BT11-017.question: If I attack my opponent using this Digimon and my opponent blocks, does this card's [Your Turn] effect activate?
BT11-017.answer: Yes. Blocking causes the attack target to be switched, so the effect activates.

BT11-018.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [OmniShoutmon] and [ZeigGreymon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [OmniShoutmon] and [ZeigGreymon].")
BT11-018.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [OmniShoutmon] and [ZeigGreymon] names.

BT11-018.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] effect to digivolve this card into BT11-018 [Shoutmon DX]?
BT11-018.answer:
No, you can't digivolve it.
You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements.

BT11-020.question: If the cards revealed only include either a Digimon card with [Gaogamon] in its name or a blue Tamer card, can I still add a card to my hand using this effect?
BT11-020.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with [Gaogamon] in its name or a blue Tamer card is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT11-020.question: If both a Digimon card with [Gaogamon] in its name and a blue Tamer are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand and trash the remaining card using this effect?
BT11-020.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 Digimon card [...] and 1 blue Tamer card among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT11-023.question: If the cards revealed only include either a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name or a blue Tamer card, can I still add a card to my hand using this effect?
BT11-023.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name or a blue Tamer card is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT11-023.question: This card’s effect reveals 3 cards. If both a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name and a blue Tamer are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
BT11-023.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 Digimon card [...] and 1 blue Tamer card among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT11-030.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [MetalGreymon] and [Cyberdramon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [MetalGreymon] and [Cyberdramon].")
BT11-030.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [MetalGreymon] and [Cyberdramon] names.

BT11-030.question: Can I activate this card's "If [Cyberdramon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards" effect if it has another copy of this card in its digivolution cards?

BT11-033.question: Can the [Security] effect of the card added to the hand with this card's "your opponent adds the top card of their security stack to their hand" effect be activated?
BT11-033.answer: No, since the card was not revealed by a security check, its [Security] effect can't be activated.

BT11-037.question: What happens if this Digimon is affected by an effect that forces an attack?
BT11-037.answer:
This Digimon can't attack players, so it will attack one of your opponent's Digimon.
The attack won't be performed in cases where your opponent doesn't have any Digimon that can be attack targets, such as when your opponent doesn't have any suspended Digimon.

BT11-038.question: If this card and one of my purple Digimon or Tamers are deleted at the same time, removing all my purple cards from the battle area, does this card's [On Deletion] effect activate?

BT11-040.question: Can this card's inherited effect delete an opponent's [Sukamon] to prevent itself from being deleted?

I have [Sukamon] A and [Sukamon] B with this card in their digivolution cards in the battle area. When [Sukamon] A would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] B using this card's inherited effect. On the other hand, when [Sukamon] B would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] A using this card's inherited effect. At such times, can [Sukamon] A activate this card's inherited effect again?
BT11-040.answer:
No, it can't be activated.
Until the processing for the 1st activation has resolved, only 1 activation is possible for each immediate-type effect.
In your case, until the deletion of the 1st only [Sukamon] A is resolved, only 1 activation is possible for each "when [...] would" effect, therefore the effect that has already activated for [Sukamon] A can't be activated again.

BT11-041.question: Can this card's inherited effect delete an opponent's [Sukamon] to prevent itself from being deleted?

I have [Sukamon] A and [Sukamon] B with this card in their digivolution cards in the battle area. When [Sukamon] A would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] B using this card's inherited effect. On the other hand, when [Sukamon] B would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] A using this card's inherited effect. At such times, can [Sukamon] A activate this card's inherited effect again?
BT11-041.answer:
No, it can't be activated.
Until the processing for the 1st activation has resolved, only 1 activation is possible for each immediate-type effect.
In your case, until the deletion of the 1st only [Sukamon] A is resolved, only 1 activation is possible for each "when [...] would" effect, therefore the effect that has already activated for [Sukamon] A can't be activated again.

BT11-042.question: What does "You may search your security stack" mean?
BT11-042.answer:
You may look at all the cards in your security stack without revealing them to your opponent.
Then, choose 1 card to add to your hand, reveal only that card to your opponent and add it to your hand.

BT11-043.question: This card that was targeted by [BT11-043 KingSukamon]'s effect and had its name changed to [Sukamon] is deleted. If I have no other [Palmon] in the trash, can I place this same card at the bottom of the digivolution cards of one of my green Digimon from the trash with it's [On Deletion] effect?
BT11-043.answer:
Yes, you can.
The [On Deletion] effect is activated while treated as [Sukamon], but the name changing effect is lost when the card is deleted and placed in the trash, so you can treat this card as a [Palmon] card.

BT11-043.question: Can this card's inherited effect delete an opponent's [Sukamon] to prevent itself from being deleted?

I have [Sukamon] A and [Sukamon] B with this card in their digivolution cards in the battle area. When [Sukamon] A would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] B using this card's inherited effect. On the other hand, when [Sukamon] B would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] A using this card's inherited effect. At such times, can [Sukamon] A interrupt this card's inherited effect again?
BT11-043.answer:
No, it can't interrupt it.
Until the processing for the 1st interruption has resolved, only 1 activation is possible for each "when [...] would" effect.
In your case, until the deletion of the 1st only [Sukamon] A is resolved, only 1 interruption is possible for each "when [...] would" effect, so because [Sukamon] A's effect has already interrupted, it can't interrupt again.

BT11-043.question: What does a "change 1 of your opponent's Digimon into a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]" effect do, exactly?
BT11-043.answer: This effect changes 1 of your opponent's Digimon into a Digimon whose original name is [Sukamon], its original color is white, and its original DP is 3000.

BT11-043.question: If a card such as BT15-035 [Geremon] has a (Rule) that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?
BT11-043.answer:
The card information gained from the (Rule) will also be changed.
For example, BT15-035 [Geremon]'s (Rule) gives it an original name of [Geremon/Numemon], but if its original card information is changed by this effect, its original name becomes just [Sukamon].

BT11-043.question: If a card such as EX1-005 [Tyrannomon] has an effect that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?
BT11-043.answer:
The card information gained from the effect remains as-is.
For example, if EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s original card information is changed, its original color will become white, and EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s effect will also treat it as green, making it a 2-color white and green Digimon.

BT11-043.question: If a card is changed to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, then it digivolves or its top card is trashed by <De-Digivolve> or other effect, what happens to that card's information?
BT11-043.answer: It remains as a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]. The gained effect is carried over even if the Digimon digivolves or one or more of its top cards are trashed.

BT11-043.question: What happens if a card is changed to a white card with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, then its top card is trashed by <De-Digivolve> or other effect and the top card becomes a Tamer or Digi-Egg card?
BT11-043.answer:
It remains changed to a white card with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, but any card information that it didn't originally have can't be changed.
If it becomes a Tamer or Digi-Egg card, or if it becomes a card that didn't originally have DP, then it will remain without DP.

BT11-044.question: From the cards revealed with this card's effect, can I choose cards whose total play costs add up to less than 7 on purpose?
BT11-044.answer: Yes, you can choose any number as long as the total play costs add up to 7 or less.

BT11-045.question: When an opponent's Digimon with <Security Attack+1> would check 2 security cards, can I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP" twice?
BT11-045.answer: Yes, you can. This effect is activated every time a security card is checked.

BT11-054.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "Treat this card/Digimon as if it also has [Leomon] in its name" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as having [Leomon].")
BT11-054.answer:
This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also includes the [Leomon] name.
This card can be chosen for text that specifies cards with [Leomon] in their names.
This card can't be chosen for text that specifies cards with the name [Leomon].

BT11-055.question: If I use this card’s effect when I have 2 green or black Tamer cards, do 2 of my opponent's Digimon suspend and then can't unsuspend during my opponent's next unsuspend phase?
BT11-055.answer:
No, for each green or black Tamer you have in play, this effect suspends 1 of your opponent's Digimon, but only 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon can't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase.
You can choose from your opponent's already suspended Digimon for the target Digimon in addition to the Digimon suspended by this card’s effect.

BT11-056.question: Can I intentionally choose cards with lower costs from among the cards revealed by this card’s effect so that the total play costs add up to less than 10?
BT11-056.answer: Yes, you can choose any of the cards as long as the total play costs add up to 10 or less.

BT11-056.question: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to reveal 2 cards from the top of my deck when I have a green and black 2-color Tamer?
BT11-056.answer:
No, you can't.
A 2-color Tamer still counts as 1 Tamer.

BT11-057.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to trash 3 cards in my hand even when my opponent has 2 or fewer Digimon?

BT11-059.question: Can I use this card's effect to reduce the digivolution cost by 2 when I have a green and black 2-color Tamer?
BT11-059.answer:
No, you can't.
A 2-color Tamer still counts as 1 Tamer.

BT11-061.question: If there are no [Snatchmon], [Destromon], [Galactimon], or [Fusionize] among the cards revealed by this card's effect, can I place 1 [Vemmon] under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card?
BT11-061.answer: Yes, you can place 1 [Vemmon] as a digivolution card even when none of those cards are among the revealed cards.

BT11-061.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "You can include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck" has been changed to "(Rule) You can include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck")
BT11-061.answer: This is a specific rule that allows you to include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck.

BT11-062.question: If the cards revealed only include either a Digimon card with [Greymon] or [X Antibody] in its name or a black Tamer, can I still add a card to my hand using this effect?
BT11-062.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with [Greymon] or [X Antibody] in its name or a black Tamer card is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT11-062.question: If both a Digimon card with [Greymon] or [X Antibody] in its name and a black Tamer are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck using this effect?
BT11-062.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 card [...] and 1 black Tamer card among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT11-063.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place a BT11-063 [Geremon] or BT15-035 [Geremon] from my trash in this card's digivolution cards?
BT11-063.answer:
Yes, you can.
BT11-063 [Geremon] and BT15-035 [Geremon] have a rule that also treats them as having the name [Numemon], therefore you can place them as digivolution cards under this Digimon.

BT11-063.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [Numemon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Numemon].")
BT11-063.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Numemon] name.

BT11-069.question: Does this card's "When a Digimon becomes unsuspended" inherited effect activate even when my opponent's Digimon becomes unsuspended?

BT11-071.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "This card/Digimon is also treated as [DarkKnightmon] and [Tuwarmon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [DarkKnightmon] and [Tuwarmon].")
BT11-071.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [DarkKnightmon] and [Tuwarmon] names.

BT11-072.question: If there is no [Analogman] among the cards revealed by this card's effect, can I add 1 card with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait to my hand or place it under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card?
BT11-072.answer: Yes, you can add 1 card with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait to your hand or place it under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card even when no [Analogman] is among the revealed cards.

BT11-072.question: If there's no [Machinedramon] in my hand, can I place 1 of my [Analogman] at the bottom of its owner's deck with this card's [On Deletion] effect?
If this Digimon with [BT11-072 Machinedramon] in its digivolution cards is deleted, can I activate the [On Deletion] effect this Digimon gained from [BT11-072 Machinedramon]?
BT11-072.answer:
Yes, you can activate the [On Deletion] effect.
When a Digimon is in the deletion process, it is checked for any [On Deletion] effects. Due to this card's [All Turns] effect, Chaosdramon (X Antibody) is considered to have the [On Deletion] effect of [BT11-072 Machinedramon].

BT11-074.question: An opponent's Digimon without the highest DP attacks, and by using a [When Attacking] effect to increase its DP, it becomes the Digimon with the highest DP. In such cases, can the target of the attack be switched to this Digimon with this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?
BT11-074.answer:
No, you can't.
If Digimon did not have the highest DP when the attack was declared, this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect can't be activated.

BT11-074.question: Does this card's "When a Digimon becomes unsuspended" effect activate even when my opponent's Digimon becomes unsuspended?

BT11-076.question: If a Digimon card with DigiXros requirements is played by an effect and this card is placed in the digivolution cards by a DigiXros, does this card's inherited effect activate when a Digimon card with this card in its digivolution cards is played by an effect?

BT11-077.question: When this card was played, an already activated DP-reducing effect reduced this card's DP to 0 and deleted it. In such cases, can I activate the [On Play] effect by considering the "By deleting this Digimon" condition to be fulfilled?
BT11-077.answer:
No, you can't.
If its DP is reduced to 0 and it is deleted when played, you can't activate the [On Play] effect. Also, the "By deleting this Digimon" condition is not fulfilled when this Digimon is deleted by another effect or rule.

BT11-082.question: When an effect would delete this Digimon and one of my [Yuu Amano] cards at the same time, does this card’s effect prevent my [Yuu Amano] card from being deleted?

BT11-083.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to return the trashed card from my trash to my hand if 1 [Mirei Mikagura] or 1 card with the [Angel], [Archangel], or [Fallen Angel] trait is trashed from my hand?

BT11-085.question: With this card's effect, can a blue level 3 Digimon card be played from one of my purple Digimon's digivolution cards, or a purple level 3 Digimon card be played from one of my blue Digimon's digivolution cards?

[EX3-023 Plesiomon]'s [When Digivolving] effect plays a level 4 Digimon card from digivolution cards and places this card under it as a digivolution card from the hand. At this timing, does this card's inherited effect activate?
BT11-085.answer: No, it does not. Since this card was not a digivolution card when [EX3-023 Plesiomon]'s effect played a level 4 Digimon card from digivolution cards, its inherited effect can't be activated.

BT11-086.question: Does "When you would play this card, you can also place cards from your trash in digivolution cards for a DigiXros" mean that you can place cards from your hand, batle area and trash as digivolution cards for a DigiXros?
BT11-086.answer:
Yes, that's correct.
In addition to Digimon from the hand or battle area, you may also place cards from the trash as digivolution cards for a DigiXros.

BT11-086.question: If this card is played by DigiXrosing, if there's 2 or more purple level 4 or lower Digimon cards or level 4 or lower Digimon cards with the [Xros Heart] trait, can I play only 1 instead?
BT11-086.answer:
No, you can't.
If there are 2 or more cards that can be targeted in your trash, you must either play 2 of them or none.

BT11-087.question: With this card's [On Play] effect, can I place cards under 1 of my Tamers if I didn't add cards with [Bagra Army] in one of their traits from the trash to my hand?
BT11-087.answer:

BT12-043.question: If a [Marcus Damon] Tamer isn't treated as a Digimon and doesn't have DP, does this card's [Your Turn] effect treat it as having 3000 DP and give it <Security A. +1>?
BT12-043.answer:
It won't be treated as having DP, but it will gain <Security A. +1>.
If a card doesn't have DP, it won't be treated as having DP, and DP can't be added to it.
DP can be added if a [Marcus Damon] Tamer is treated as a Digimon and has DP.

BT12-044.question: What kind of Digimon does this effect's "Digimon with <Security Attack>" refer to?
BT12-044.answer: It refers to Digimon affected by <Security Attack +> or <Security Attack -> effects.

BT12-047.question: If the 3 cards revealed by this card's effect only include a Digimon card with [Imperialdramon] in its name or the [Free] trait, or a Tamer card with [Ken Ichijoji] in its name among them, can I still add a card to my hand?
BT12-047.answer: Yes, as long as either a card with [Imperialdramon] in its name or the [Free] trait or a card with [Ken Ichijoji] in its name is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT12-047.question: If the 3 cards revealed by this card's effect include both a Digimon card with [Imperialdramon] in its name or the [Free] trait, and a Tamer card with [Ken Ichijoji] in its name among them, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand and return the others to the bottom of my deck?
BT12-047.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 card [...] and 1 card [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT12-048.question: With this card's [On Play] effect, can I reveal 3 Tamer cards from my hand but not return them to the bottom of my deck?
BT12-048.answer:
No, you can't.
The condition for this card's [On Play] effect is "By revealing up to 3 Tamer cards in your hand and placing them at the bottom of your deck in any order," and you can't perform only a part of it.
If you reveal 3 Tamer cards from your hand, you must return all of them to the bottom of your deck.

BT12-055.question: What happens to this card's [When Digivolving] effect if my opponent doesn't have any Digimon that can be attacked?
BT12-055.answer: There is no target for the attack, so the effect ends without an attack being performed.

BT12-055.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?
BT12-055.answer:
Yes, you can process it.
Even if this Digimon didn't DNA digivolve, this card's [When Digivolving] effect allows this Digimon to attack an opponent's Digimon.

BT12-056.question: What happens to this card's [When Digivolving] effect if my opponent doesn't have any Digimon that can be attacked?
BT12-056.answer: There is no target for the attack, so the effect ends without an attack being performed.

BT12-057.question: How do I count "for every 2 suspended Digimon and/or Tamers, gain 1 memory" for this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
BT12-057.answer:
Count the total number of you and your opponent's suspended Digimon and suspended Tamers, then gain 1 memory for every 2.
For example, if you have 1 suspended Digimon and 1 suspended Tamer while your opponent has 2 suspended Digimon, the total would be 4 and you gain 2 memory.

BT12-057.question: If I have 2 or more of this Digimon in the battle area, or if me and my opponent have 1 or more each, does this Digimon itself become unable to unsuspend during the unsuspend phase because of this card's [All Turns] effect?
BT12-057.answer:
Yes, that's right.
Other [BT12-057 Quartzmon]'s [Other than this Digimon, all Digimon and Tamers don't unsuspend.]'s effect will also activate, so if there's more than 1 of this Digimon in play, none of them will be able to unsuspended during the unsuspend phase.

BT12-057.question: If this Digimon is in play, and 2 suspended Digimon perform DNA Digivolve, will that Digimon unsuspend?
BT12-057.answer:
Yes, it unsuspends.
DNA Digivolve treats unsuspended Digimon because of the DNA Digivolve as new Digimon in the battle area. This card's effect does not affect it since it's not treated as a suspended Digimon becoming unsuspended

BT12-057.question: If this Digimon is in play, do other Digimon or Tamers with effects such as <Reboot> or "Unsuspend this..." become unable to unsuspend?
BT12-057.answer: Yes, that's right. Even with the "Unsuspend this..." effect, they don't unsuspend.

BT12-059.question: This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include a Digimon card with [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name or 1 Tamer card with [Tai Kamiya] in its name, can I still add a card to my hand?
BT12-059.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name or 1 Tamer card with [Tai Kamiya] in its name is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT12-059.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If both a Digimon card with [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name and a Tamer card with [Tai Kamiya] in its name are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and return the other cards to the bottom of my deck?
BT12-059.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 Digimon card [...] and 1 Tamer card [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT12-059.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If [BT5-093 Tai Kamiya & Matt Ishida], [BT9-084 Tai Kamiya & Kari Kamiya], or [P-012 Tai Kamiya (V-Tamer)] is one of the cards revealed, can I add that card to my hand?
BT12-059.answer: Yes, those are Tamer cards with [Tai Kamiya] in their names, so you can add one to your hand.

BT12-065.question: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?
BT12-065.answer:
Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.
In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.

BT12-065.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
BT12-065.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

BT12-065.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
BT12-065.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

BT12-065.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
BT12-065.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

BT12-065.question: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
Can I choose an opponent's Digimon with a "can't attack" effect as the target when I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
BT12-065.answer: Yes, you can. However, in such cases the "can't attack" effect prevents making the attack.

BT12-065.question: What happens if there are multiple "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" effects and they trigger simultaneously?
BT12-065.answer:
You activate the 1st effect from among the simultaneously triggered effects and attack.
The 2nd effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.

BT12-065.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to give "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
BT12-065.answer: You can give that effect to such Digimon, but if the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the gained effect won't trigger.

BT12-065.question: Can I choose to not digivolve with this card's 1st effect?
BT12-065.answer:
No, you can't.
For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.

BT12-066.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
If I've digivolved this card on top of a Tamer card and the Digimon is deleted, what happens to the Tamer card?
Can I choose to not digivolve with this card's 1st effect?

No, you can't.
For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.

BT12-068.question: This Digimon attacks my opponent, then my opponent blocks. Does this card's [All Turns] effect activate?
BT12-068.answer: Yes, blocking causes the attack target to switch, so the effect activates.

BT12-072.question: "This Digimon has [EX3-013 Chaosdramon] in its digivolution cards. and then an effect attempts to delete it. Is it possible to first activate this card's ""When this Digimon would be deleted, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack"" effect, trashing a security card from the opponent's security stack, and then activate [EX3-13 Chaosdramon]'s ""you may trash 2 level 5 cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards to prevent it from leaving play"" effect and prevent the deletion?"

When this card digivolves from [EX3-013 Chaosdramon], it gains all of the effects of the [Chaosdramon] in its digivolution cards. Does that mean [EX3-013 Chaosdramon]'s [On Play][When Digivolving] effect activates?
BT12-072.answer:
Yes, it activates.
This card's ""This Digimon gains all effects of [Machinedramon] and [Chaosdramon] cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards"" effect is an [All Turns] effect, so it is active as soon as the digivolution is confirmed. Therefore, the [When Digivolving] effect is gained and triggered.

BT12-072.question: If this Digimon with [BT11-072 Machinedramon] in its digivolution cards is deleted, can I activate the [On Deletion] effect this Digimon gained from [BT11-072 Machinedramon]?
BT12-072.answer:
Yes, you can activate the [On Deletion] effect.
When a Digimon is in the deletion process, it is checked for any [On Deletion] effects. Due to this card's [All Turns] effect, Chaosdramon (X Antibody) is considered to have the [On Deletion] effect of [BT11-072 Machinedramon].

BT12-078.question: Can I activate "Trash the top 2 cards of your deck." of this card's [When Digivolving] effect if [Wizardmon] or [X Antibody] are in its digivolution cards when digivolving into this card ?
BT12-078.answer:
No, you can't.
If [Wizardmon] or [X Antibody] are in the digivolution cards, this Digimon gains <Blocker> instead. You can't activate ""Trash the top 2 cards of your deck"".

BT12-083.question: What does this card's [When Digivolving] effect do, exactly?
BT12-083.answer:
You choose 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower Digimon and place it under another of your opponent's Digimon as its bottom digivolution card or under an opponent's Tamer.
For each Tamer you have in play with a different color, you add 1 to the maximum level you can choose with this effect.
If you have a multicolor Tamer, you reference its colors that are different from your other Tamers and count it as 1 Tamer with a different color. For example, if you have a red Tamer, a red/blue Tamer, and a blue/yellow Tamer, you would refer to the red, blue, and yellow colors, then add +3 to the maximum level you can choose.

BT12-083.question: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to place a card under a Tamer that already has cards under it, in what order do I place the cards?
BT12-083.answer: If there are already any cards stacked under the Tamer, you place the new card at the bottom.

BT12-083.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to place 1 of my opponent's Digimon under another of their Digimon, one that isn't affected by effects?

If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to place an opponent's Digimon under my opponent's other Digimon as its bottom digivolution card, will the Digimon to be placed in digivolution cards leave the battle area?
BT12-083.answer:
Yes, it will leave the battle area.
The digivolution cards of the Digimon to be placed in digivolution cards will be trashed at the same time.

BT12-083.question: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to place an opponent's Digimon under one of their Tamers, does that Tamer gain the placed card's inherited effect?
BT12-083.answer:
No, it doesn't.
A Digimon will gain an inherited effect, but a Tamer doesn't gain it.

BT12-083.question: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to place an opponent's BT12-038 [GeoGreymon] from the battle area as the bottom digivolution card of their BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] that's treated as a Digimon, does that BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] gain BT12-038 [GeoGreymon]'s inherited effect?
BT12-083.answer:
Yes, it gains the inherited effect.
If BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] suspends, BT12-038 [GeoGreymon]'s inherited effect will trigger. However, as soon as it is no longer treated as a Digimon, it will lose inherited effects.

BT12-083.question: If I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to attack, can this card attack even if it's suspended?

BT12-084.question: "I activated this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect and all of my Digimon gained <Blocker> and can't be returned to hands or decks. If [Sparrowmon] is then trashed from this card's digivolution cards, what happens to the effects that my Digimon gained?"
BT12-084.answer: The effect has already activated, so even without [Sparrowmon] in the digivolution cards, the effect will continue until the end of your opponent's turn.

BT12-088.question: A Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards attacked the player while it had 10000 DP, then a security check was performed. If the [Security] effect on the flipped card reduces the DP to 9000 or less, do I still activate this card's "gain 2 memory" inherited effect?
BT12-088.answer: No. If the DP is not 10000 or more when the effect activates, you can't gain 2 memory.

BT12-088.question: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
BT12-088.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation.
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation.
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

BT12-088.question: A Digimon with this card as a digivolution card attacks a player and is deleted in battle against a Security Digimon. At that moment, can I activate this card's inherited effect to gain 2 memory?
BT12-088.answer: Yes, this card's inherited effect is triggered after [Security] effects but before battling against the Security Digimon.

BT12-089.question: After I activate this card's [Main] effect and place [Growlmon] and [WarGrowlmon] in my [Guilmon]'s digivolution cards. Can I choose to not digivolve it into [Gallantmon] in my hand?
BT12-089.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, the cards placed in [Guilmon]'s digivolution cards stay there.

BT12-089.question: Can I digivolve one of my [Guilmon] to a [Gallantmon] in my hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon other than this card's is activated?
Can I activate BT12-089 [Takato Matsuki]'s [Main] effect and digivolve a [Hero] trait Guilmon into this card for a digivolution cost of 3?
BT12-089.answer:
Yes, it can digivolve for a digivolution cost of 3.
If you reference this card's 3rd digivolution requirement to digivolve, ignoring level, the digivolution cost will be 3.

BT12-090.question: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect when I attack with a 2-color green/blue (in that specific order) Digimon or with a Digimon that is blue and green because of an effect?
Can I also activate this card's [Your Turn] effect when my 3-color Digimon with blue and green attacks?
BT12-090.answer:
No, you can't.
Since this card's effect specifies "one of your 2-color blue and green Digimon", you can't activate this card's [Your Turn] effect if your Digimon has 3 or more colors, even if those colors include blue and green.

BT12-092.question: What does an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect do, exactly?
BT12-092.answer:
It causes that card to also be treated as a Digimon with X000 DP.
For example, if a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon, it can attack like a standard Digimon, and it will gain inherited effects from cards stacked under it.
However, even if a Tamer is played and then treated as a Digimon in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn.

BT12-092.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, is it no longer considered a Tamer?
BT12-092.answer: No, it is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer.

BT12-092.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect and it activates an effect, is it treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect?
BT12-092.answer:
Yes, it's treated as an effect of both.
Because the card is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the activated effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect.

BT12-092.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
BT12-092.answer: Yes, it's deleted upon the rule check timing.

BT12-092.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?
BT12-092.answer:
If an effect has triggered and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the play cost, level, and DP are overwritten by the newer effect.
However, if an effect has already activated and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the already activated effect will be overwritten.
Any other effects such as <Rush> that are later gained will be added.

BT12-092.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
BT12-092.answer:
Yes, you can.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

BT12-092.question: If an opponent's card has "isn't affected by Digimon effects" and it's chosen for an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" Tamer effect that treats it as a Digimon, will the chosen opponent Digimon be affected by effects?
BT12-092.answer:
No, it won't be affected by effects.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore the chosen opponent Digimon won't be affected by effects.

BT12-098.question: This card’s [On Play] effect reveals 3 cards. If the cards revealed only include a Digimon card with <Save> in its text or a card with the [Hunter] trait, can I still add a card to my hand?
BT12-098.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with <Save> in its text or a card with the [Hunter] trait is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT12-098.question: This card’s [On Play] effect reveals 3 cards. If both a Digimon card with <Save> in its text and a card with the [Hunter] trait are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining card at the bottom of my deck?
BT12-098.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 Digimon card [...] and 1 card [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT12-099.question: Does this card's [Main] effect let me attack with a suspended Digimon or with a Digimon that was played that turn?
BT12-099.answer:
No, it doesn't.
This card's effect doesn't let you attack with a Digimon that's in a state where it can't attack.

BT12-102.question: When I use this card's effect to place a blue Digimon as the bottom digivolution card of another Digimon, what happens to that Digimon's digivolution cards?
When I use this card's effect to place a blue Digimon as the bottom digivolution card of another Digimon, what happens if that Digimon has [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards?
BT12-102.answer: It's not being trashed by the effect, it's being trashed because of the rules, so [BT9-109 X Antibody] does still get trashed.

BT12-104.question: If I have a 2-color yellow/red Tamer, can I count it as 2 Tamers for this card's [Main] effect?
If I have 2 yellow or red Tamers, does this card's [Main] effect give 6 of my opponent's Digimon -2000 DP for the turn or 3 of my opponent's Digimon -4000 DP for the turn?
BT12-104.answer:
3 of your opponent's Digimon get -4000 DP.
This card's effect only targets 3 of your opponent's Digimon.

BT12-105.question: If my Digimon attacks my opponent who has 1 security card, and I've used this card so its [Main] effect has given an opponent's Digimon the [On Deletion] effect, then delete that Digimon with a [When Attacking] effect, do I win the game by trashing the security card before the check and making it so I am attacking an opponent with 0 security cards?
BT12-105.answer: Yes, in such cases you win the game.

BT12-106.question: My opponent played a suspended Digimon by an effect after I activated this card's [Main] effect. Does my opponent's Digimon unsuspend in my opponent's next unsuspend phase?
BT12-106.answer:

This card reads "Your opponent's cards don't unsuspend during their next unsuspend phase," and this also affects cards that were later played or moved to the battle area.

BT12-107.question: Can I choose an opponent's Digimon with a "can't attack" effect as the target when I activate this card's [Main] effect?

BT12-107.question: What happens if there are multiple "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" effects and they trigger simultaneously?
BT12-107.answer:
You activate the 1st effect from among the simultaneously triggered effects and attack.
The 2nd effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.

BT12-107.question: What happens if this card's effect is activated on an opponent's Digimon with an "[Opponent’s Turn] This Digimon isn't affected by your opponent’s effects" effect?
BT12-107.answer:
You can still choose a "this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent’s effects" Digimon as a target for the effect. As soon as it becomes your opponent's turn, that opposing Digimon loses the "this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent’s effects" effect and is affected by this card's effect.
As a result, the attack occurs at the start of the main phase.

BT12-110.question: When exactly is the timing for "[Trash] [Your Turn]"?
BT12-110.answer:
When this card is in your trash, the effect can activate when one of your Digimon digivolves into [Beelzemon (X Antibody)].
[Trash] means that the card needs to be in your trash for the effect to activate.

BT12-110.question: What happens to the color requirements and cost when I activate this card's [Trash] effect?
BT12-110.answer: When activating the effect from your trash, it's not considered to be using an Option card, so there are no color requirements and no cost to be paid.

BT12-110.question: Are "when using an Option card" effects triggered if I activate this card's [Trash] effect?
BT12-110.answer: No. Activating an effect from your trash isn't considered to be using an Option card, so they don't trigger.

BT12-110.question: What is a {Trash} effect?
BT12-110.answer:
A {Trash} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the trash.
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the trash.

BT12-110.question: When one of my Digimon digivolves into [Beelzemon (X Antibody)], in what order can I activate this card's {Trash} [Your Turn] effect and the effects that trigger upon digivolution into that Digimon?
BT12-110.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

BT12-112.question: When playing this card, can the [Shoutmon] I place in its digivolution cards for its effect come from my hand, breeding area, or trash?
BT12-112.answer:
No, it can't.
The effect only allows you to place a [Shoutmon] from the battle area in its digivolution cards.

BT12-112.question: When I activate the "When this card would be played" effect and place [Shoutmon] in this card's digivolution cards, what happens to [Shoutmon]'s digivolution cards?
When this card's effect places [Shoutmon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards, what happens if [Shoutmon] has [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards?
BT12-112.answer: It's not being trashed by the effect, it's being trashed because of the rules, so [BT9-109 X Antibody] does still get trashed.

BT12-112.question: When I activate the "When this card would be played" effect and place [Shoutmon] in this card's digivolution cards, can I first place cards for DigiXros and only then place [Shoutmon]?
BT12-112.answer:
No, you can't.
DigiXros is performed after all ""would be played"" effects have activated. Therefore, you must first place [Shoutmon] in its digivolution cards for the effect and then place cards under the [Shoutmon] digivolution card for the DigiXros.

BT12-112.question: [Shoutmon]'s digivolution cards are trashed when I place it in this Digimon's digivolution cards for the "When this card would be played" effect. Can I DigiXros with those trashed cards and place them in this Digimon's digivolution cards?
What does "∞ Digimon cards w/[Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait & different card numbers" in this card's DigiXros requirements mean?
BT12-112.answer: It means that you can DigiXros with as many cards as you like, as long as all the cards have the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait and different card numbers.

BT12-112.question: This card's DigiXros requirements say "∞ Digimon cards," but is it still considered DigiXros if I place 0 cards?
BT12-112.answer: No, it's not DigiXros if you don't place any cards.

BT12-112.question: If I place [Shoutmon] as a digivolution card for this card's "When you would play this card" effect, can I place another card with the same number as that [Shoutmon] as a digivolution card under this Digimon for this card's DigiXros?
BT12-112.answer:
Yes, you can.
A [Shoutmon] placed as a digivolution card for this card's ""When you would play this card"" effect is not treated as placed by the DigiXros, so it is not included in this card's ""different card numbers"" DigiXros condition.

BT12-112.question: Does "if this effect returned level 7 white cards" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect mean that it will activate even if I return a card such as BT12-112 [Shoutmon X7: Superior Mode] that has 2 or more colors including white?

BT13-006.question: Can I use this card's [On Deletion] inherited effect to trash 1 card in my hand even if my opponent has no level 3 Digimon when the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards is deleted?
BT13-006.answer: Yes, you can. You can't delete an opponent's Digimon, but you can trash a card in your hand.

BT13-007.question: Does this card's [Breeding] [Your Turn] effect also prevent my Digimon from DNA digivolving or burst digivolving?
BT13-007.answer: That's correct, such digivolutions are also not possible.

BT13-007.question: Does this card's 1st [Breeding] [Your Turn] effect allow my Tamers to digivolve using a "you may digivolve as if your Tamer is a level 3 Digimon" effect?

What does "further reduce it by 1 for each of this Digimon's digivolution cards" in this card's 2nd [Breeding] [Your Turn] effect mean, exactly?
BT13-007.answer:
This effect additionally increases the numerical value of the play cost reduction in "when a [Royal Knight] trait Digimon card would be played, you may reduce the play cost by 4" in this card's 2nd [Breeding] [Your Turn] effect.
For example, if this Digimon has 1 digivolution card, the numerical value of the play cost reduction will be 5.

BT13-007.question: Can I choose to not reveal the top card of my Digi-Egg deck and not place my [Royal Knight] trait Digimon as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards for this card's [Breeding] [Start of Your Main Phase]?
BT13-007.answer: No, you must perform as much of the processing as possible.

BT13-007.question: If multiple cards are placed as the bottom digivolution cards for this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect, what order are the cards placed?
BT13-007.answer:
The player that activated the effect chooses the order of the bottom digivolution cards that are placed.
Note that the cards placed by this effect must be placed under any already placed digivolution cards.

BT13-007.question: When I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to place a BT17-078 [Omnimon ACE] under this card as a digivolution card, is BT17-078 [Omnimon ACE] processed?
BT13-007.answer:
No, it isn't processed.
<Overflow> is processed when a card is sent from the area or from under a card to another area.
In this case, <Overflow> isn't processed because a card from the area is placed under another card.

BT13-007.question: If I have a Digimon card with the [Royal Knight] trait in my hand, do I have to place it under my [Yggdrasill_7D6] in the breeding area as its bottom digivolution card for this card's [On Deletion] effect?
BT13-007.answer: No. The cards in your hand count as private information, so you don't have to place that card.

BT13-007.question: I used this card's [On Play] effect to trash a BT13-007 [King Drasil_7D6] with a BT17-078 [Omnimon ACE] in its digivolution cards. Is BT17-078 [Omnimon ACE]'s <Overflow> processed at such times?
BT13-007.answer:
Yes, it's processed.
<Overflow> is processed when a card is sent from the area or from under a card to another area.
In this case, <Overflow> is processed because a card is placed in the trash from under another card.

BT13-007.answer: It can't move level 2 Digimon or cards like [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] because cards without DP can't be moved to the battle area. It can move [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] because it has DP.

BT13-008.question: What does an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect do, exactly?
BT13-008.answer:
It causes that card to also be treated as a Digimon with X000 DP.
For example, if a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon, it can attack like a standard Digimon, and it will gain inherited effects from cards stacked under it.
However, even if a Tamer is played and then treated as a Digimon in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn.

BT13-008.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, is it no longer considered a Tamer?
BT13-008.answer: No, it is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer.

BT13-008.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect and it activates an effect, is it treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect?
BT13-008.answer:
Yes, it's treated as an effect of both.
Because the card is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the activated effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect.

BT13-008.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
BT13-008.answer: Yes, it's deleted upon the rule check timing.

BT13-008.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?
BT13-008.answer:
If an effect has triggered and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the play cost, level, and DP are overwritten by the newer effect.
However, if an effect has already activated and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the already activated effect will be overwritten.
Any other effects such as <Rush> that are later gained will be added.

BT13-008.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
BT13-008.answer:
Yes, you can.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

BT13-008.question: If an opponent's card has "isn't affected by Digimon effects" and it's chosen for an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" Tamer effect that treats it as a Digimon, will the chosen opponent Digimon be affected by effects?
BT13-008.answer:
No, it won't be affected by effects.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore the chosen opponent Digimon won't be affected by effects.

BT13-012.answer: <Security +1 (Deck)> doesn't occur. Shuffle your security stack, and the effect ends.

BT13-033.question: Which player chooses the cards in my opponent's hand to return to the deck with this card's [When Attacking] effect?
BT13-033.answer: The player that activated this card's effect. The player chooses the cards in their opponent's hand until there are only 8 left and the order they are returned to the deck before returning them to the bottom of the deck.

BT13-065.question: Can this card's inherited effect delete an opponent's [Sukamon] to prevent itself from being deleted?
