No, you can't.
This card's [All Turns] effect is triggered when one of your Digimon with [Chessmon] in its name is deleted, therefore it won't trigger if such a Digimon isn't deleted.

BT13-075.question: When my opponent activated this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect, my Digimon with a play cost of 9 or less digivolved in my next turn and became a Digimon with a play cost of 10 or more. Can I attack with this Digimon?

A Digimon with a play cost of 9 or less attacked a player, digivolved using a [When Attacking] effect, and became a Digimon with a play cost of 10 or more in a state where this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect was activated for my opponent. What happens to the attack in such cases?
BT13-075.answer: The attack has already been declared, so the attack will continue.

BT13-076.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect also trigger when one of my opponent's Digimon with [Etemon] or [Sukamon] in its name is deleted?

BT13-077.question: If this Digimon attacks when this card's [On Play][When Attacking] effect prevents it from being affected by the effects of my opponent's Digimon, can it be blocked by my opponent's Digimon?
BT13-077.answer:
Yes, it can be blocked.
<Blocker> is an effect that allows for the Digimon to block, so it isn't affected by ""isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon"" effects.

BT13-077.question: Do I have to choose an opponent's Digimon and have my opponent attack for this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect?
BT13-077.answer:
No. The effect reads ""You may choose,"" so you don't have to choose a Digimon.
In such cases, the attack doesn't occur.

BT13-077.question: Do I have to choose an opponent's Digimon for this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect?
BT13-077.answer: No, you don't have to choose an opponent's Digimon.

BT13-077.question: If I choose an opponent's Digimon that can't attack for this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect, does my opponent attack with that Digimon?
BT13-077.answer: No, they can't attack using a Digimon that can't attack.

BT13-077.question: An opponent's Digimon is attacking using an effect at the end of their turn. If I choose an opponent's Digimon for this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect, does my opponent attack with that Digimon?
BT13-077.answer:
No, your opponent can't attack using that Digimon. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack.
In such cases, even if you choose an opponent's Digimon for this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect when there is already an attacking Digimon, your opponent can't attack with the chosen Digimon.

BT13-077.question: Can I choose a Digimon that isn't affected by effects for this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect and have it attack?
BT13-077.answer:
Yes, you can choose a Digimon that isn't affected by effects for this and have it attack.
Such Digimon aren't affected by effects, but they can be chosen.
In addition, "your opponent attacks with the chosen Digimon" in this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect affects a player, therefore your opponent must attack with the chosen Digimon if it can attack.

BT13-079.question: Do I or my opponent choose the card to be trashed from their hand when I activate this card's inherited effect?
Does this card’s inherited effect activate when the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is deleted by <Retaliation> on a battled opponent's Digimon?
BT13-079.answer: Yes. It activates because the Digimon is deleted by the <Retaliation> effect, not by battle.

BT13-080.question: This Digimon can't Digivolve, but can it be placed in another Digimon's digivolution cards by a card effect?
BT13-080.answer: Yes it can. Placing a card in digivolution cards isn't digivolution.

BT13-080.question: Can I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to return this card itself from my trash to the bottom of my deck?

When I only have 2 cards with [Gizmon] in their names including this card in my trash, can I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to return those 2 cards to the bottom of my deck but not play [Gizmon: AT] from my trash?

BT13-082.question: Do I or my opponent choose the card to be trashed from their hand when I activate this card's inherited effect?
Does this card’s inherited effect activate when the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is deleted by <Retaliation> on a battled opponent's Digimon?
BT13-082.answer: Yes. It activates because the Digimon is deleted by the <Retaliation> effect, not by battle.

BT13-083.question: This Digimon can't Digivolve, but can it be placed in another Digimon's digivolution cards by a card effect?
BT13-083.answer: Yes it can. Placing a card in digivolution cards isn't digivolution.

BT13-083.question: Can I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to return this card itself from my trash to the bottom of my deck?

When I only have 2 cards with [Gizmon] in their names including this card in my trash, can I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to return those 2 cards to the bottom of my deck but not play [Gizmon: XT] from my trash?

BT13-085.question: Does this card’s inherited effect activate when the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is deleted by <Retaliation> on a battled opponent's Digimon?
BT13-085.answer: Yes. It activates because the Digimon is deleted by the <Retaliation> effect, not by battle.

BT13-087.question: Do I have to choose 2 cards with [Lucemon] in their names or 2 cards with the [Royal Knight] trait among the revealed cards to add to my hand for this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect?
BT13-087.answer: No, the 2 cards you add to your hand are cards that fulfill either of the conditions: a card with [Lucemon] in its name or a card with the [Royal Knight] trait. Therefore, in addition to the combinations from your question, you can also add 1 card with [Lucemon] in its name and 1 card with the [Royal Knight] trait to your hand.

BT13-087.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to add a card to my hand when only 1 card with [Lucemon] in its name or the [Royal Knight] trait is among the 5 revealed cards?
BT13-087.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT13-089.question: At what timing do I play [Ravemon] from my trash at the end of my opponent's turn for this card's effect?
BT13-089.answer: The effect triggers simultaneously with your opponent's [End of Your Turn] effects, therefore your opponent's [End of Your Turn] effects and any derived effects will activate first because your opponent is the turn player.

BT13-089.question: This card Burst Digivolved into [BT13-092 Ravemon: Burst Mode]. At the end of my turn, the [BT13-092 Ravemon: Burst Mode] that was placed for the Burst Digivolve is trashed, but then can I activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?
BT13-089.answer:
No, you can't.
At the end of your turn, [BT13-092 Ravemon: Burst Mode] is still placed, so this card's [End of Your Turn] effect isn't triggered.

BT13-092.question: This card Burst Digivolved into [BT13-092 Ravemon: Burst Mode]. At the end of my turn, the [BT13-092 Ravemon: Burst Mode] that was placed for the Burst Digivolve is trashed, but then can I activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?
BT13-092.answer:
No, you can't.
At the end of your turn, [BT13-092 Ravemon: Burst Mode] is still placed, so this card's [End of Your Turn] effect isn't triggered.

BT13-092.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to look at the card that my opponent adds to their hand from their security stack?
BT13-092.answer:
No, you can't.
This card’s [When Digivolving] effect can only be used to search your opponent's hand for the card you choose to trash from their hand.

BT13-092.question: If I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to return my opponent's [Greymon] to the bottom of their deck from their trash, can I delete my opponent's cards such as [MetalGreymon] and [WarGreymon]?
BT13-092.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's [When Attacking] effect reads ""your opponent's Digimon that share a name with the returned card,"" therefore if you return your opponent's [Greymon] to their deck, you can only delete your opponent's Digimon with the [Greymon] name.

BT13-092.question: If I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to return my opponent's card with "This card/Digimon is also treated as [XX]" to the bottom of their deck from their trash, can I delete both my opponent's Digimon with the same name as that card and my opponent's Digimon with the [XX] name?
If the card that my opponent adds to their hand from their security stack by this card's [When Digivolving] effect has a [Security] effect, does that effect activate?
BT13-092.answer: No, since the card was not revealed by a security check, its [Security] effect can't be activated.

BT13-093.question: If I have a Digimon card with the [Royal Knight] trait in my hand, do I have to place it under my [Yggdrasill_7D6] in the breeding area as its bottom digivolution card for this card's [On Deletion] effect?
BT13-093.answer: No. The cards in your hand count as private information, so you don't have to place that card.

BT13-095.question: If I have [Agumon] or [Greymon] but my opponent has no Digimon when this Tamer becomes suspended, can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to gain 1 memory without 1 of my opponent's Digimon getting -3000 DP?

BT13-096.question: When I played a blue Digimon, its DP became 0 by an opponent's effect that had already activated, so the Digimon was deleted at the same time it was played. Does this Tamer's [All Turns] effect still trigger in such cases?

BT13-097.question: Do I have to draw 1 card from my deck when my opponent activates this Tamer card's [Your Turn] effect?
BT13-097.answer: Yes, you must draw 1 card from your deck if possible.

BT13-098.question: Can I activate the "when an effect trashes this card from the security stack" effect when this card is revealed from the security stack or when searching/looking at this card from the security stack?
BT13-098.answer: No, you can't. You can only activate the "when an effect trashes this card from the security stack" when this card is directly trashed from the security stack.

BT13-098.question: What does "if there're X or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks" mean, exactly?
BT13-098.answer:
It refers to when the total number of cards in both you and your opponent's security stacks is X or fewer.
The text "if there're 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks" would include when there're 3 cards in both players' security stacks, 2 cards in your security stack and 4 cards in your opponent's security stack, etc.

BT13-099.question: What does an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect do, exactly?
BT13-099.answer:
It causes that card to also be treated as a Digimon with X000 DP.
For example, if a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon, it can attack like a standard Digimon, and it will gain inherited effects from cards stacked under it.
However, even if a Tamer is played and then treated as a Digimon in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn.

BT13-099.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, is it no longer considered a Tamer?
BT13-099.answer: No, it is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer.

BT13-099.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect and it activates an effect, is it treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect?
BT13-099.answer:
Yes, it's treated as an effect of both.
Because the card is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the activated effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect.

BT13-099.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
BT13-099.answer: Yes, it's deleted upon the rule check timing.

BT13-099.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?
BT13-099.answer:
If an effect has triggered and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the play cost, level, and DP are overwritten by the newer effect.
However, if an effect has already activated and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the already activated effect will be overwritten.
Any other effects such as <Rush> that are later gained will be added.

BT13-099.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
BT13-099.answer:
Yes, you can.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

BT13-099.question: If an opponent's card has "isn't affected by Digimon effects" and it's chosen for an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" Tamer effect that treats it as a Digimon, will the chosen opponent Digimon be affected by effects?
BT13-099.answer:
No, it won't be affected by effects.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore the chosen opponent Digimon won't be affected by effects.

BT13-101.question: Can I also activate this card's [All Turns] effect when I play a 2-color yellow and black Digimon?
BT13-101.answer: Yes. The order of the colors doesn't matter, so the effect will activate for either yellow and black or black and yellow.

BT13-101.question: When I played a 2-color black and yellow Digimon, its DP became 0 by an opponent's effect that had already activated, so the Digimon was deleted at the same time it was played. Does this Tamer's [All Turns] effect still trigger in such cases?

BT13-102.question: Which player gains 1 memory and <Draw 1> from this card’s [On Play] effect?
BT13-102.answer:
The player that activated this card's effect.
This card's effect gives you 1 memory and <Draw 1> if the opponent player doesn't trash 1 Tamer card or Option card from their hand.

BT13-102.question: Does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate when either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon is played by an effect?
Does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate when a Digimon is played by a DigiXros?
BT13-102.answer:
No. DigiXros itself is not an effect, so the effect doesn't activate for a card played by a DigiXros as a main phase action.
The effect will activate if a DigiXros is performed when a Digimon is played by an effect.

BT13-105.question: Which player gains memory from this card's effect?
BT13-105.answer: The player that uses this card gains memory.

BT13-106.question: Can I activate the "when an effect trashes this card from the security stack" effect when this card is revealed from the security stack or when searching/looking at this card from the security stack?
BT13-106.answer: No, you can't. You can only activate the "when an effect trashes this card from the security stack" when this card is directly trashed from the security stack.

BT13-106.question: What does "if there're X or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks" mean, exactly?
BT13-106.answer:
It refers to when the total number of cards in both you and your opponent's security stacks is X or fewer.
The text "if there're 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks" would include when there're 3 cards in both players' security stacks, 2 cards in your security stack and 4 cards in your opponent's security stack, etc.

BT13-106.question: This card's effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0. At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of zero deleted?
BT13-106.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet.
Once all of the processing for the activated effect has resolved, a rule check will occur, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.

BT13-107.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my [Leopardmon: Leopard Mode] without digivolution cards to my hand and unsuspend all of my Digimon?
BT13-107.answer: No. A card doesn't have cards stacked under it if it doesn't have digivolution cards, therefore you can't use this card's effect to return the card to your hand, and the effect that unsuspends all of your Digimon doesn't activate, either.

BT13-107.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my [Leopardmon: Leopard Mode] with only a level 2 Digi-Egg card in its digivolution cards to my hand and unsuspend all of my Digimon?
BT13-107.answer:
Yes, you can.
However, a level 2 Digimon doesn't have DP, so it will be trashed by the rules after effect activation.

BT13-108.question: My Digimon is affected by this card's "This Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards" effect. Is it affected by the [Security] effect of my opponent's Option cards?
BT13-108.answer: No, it isn't affected by [Security] effects, either.

BT13-108.question: Can "isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards" effects prevent the "When this Digimon is suspended, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost less than or equal to this Digimon" effect given to an opponent's Digimon by this card?
BT13-108.answer:
No, they can't.
The "When this Digimon is suspended, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost less than or equal to this Digimon" effect from this card is a Digimon effect. It isn't considered to be an Option card effect.

BT13-109.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve any 1 of my Digimon into a [Belphemon: Sleep Mode] from my trash without paying the cost?
BT13-109.answer: No. You can't ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve a Digimon that meets the digivolution requirements or special digivolution requirements into [Belphemon: Sleep Mode] from your trash.

BT13-111.question: Does "for every 5 cards in both players' trash" mean for every 5 cards in either mine or my opponent's trash?
BT13-111.answer:
No, it means every 5 cards in yours and your opponent's trashes combined.
For example, if you have 12 cards in your trash and your opponent has 8 cards in theirs, that makes a total of 20 cards, so the play cost is reduced by 8.

BT13-111.question: When an "Add 1000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" effect has activated, does this card's [On Play][When Digivolving][When Attacking] effect become "Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 7000 DP or less. If no Digimon was deleted by this effect, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 14000 DP or more"?
BT13-111.answer: No. "Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less" becomes "Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 7000 DP or less," but 13000 DP isn't the maximum for "delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 13000 DP or more," therefore it isn't affected and remains as "delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 13000 DP or more."

BT13-112.question: Does "you may play 1 of each Digimon with the [Royal Knight] trait and a different name from the digivolution cards of Digimon in the breeding area without paying the costs" in this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect mean that I can play a Digimon card with the [Royal Knight] trait without the name [Omnimon]?
BT13-112.answer:
No, this effect plays 1 of each Digimon with the [Royal Knight] trait and different names from among the digivolution cards.
For example, if the target digivolution cards are [Omnimon], [Alphamon], [Alphamon], [Gallantmon], and [Gallantmon (X Antibody)], you would leave 1 [Alphamon] since it has the same name, then play[Omnimon], [Alphamon], [Gallantmon], and [Gallantmon (X Antibody)].
Note that the [Omnimon] where this effect activated isn't a digivolution card, therefore you can use this effect to play 1 [Omnimon] from among the target cards.

BT13-112.question: When I use this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect to play Digimon, can I choose just the cards I want to play from among the cards I can play?
BT13-112.answer:
No, you can't.
You must play all of the Digimon that you can play or play no Digimon.

BT13-112.question: This card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect reads "trash your Digimon in the breeding area" for when a Digimon is played by this effect, but what happens to the remaining digivolution cards under this Digimon?
BT13-112.answer: The digivolution cards are also trashed.

BT13-112.question: I used this card's [On Play] effect to trash a BT13-007 [King Drasil_7D6] with a BT17-078 [Omnimon ACE] in its digivolution cards. Is BT17-078 [Omnimon ACE]'s <Overflow> processed at such times?
BT13-112.answer:
Yes, it's processed.
<Overflow> is processed when a card is sent from the area or from under a card to another area.
In this case, <Overflow> is processed because a card is placed in the trash from under another card.

BT14-002.question: Is a "while your opponent has no Digimon with XX" condition also met when my opponent has no Digimon?

BT14-006.question: Can this card's inherited effect digivolve a Digimon in the breeding area into a Digimon with the [Dark Animal] or [SoC] trait that was trashed from my hand?
BT14-006.answer:
No, it can’t.
Digimon in the breeding area are not included in the target of this effect.

BT14-006.question: When a Digimon card with the [Dark Animal] or [SoC] trait is trashed from my hand, can I use this card's inherited effect to digivolve into that card regardless of its digivolution requirements?
BT14-006.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

BT14-006.question: Can I use this card's inherited effect to digivolve without paying the digivolution cost?
BT14-006.answer: No, you must pay the digivolution cost.

BT14-007.question: When I use this card's effect to digivolve into [Greymon] in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
BT14-007.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

BT14-009.question: Does this card's effect allow activation of effects that reduce play costs when Digimon are played other than by an effect?
Can players play Digimon into the breeding area by effects while this card is in the battle area?

BT14-013.question: When digivolving into a Digimon that meets the requirements and then digivolving into another Digimon that meets the requirements in the same turn, can this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] reduce the digivolution cost by 1 again?
BT14-013.answer: Yes, the digivolution cost is reduced by 1. This effect continues until the end of the turn, therefore the digivolution cost will be reduced by 1 for every digivolution that occurs during that time and meets the requirements.

BT14-013.question: Can I use this card's inherited effect to attack using a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards even when it's suspended?
BT14-013.answer: No, you can't. This card's inherited effect does not allow you to attack with Digimon that are in a state where they can't attack.

BT14-013.question: At the end of my turn, I used this inherited effect to attack, then an effect changed my memory to 0 or more and my turn continued. After that, if a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards digivolved and the end of my turn came again while it was unsuspended, can I use this inherited effect to attack again?
BT14-013.answer: No, you can't. Because the turn didn't switch the first time the turn ended, the [Once Per Turn] restriction still applies. In addition, the [Once Per Turn] restriction doesn't reset even for digivolutions. Therefore, you can't use this card's inherited effect to attack twice.

BT14-013.question: When I have 2 Digimon with this card in their digivolution cards, can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to attack using these 2 Digimon?
BT14-013.answer: No, you can't. At the end of your turn, the inherited effects on these cards activate, the activation order is decided, and then the attack occurs for the 1st Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards. After activation of effects that are triggered upon attack declaration such as [When Attacking] effects and "when one of your Digimon attacks" effects but before the counter timing, the next activation would occur for the other inherited effect that was pending activation, but because the 1st Digimon is still attacking, you can't make a new attack declaration, and the 2nd activation fails.

BT14-017.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect prevent me from playing a Digimon card with 6000 DP or less when my opponent has this Digimon while I have 1 or more memory?
BT14-017.answer: Yes, it can't be played. If your opponent has this Digimon, "While your opponent has 1 or more memory" from your opponent's perspective means while you have 1 or more memory.

BT14-017.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect prevent playing a Digimon card with 6000 DP or less even from effects that play a card?
Does this card's [All Turns] effect also prevent playing a token that is treated as a Digimon card with 6000 DP or less?

If I have a Digimon card with an original DP of 6000 or less and its DP would increase to more than 6000 by an effect upon playing it into the battle area, does this card's [All Turns] effect allow that card to be played?

Does this card's [All Turns] effect allow me to play a Digimon card with 6000 DP or less if paying the play cost would cause the memory to change to 0 or 1 or more on my opponent's side when my opponent has this Digimon?
BT14-017.answer: No, it can't be played. At the timing of the play declaration, if "While your opponent has 1 or more memory" from your opponent's perspective applies (in other words, if you have 1 or more memory), this card's [All Turns] effect doesn't allow you to play such Digimon.

BT14-017.question: When my opponent has this Digimon, does this card's [All Turns] effect allow me to just pay the play cost for a Digimon card with 6000 DP or less without playing it while I have 1 memory or more?
BT14-017.answer: No, it doesn't. You aren't allowed to declare playing a 6000 DP or lower Digimon card.

BT14-018.question: What's a token?
BT14-018.answer: Tokens are special cards that some effects put into play to represent Digimon or Tamers. This card's effect, for example, plays tokens that are treated as Digimon named [Amon of Crimson Flame] and [Umon of Blue Thunder]. For a more detailed explanation of how tokens work, check the official rule manual.

BT14-018.question: Can [Amon of Crimson Flame] and [Umon of Blue Thunder] tokens played by this card's effect become targets for "Digimon with play costs of X or less" effects or "level X or higher/lower Digimon" effects?
BT14-018.answer: No, they can't. The [Amon of Crimson Flame] and [Umon of Blue Thunder] tokens played by this card's effect can't become targets for effects with requirements related to play cost or level because these tokens don't have a play cost or level.

BT14-018.question: Can this card's [All Turns] effect activate <Recovery +1 (Deck)> and delete my [Amon of Crimson Flame] or [Umon of Blue Thunder] when I only have one or the other?
BT14-018.answer: Yes, it can. Even if you have only 1 [Amon of Crimson Flame] or [Umon of Blue Thunder] token, it will be deleted and <Recovery +1 (Deck)> will activate.

BT14-018.question: If this card's [All Turns] effect deletes 2 of my [Amon of Crimson Flame] and/or [Umon of Blue Thunder], does <Recovery +1 (Deck)> activate twice?
BT14-018.answer: No, it only activates once. No matter how many [Amon of Crimson Flame] and/or [Umon of Blue Thunder] you delete at one time with this effect, <Recovery +1 (Deck)> will only activate once.

BT14-018.question: What does this card's "When [...] would [...] leave the battle area" mean, exactly?
BT14-018.answer: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.

BT14-020.question: Does "This Digimon can't be blocked" in this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect activate even when my opponent can't trash a digivolution card?

I have both this card and another [Gomamon] with an [On Deletion] inherited effect in the digivolution cards of the same one of my Digimon. When that Digimon is deleted, can I activate this card's inherited effect, play the other [Gomamon] from the digivolution cards, and activate that [On Deletion] inherited effect?
BT14-020.answer: No, you can't activate it. This card’s inherited effect reads "When this Digimon would be deleted," so it interrupts the deletion when it activates. Therefore, the [Gomamon] with the [On Deletion] effect is removed from the digivolution cards before the [On Deletion] effect can be triggered.

BT14-023.question: If the digivolution cards under the target opponent's Digimon increase to become more than those under this Digimon after this card's [When Attacking] effect/inherited effect activate, can my opponent's Digimon now attack?
BT14-023.answer: No, it can't. If the number of digivolution cards under the target opponent's Digimon is less than or equal to those of this Digimon or the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards at the timing when this effect activates, the target Digimon can't attack until the effect ends at the end of your opponent's turn, even if the number of its digivolution cards later increases.

BT14-023.question: Can this card's [When Digivolving] effect trash 1 digivolution card each from 2 of my opponent's Digimon?

BT14-026.question: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect trash 1 digivolution card each from 2 of my opponent's Digimon?

BT14-027.question: Does this card's effect also return my level 3 Digimon to the hand?
BT14-027.answer: Yes, you must return your level 3 Digimon to your hand.

BT14-028.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect prevent deletion even when I lose a battle with my opponent's Security Digimon?
Does this card's [All Turns] delete this Digimon when my opponent's Digimon activates <Retaliation> after battling this Digimon?
BT14-028.answer: Yes, it's deleted. <Retaliation> is deletion by an effect, not by battle.

BT14-029.question: Can this card's [When Digivolving] effect trash 1 digivolution card each from 3 of my opponent's Digimon or trash 2 digivolution cards from 1 of their Digimon and 1 digivolution card from another?
Can this card's [When Attacking] effect unsuspend this Digimon when my opponent has no Digimon?

BT14-030.question: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect return any level Digimon when it returns my Digimon to the hand?
BT14-030.answer: Yes, you can return your Digimon of any level to the hand.

BT14-030.question: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect return my Digimon to the hand even when my opponent has no Digimon?
Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand?
BT14-030.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

BT14-030.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand, what happens for "return 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose level is less than or equal to the returned Digimon's level to the hand"?
BT14-030.answer: [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is a Digimon without a level, therefore your opponent can't return a Digimon to the hand.

BT14-030.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return my token that was played as a Digimon from the battle area to the hand?
BT14-030.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your token is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be removed from the game instead of being returned to the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

BT14-032.question: How does this card’s effect work if it activates when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
BT14-032.answer: You can't add a card to the hand because you have 0 cards in your security stack, but you may perform "place 1 card with [Sukamon] in its name from your hand on top of your security stack."

BT14-032.question: When I use this card's [On Play] effect to add 1 card from my security stack to the hand, do I have to reveal the added card to my opponent?
BT14-032.answer: No, there are no requirements for the card you add to your hand with this effect, so you don't have to reveal it to your opponent.

BT14-033.question: Can I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to search my security stack but choose to not digivolve?
BT14-033.answer:
Yes, you can choose to not digivolve.
In such cases, you shuffle all of the searched cards and return them to the security stack.

BT14-033.question: When exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw when a digivolution would occur by this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect?
BT14-033.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when a card is placed on top of the Digimon to digivolve.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

BT14-033.question: If I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before returning the remaining cards to the security stack?

I used this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to digivolve this card. If I then use the part of the effect after "then" to place a card from the hand into the security stack, can I activate this card's inherited effect?

BT14-037.question: Does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] give 1 of my opponent's Digimon -1000 DP for each card in my security stack even if I have 6 or more cards in my security stack?
BT14-037.answer: Yes. Even if you have 6 or more cards, they get -1000 DP for each security card.

BT14-037.question: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] give 2 of my opponent's Digimon -1000 DP each when I have 2 cards in my security stack?
BT14-037.answer: No, it can't. The effect only targets 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

BT14-038.question: Does this cards [Security] effect play 1 level 6 Digimon card with [Etemon] in its name from my hand before or after the battle with my Security Digimon?
BT14-038.answer:
This is a [Security] effect, so it happens before the battle.
The battle with your Security Digimon happens after the activation of [On Play] effects on played Digimon or "When you play a Digimon" effects.

BT14-041.question: [BT1-087 T.K. Takaishi]’s effect adds a yellow card from my security stack to my hand, and <Recovery +1 (Deck)> adds a card to my security stack. The number of cards in my security stack ultimately remained the same, but does 1 of my opponent's Digimon still get -7000 DP and does this Digimon still gain <Security A. +1> from this card’s effect?
BT14-041.answer: Yes. A card was added to your security stack with <Recovery +1 (Deck)>, therefore 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP and this Digimon gains <Security A. +1>.

BT14-043.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect suspend my Digimon even when my opponent has no Digimon?

BT14-047.question: If a Digimon has 6000 DP or more when this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect activates, then its DP is reduced to 5000 or less by an effect, does that Digimon unsuspend during the unsuspend phase?
BT14-047.answer:
No, it doesn't unsuspend. This card's effect targets "all of your opponent's Digimon," therefore even your opponent's Digimon that later had their DP reduced to 5000 DP or less don't unsuspend.
On the other hand, even if one of your opponent's Digimon has 5000 DP or less upon activation, that Digimon will unsuspend if its DP later increases to 6000 DP or more.

BT14-048.question: This Digimon attacked the opponent player and was blocked by an opponent's Digimon that has more DP than this Digimon. Can I use this card's effect to digivolve into a level 6 Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name in my hand, ignoring its digivolution requirements?
BT14-048.answer: No, you can't. This card's [When Attacking] effect is an effect that activates before your opponent blocks, therefore the activation timing has already passed by the time of the block timing.

BT14-048.question: This Digimon gained <Rush>, it attacked the opponent player, and I used the <Rush> effect to switch the target of attack to an opponent's Digimon with higher DP than this Digimon. In such cases, can this card's [When Attacking] effect digivolve into a level 6 Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name in my hand?
BT14-048.answer: No, it can't. Only when this Digimon attacked a Digimon with higher DP at the time of the attack declaration can this card's [When Attacking] effect digivolve into a level 6 Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name in your hand, ignoring its digivolution requirements.

BT14-051.question: Can I still add to the hand with this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect if I only reveal 1 green Digimon card among the top 5 cards of my deck?
BT14-051.answer: Yes, you can. In that case, you add as many as possible to the hand.

BT14-052.question: What does this card's "(Rule) Name: Treated as having [Leomon]" mean, exactly?
BT14-052.answer: This is a special rule for this card that treats it as a card that has [Leomon] in its name. This is a rule and not an effect, therefore this card is treated as having [Leomon] in its name when the card is in your hand, breeding area, or any other area.

BT14-052.question: Can this card be selected as the target of an effect that targets exactly [Leomon] due to the text "(Rule) Name: Treated as having [Leomon]"?
BT14-052.answer: No, it can't. This card's name is treated as having [Leomon] in its name, but it is not treated as [Leomon].

BT14-054.question: Can this card's [When Digivolving] effect unsuspend this Digimon even when my opponent has no Digimon?
When I have 2 copies of this Digimon, can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to attack using these 2 Digimon?
BT14-054.answer: No, you can't. At the end of your turn, these cards' [End of Your Turn] effects trigger at the same time, the activation order is decided, and then the attack occurs for the 1st Digimon. After activation of effects that are triggered upon attack declaration such as [When Attacking] effects and "when one of your Digimon attacks" effects but before the counter timing, the activation would next occur for the other [End of Your Turn] effect that was pending activation, but because the 1st Digimon is still attacking, you can't make a new attack declaration, and the 2nd effect activation fails.

BT14-054.question: Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to attack even when this Digimon is suspended?
BT14-054.answer: No, you can't. This effect does not allow you to attack with Digimon that are in a state where they can't attack.

BT14-056.question: If one of the cards revealed from my deck by this card's [On Play] effect is a Tamer card or Option card with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait, can I add that card to my hand?
Can this card's inherited effect activate when an opponent's effect would place a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards in another of my Digimon's digivolution cards?
BT14-056.answer: Yes, it can. This effect can interrupt the removal of a card from the battle area, therefore by deleting 1 of your other Digimon with the [D-Brigade] trait, this card will be prevented from being placed in your other Digimon's digivolution cards.

BT14-056.question: What does this card's "When [...] would [...] leave the battle area" mean, exactly?
BT14-056.answer: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.

BT14-060.question: What does this card's "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Commandramon]" mean, exactly?
BT14-060.answer: This is a special rule for this card that treats it as a card that has the [Commandramon] name. This is a rule and not an effect, therefore this card is treated as having the [Commandramon] name when the card is in your hand, breeding area, or any other area.

BT14-060.question: Can this card be selected as the target of an effect that targets exactly [Commandramon] due to the text "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Commandramon]"?
If one of the cards revealed from my deck by this card's [When Attacking] effect is a Tamer card with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait and a play cost of 3 or less, can I play that card?
What does this card's "When [...] would [...] leave the battle area" mean, exactly?
BT14-060.answer: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.

BT14-061.question: Which player chooses the card to return from my opponent’s trash to the deck by this card's effect?
BT14-061.answer: The player that activated this effect chooses.

BT14-062.question: This card’s [All Turns] effect reads "This Digimon can't be deleted by your opponent's effects." How does this effect work, exactly?
BT14-062.answer: This effect prevents deletion when this Digimon is the target of an effect with "delete" in its card text. Deletion will still occur if you lose a battle, both players lose a battle, or if this Digimon's DP is reduced to 0.

BT14-062.question: My opponent has BT14-062 [Datamon] and a Digimon with 8000 DP or less. If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to choose BT14-062 [Datamon] without deleting a Digimon, is the "if this effect didn't delete" condition met?
BT14-062.answer:
Yes, it is.
If your opponent has a Digimon that can't be deleted but can be chosen for this effect, the "if this effect didn't delete" condition can be met by choosing that Digimon.

BT14-062.question: My opponent has BT14-062 [Datamon] and a Digimon with a play cost of 7. If I trash 2 digivolution cards for this card's [When Attacking] effect, can I delete BT14-062 [Datamon] and the Digimon with a play cost of 7?
BT14-062.answer:
No, you can't.
You repeat this card's [When Attacking] effect of deleting 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers with the lowest play cost for each card trashed from digivolution cards.
In this case, you choose BT14-062 [Datamon] as the Digimon with the lowest play cost, but its effect prevents it from being deleted both times.

BT14-063.question: If the 3 cards revealed with this card's [On Deletion] effect don't include both a card with [Monzaemon] in its name and a Digimon card with [Numemon] in its name, am I allowed to play one of the cards or add it to my hand, or do both cards have to be present?
BT14-063.answer: Yes, you can add 1 card or play it even if only 1 card is revealed.

BT14-063.question: When the 3 cards revealed from my deck with this card's [On Deletion] effect include both a card with [Monzaemon] in its name and a Digimon card with [Numemon] in its name, am I allowed to add just one card to my hand or play it?
BT14-063.answer: No, it can't. You must play or add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT14-064.question: If one of the cards revealed from my deck by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect is a Tamer card with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait and a play cost of 4 or less, can I play that card?

BT14-065.question: If my opponent reveals 3 Digimon cards from their deck by this card's effect, does it <De-Digivolve 3> 1 of my opponent's Digimon?
BT14-065.answer:
No. <De-Digivolve 1> activates 3 times, not <De-Digivolve 3>.
The difference is that <De-Digivolve 3> allows you to trash 1 to 3 cards, but <De-Digivolve 1> trashes 1 card three times, meaning that you always trash 3 cards (or until there are no more digivolution cards or until the Digimon is reduced to level 3).

BT14-065.question: When this card’s effect returns revealed cards to my opponent's deck, which player decides the order the cards are placed in and whether the cards are placed on the top or bottom of the deck?
BT14-065.answer: The player that activated this effect chooses.

BT14-067.question: If the card chosen with this card's effect has a play cost of 5, can it delete up to 5 of my opponent's Digimon?
BT14-067.answer: No. If the chosen card has a play cost of 5, choose a number of your opponent's Digimon whose total play cost add up to 5 or less and delete them.

BT14-067.question: When this card’s effect returns revealed cards to my opponent's deck, which player decides the order the cards are placed in and whether the cards are placed on the top or bottom of the deck?
BT14-067.answer: The player that activated this effect chooses.

BT14-068.question: If one of the cards revealed from my deck by this card's [End of Your Turn] effect is a Tamer card with the [D-Brigade]/[DigiPolice] trait, can I play that card?

BT14-072.question: What happens for this effect if I don't have a purple Digimon card with the [Dark Animal] trait in my trash?
BT14-072.answer: You can't return a card from your trash to the hand, but you must perform "trash 1 card in your hand."

BT14-073.question: Can I use this card’s [Your Turn] effect to gain 1 memory when [EX5-062 Anubismon]'s [When Digivolving] effect trashes this card in my hand and plays it from my trash?
BT14-073.answer: No. This card isn't in the battle area upon the timing when it's trashed, so the [Your Turn] effect doesn't trigger and you don't gain 1 memory.

BT14-074.question: If I don't trash 1 card in my hand, do I gain 1 memory from this card's [When Attacking] effect when [Eiji Nagasumi] is still in this Digimon's digivolution cards?
BT14-074.answer: No, you don't gain 1 memory. The effect reads "By..." Therefore, the rest of the effect won't activate if you don't trash a card in your hand.

BT14-075.question: Is the card trashed by this card's [On Deletion] effect also private information?
BT14-075.answer: No, the the trashed card is public information. "Trash [...] without looking" means that you must choose a card to trash from your opponent's hand without looking at the front of the cards in their hand.

BT14-076.question: Does this card's [When Digivolving] effect delete this Digimon when I only have this Digimon?
BT14-076.answer: Yes, it deletes this Digimon. However, this effect reads "By trashing 1 card in your hand," therefore you can choose to not activate the effect by not trashing a card in your hand.

BT14-076.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to trash 1 card in my hand even when my opponent has no Digimon?

BT14-078.question: Do I have to activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?
BT14-078.answer: You must activate "Delete this Digimon and <Draw 2>." "Then, you may return 1 [Loogamon] from your trash to the hand" uses "you may return," therefore it is optional.

BT14-081.question: What does this card's [Your Turn] effect mean?
BT14-081.answer: Normally, the turn will end and switch when the memory moves to 1 or more on your opponent's side. But while this effect is activated, the turn won't end unless the memory moves to 3 or more on your opponent's side. Your turn will continue when your opponent's memory is at 1 or 2.

BT14-081.question: If the memory moves to 2 or less on my opponent's side during my opponent's turn, does the turn switch to my turn with this card's [Your Turn] effect?
BT14-081.answer: No, this effect only applies during your turn. Your opponent's turn continues until the memory moves to 1 or more from your perspective.

BT14-081.question: The memory moved to 3 or more on my opponent's side and the turn ended while this card's [Your Turn] effect was activated. If the memory moves to 1 or 2 on my opponent's side due to an [End of Your Turn] effect, does my turn continue?
When the memory moves to 3 or more on my opponent's side while this card's [Your Turn] effect is activated, does <Blitz> allow for attacking?
BT14-081.answer: No. <Blitz> still requires the memory to be at 1 or more on your opponent's side for attacking.

BT14-081.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to play just 2 of the target cards from my trash when [Eiji Nagasumi] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards and I have 3 or more level 4 or lower cards with the [Dark Animal] or [SoC] trait in my trash?
BT14-081.answer: No, you can't. This effect is a "You may play" effect, but it doesn't include "up to," therefore you must choose to either play no cards or as many as possible.

BT14-081.question: What happens if I declare a "pass" when I have this Digimon?
BT14-081.answer: The memory will move to 3 on your opponent's side, and the turn will end if there are no other effects pending activation, etc.

BT14-082.question: When is the activation timing for this card's [Your Turn] effect when a player is attacked and a security check is performed?
BT14-082.answer: After activation of the [Security] effect on the card revealed by the security check. If the card is a Digimon card, then the timing will come before the battle with the Security Digimon.

BT14-084.question: I used this card's [On Play] effect to return 1 card from my security stack to the hand, then I placed 1 yellow card with the [Vaccine] trait from my hand at the bottom of my security stack. At such times, is a card considered to be added to my security stack, allowing this card's [Your Turn] effect to activate?
When I use this card's [On Play] effect to return 1 card from my security stack to the hand, do I have to reveal the returned card to my opponent?
BT14-084.answer: No, there are no requirements for the card you return to your hand with this effect, so you don't have to reveal it to your opponent.

BT14-085.question: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect even when an opponent's effect suspends an opponent's Digimon?

BT14-086.question: Can I use the [End of All Turns] effect in this card's inherited effect to play this card itself when this card is in a Digimon's digivolution cards?

BT14-087.question: Can I use the [End of All Turns] effect in this card's inherited effect to play this card itself when this card is in a Digimon's digivolution cards?

BT14-088.question: If the cards I reveal with this card's [On Play] effect don't contain both a level 3 Digimon card and a non-white Tamer card, do I still get to add a card to my hand?
BT14-088.answer: Yes, you can add just 1 card to your hand when only 1 or the other is revealed.

BT14-088.question: When the cards revealed from my deck with this card's [On Play] effect contain both a level 3 Digimon card and a non-white Tamer card, am I allowed to add just one card to my hand?
BT14-088.answer: No, you can't. You must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT14-088.question: Can this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect move a level 2 Digimon or cards like [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] or [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] from the breeding area to the battle area?
BT14-088.answer: It can't move level 2 Digimon or cards like [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] because cards without DP can't be moved to the battle area. It can move [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] because it has DP.

BT14-088.question: I used this card’s [Opponent's Turn] effect to move a Digimon from the breeding area to the battle area. Can I use <Blast Digivolve> to digivolve that moved Digimon during the following counter timing?

BT14-089.question: When I have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name and my opponent has 1 Digimon with 6000 DP and 1 with 4000 DP, can I choose the target to delete with this card's effect from these 2 Digimon?
BT14-089.answer: No, you can't. If you have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP.

BT14-090.question: Can I use this card to place 1 [Greymon] and 1 [MetalGreymon] from my trash under [Agumon] but choose to not digivolve into [WarGreymon] in my hand?
BT14-090.answer: Yes, you can. This effect reads "may digivolve into [WarGreymon] in your hand," therefore you can choose to not digivolve after placing [Greymon] and [MetalGreymon] from your trash under [Agumon].

BT14-092.question: My opponent's Digimon was targeted by this card's effect, then it digivolved and now has more digivolution cards than my chosen Digimon. Can my opponent's Digimon now attack and block?
BT14-092.answer: No, it can't. If the number of digivolution cards under the opponent's Digimon targeted by this effect is less than or equal to those of your chosen Digimon at the timing when this card's effect activates, the effect will continue, even if the target's number of digivolution cards later increases.

BT14-093.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to search my security stack but then choose to not digivolve?
When a digivolution would occur by this card's [Main] effect, when exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw?
BT14-093.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when a card is placed on top of the Digimon to digivolve.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

BT14-093.question: If I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before processing the part of the effect after "then"?

I used [BT14-093 Emissary of Hope] to digivolve this Digimon into a card with the [Shaman] or [Wizard] trait in my security stack. In such cases, can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to trash cards from my security stack?
BT14-093.answer:
No, you can't.
The period starting from the use of [BT14-093 Emissary of Hope] until the digivolution is complete and you shuffle your security stack is considered checking your security stack, so it isn't affected by other cards' effects. Therefore, you can't use this card's effect to trash cards from your security stack.

BT14-094.question: Can this card's effect delete 1 of my [Angemon] even when my opponent has no Digimon?

BT14-096.question: I used this card when I had a Tamer with [Mimi Tachikawa] in its name. If my Tamer with [Mimi Tachikawa] in its name is removed from the battle area by an effect after activating this card, can my opponent's Digimon that was affected by the "doesn't unsuspend" effect now unsuspend?
BT14-096.answer: No, it can't. If you have a Tamer with [Mimi Tachikawa] in its name at the timing when this effect activates, your opponent's Digimon that was affected by the "doesn't unsuspend" effect doesn't unsuspend even if your Tamer with [Mimi Tachikawa] in its name is later removed from the battle area.

BT14-097.question: Can this card's effect digivolve any level Digimon into a Digimon card with [Sukamon] in its name in my hand as long as it is a non-white Digimon?
Can this card's effect digivolve a Digimon in the breeding area into a Digimon card with [Sukamon] in its name in my hand?
BT14-097.answer: No, it can't. This effect doesn't target Digimon in breeding areas.

BT14-097.question: What does this card's "(Rule) Name: Also treated as having [Sukamon]" mean, exactly?
BT14-097.answer: This is a special rule for this card that treats it as a card that has [Sukamon] in its name. This is a rule and not an effect, therefore this card is treated as having [Sukamon] in its name when the card is in your hand, trash, or any other area.

BT14-097.question: Also treated as having [Sukamon]" Can this card be selected as the target of an effect that targets exactly [Sukamon] due to the text "(Rule) Name: Also treated as having [Sukamon]"?
BT14-097.answer: No, it can't. This card's name is treated as having [Sukamon] in its name, but it is not treated as [Sukamon].

BT14-097.question: Can this card become a target for effects that activate for Digimon with [Sukamon] in their names?
BT14-097.answer: No, it can't. This card is an Option card, therefore it can't become a target for an effect that targets Digimon.

BT14-097.question: What does a "change 1 of your opponent's Digimon into a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]" effect do, exactly?
BT14-097.answer: This effect changes 1 of your opponent's Digimon into a Digimon whose original name is [Sukamon], its original color is white, and its original DP is 3000.

BT14-097.question: If a card such as BT15-035 [Geremon] has a (Rule) that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?
BT14-097.answer:
The card information gained from the (Rule) will also be changed.
For example, BT15-035 [Geremon]'s (Rule) gives it an original name of [Geremon/Numemon], but if its original card information is changed by this effect, its original name becomes just [Sukamon].

BT14-097.question: If a card such as EX1-005 [Tyrannomon] has an effect that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?
BT14-097.answer:
The card information gained from the effect remains as-is.
For example, if EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s original card information is changed, its original color will become white, and EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s effect will also treat it as green, making it a 2-color white and green Digimon.

BT14-097.question: If a card has changed to a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon], then it digivolves or its top card is trashed by a <De-Digivolve> effect, what happens to that card's information?
BT14-097.answer: It remains as a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]. The gained effect is carried over even if the Digimon digivolves or one or more of its top cards are trashed.

BT14-097.question: What happens if a card is changed to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, then its top card is trashed by <De-Digivolve> or other effect and the top card becomes a Tamer or Digi-Egg card?
BT14-097.answer:
