BT16-015.question: I used this card's [Your Turn] effect to attach [End of Attack] to BT16-011 [Garudamon (X Antibody)] and BT13-014 [Garudamon]'s inherited effects. If I use BT13-014 [Garudamon]'s inherited effect to delete my opponent's BT13-065 [PlatinumSukamon] at the end of this card's attack, then <De-Digivolve> causes this card's [Your Turn] effect to be removed, can I then activate BT16-011 [Garudamon (X Antibody)]'s inherited effect?
BT16-015.answer:
No, it can't be activated.
If the trigger conditions are no longer met before activation, it can't be activated.

BT16-016.question: This card has BT16-016 [Patamon] in its digivolution cards and attacked an opponent's Digimon that has 1 digivolution card. At such times, can I use BT16-016 [Patamon]'s inherited effect to trash the digivolution card of the opponent's Digimon and then activate this card's [Your Turn] effect?
BT16-016.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's [All Turns] effect triggers when this card attacks an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards.
It won't trigger if it attacks a Digimon with digivolution cards, therefore you can't activate it.

BT16-017.question: Does this card's effect reference the card for the Digimon before or after it digivolves?
BT16-017.answer: It references the Digimon after it digivolves.

BT16-018.question: Does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect prevent deletion in battles against Security Digimon?

BT16-020.question: If both my hand and my opponent's hand increase when we both draw 1 card from our decks using an effect such as BT16-020 [GaoGamon]'s [When Digivolving] effect, does my opponent add 2 cards from the top of their security stack to the hand using this card's [Your Turn] effect?
BT16-020.answer:
No, they don’t.
Although cards are added to both players' hands, they are added at the same timing, therefore your opponent only adds 1 card from their security stack to the hand.

BT16-023.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "unsuspend 1 of your Digimon" effect and the "return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the bottom of the deck" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

BT16-024.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to search my security stack but choose to not digivolve?
BT16-024.answer:
Yes, you can choose to not digivolve.
In such cases, you shuffle all of the searched cards and return them to the security stack.

BT16-024.question: When exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw when a digivolution would occur by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
BT16-024.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when a card is placed on top of the Digimon to digivolve.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

BT16-024.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before returning the remaining cards to the security stack?

I used [BT16-024 MagnaAngemon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into this card, then I placed a card from my hand at the bottom of my security stack. At such times, does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect or its [All Turns] effect activate first?
BT16-024.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player chooses the activation order.

BT16-025.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect activate when performing a non-DNA digivolve?
BT16-025.answer:
The "suspend all of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon" part activates even if not DNA digivolving.
The "none of their Digimon can unsuspend until the end of their turn" part only activates if DNA digivolving.

BT16-025.question: When BT16-025 [Paildramon] would be deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?
BT16-025.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
<Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> and this card's <Delay> effect will trigger simultaneously, but if you use this card's effect to digivolve first, the triggered <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> on BT16-025 [Paildramon] will be negated and won't activate.

BT16-025.question: When BT16-025 [Paildramon] is deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?
BT16-025.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect can't be activated because it doesn't trigger when the Digimon is deleted by an opponent's effect.

BT16-025.question: When a Digimon with BT16-025 [Paildramon] in its digivolution cards is deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?
BT16-025.answer:
Yes, you can.
<Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> and this card's <Delay> effect will trigger simultaneously, and the triggered <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> on BT16-025 [Paildramon] can be activated, even if you use this card's effect to digivolve first.

BT16-028.question: Which effect activates first, an [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect on an opponent's Digimon that was played/digivolved, or this card's [All Turns] effect?
BT16-028.answer: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player activates their effect first.

BT16-028.question: When does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger, exactly?
BT16-028.answer:
It will trigger when a Digimon is played by an effect such as the effect on BT5-092 [Nokia Shiramine] or when a Digimon digivolves by an effect such as the effect on P-103 [Offense Training].
It won't trigger for effects that aren't digivolution effects, such as BT4-011 [Agunimon]'s effect that treats a Tamer as a level 3 red Digimon or BT6-060 [Deputymon]'s effect that allows digivolution requirements to be ignored.

BT16-029.question: If the cards I reveal for this card's [On Play] effect include only two types of cards, one being a [Night Claw] trait card and one being a 2-color card, can I add both types to the hand?
BT16-029.answer:
No, you can't.
You can only add 1 [Night Claw] trait or 1 2-color card to the hand.

BT16-030.question: When I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] effect to digivolve it into a level 4 Digimon card with the [Holy Beast]/[Free] trait in the trash, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
BT16-030.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

BT16-032.question: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
BT16-032.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

BT16-032.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
BT16-032.answer:
Yes, such attacks can be ended.
"End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

BT16-033.question: This Digimon attacked a player and a security check occurred. If this card leaves the battle area due to the revealed card's [Security] effect, does this card’s [Your Turn] effect activate?
BT16-033.answer:
No, it doesn’t activate.
The effect triggers when a card is removed from a security stack, but this card is removed from the battle area before it can activate.

BT16-034.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP until the end of their turn" effect and the "1 of their Digimon gains <Security A. -2> until the end of their turn" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

BT16-036.question: Does this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect activate when a player has 0 cards in their security stack?
BT16-036.answer:
Yes, it activates.
In such cases, only the player with 1 or more security cards trashes the top card of their security stack.

BT16-039.question: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include only either a card with [Pulsemon] in its text or a card with the [Abadin Electronics] trait, can I only add 1 card to my hand?
BT16-039.answer: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.

BT16-039.question: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include both a card with [Pulsemon] in its text and a card with the [Abadin Electronics] trait, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
BT16-039.answer: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

BT16-040.question: When I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] effect to digivolve it into a level 4 Digimon card with the [Insectoid]/[Free] trait in the trash, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
BT16-040.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

BT16-040.question: I used [BT16-085 Davis Motomiya & Ken Ichijoji]'s [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to play [BT16-040 Wormmon], it digivolved into this Digimon, then I used the [End of Your Turn] effect to move it to the breeding area. At such times, does [BT16-085 Davis Motomiya & Ken Ichijoji]'s effect return this Digimon to the hand?
BT16-040.answer:
No, it doesn't.
An effect that targets this Digimon will continue targeting it even if it's moved to the breeding area, but because it isn't affected by effects while in the breeding area, it isn't returned to the hand.

BT16-043.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect and the "gain 1 memory" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

BT16-044.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. It can't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase" effect and the "gain 2 memory" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

BT16-045.question: When my Digimon with the [Insectoid] trait and this card in its digivolution cards is suspended, can this card's inherited effect switch the target of an opponent's Digimon's attack to that Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards?

BT16-046.question: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect suspend 1 each of my opponent's Digimon and Tamers?

BT16-047.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "trash the top card of your opponent's security stack" effect and the "gain 2 memory" effect when activating this card's [All Turns] effect?

BT16-048.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect prevent [Security] effects on my opponent's Security Digimon from affecting this Digimon while it's suspended?
BT16-048.answer:
Yes, it isn't affected.
[Security] effects on Security Digimon are treated as Digimon effects, so the "this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon" effect prevents such effects from affecting this Digimon.

BT16-048.question: What does a "your opponent can't play XX by effects" effect do, exactly?
BT16-048.answer:
Such effects prevent your opponent from playing XX by effects.
With this card's effect, your opponent can no longer play Digimon by effects such as BT10-018 [Gaossmon]'s [On Deletion] effect or BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon]'s [When Digivolving] effect.
This effect affects the opponent player.

BT16-048.question: I chose my opponent's BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect. If BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] then attacks and is suspended at the start of the main phase, does its gained <Collision> activate?
BT16-048.answer:
No, <Collision> doesn't activate.
As soon as BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] suspends, its [All Turns] effect prevents it from being affected by your effects, and <Collision> doesn't activate.

BT16-048.question: I chose my opponent's BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect. If BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] then attacks and is suspended at the start of the main phase, does its gained <Collision> activate?
BT16-048.answer:
No, <Collision> doesn't activate.
As soon as BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] suspends, its [All Turns] effect prevents it from being affected by your effects, and <Collision> doesn't activate.

BT16-049.question: Does this card's effect reference the card for the Digimon before or after it digivolves?
BT16-049.answer: It references the Digimon after it digivolves.

BT16-051.question: What does "this Digimon can't leave the battle area other than by deletion" in this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect mean, exactly?
BT16-051.answer:
It means that this Digimon can no longer leave the battle area by processing other than deletion. Such processing includes "return to the hand/deck," "place in the security stack," and "place under another Digimon or Tamer."
It only leaves the battle area by deletion.

BT16-051.question: If a Digimon that's affected by this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect would be trashed because it has no DP, is it still prevented from leaving the battle area?
BT16-051.answer:
No, the card is trashed.
Digimon without DP can't be in the battle area according to the rules, therefore upon the rule check timing, the card is considered a card that doesn't belong in the battle area and is trashed.
This is why that card is trashed even if that Digimon is affected by this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect.

BT16-055.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon can't have its DP reduced by your opponent's effects and isn't affected by <De-Digivolve> effects" effect and the "1 of your Digimon gains <Blocker> and <Reboot> until the end of your opponent's turn" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

BT16-056.question: When my opponent had 2 cards in their security attack, they activated [ST10-06 Mastemon]'s [When Digivolving] effect, and the effect that places a card from their trash in their security stack and the effect that plays a level 5 or lower Digimon card activated. My opponent temporarily has 3 cards in their security stack, then it becomes 2 cards. Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect?
BT16-056.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
Even if an effect activates and increases your opponent's security stack, their security stack must have 3 or more cards when the effect finishes activating.

BT16-059.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "<De-Digivolve 1> 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect and the "delete 1 of their Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

BT16-060.question: If I use the "reduce the play costs of all of your opponent's Digimon by 1" effect and all of my opponent's Digimon have their play costs reduced by 3, does an opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 2 now have a play cost of -1?
BT16-060.answer: No, it doesn't. The minimum value is 0, the resulting play cost can't be negative.

BT16-060.question: If I use the "reduce the play costs of all of your opponent's Digimon by 1" effect, is the play cost also reduced for Digimon cards in areas other than the battle area (such as my opponent's hand or trash)?
BT16-060.answer: No, it isn't. This card's effect only reduces the play costs of Digimon in your opponent's battle area.

BT16-061.question: When I use this card's [All Turns] effect to digivolve it into a Digimon card with the [Beast Dragon]/[Undead]/[SoC] trait in the hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
BT16-061.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

BT16-062.question: When digivolving into this card, do the [When Digivolving] effects on digivolution cards with [Gammamon] in their names activate?
BT16-062.answer:
Yes, they activate.
This card's "This Digimon gains all effects of cards with [Gammamon] in their names in this Digimon's digivolution cards" effect is an [All Turns] effect, so it will activate as soon as the digivolution is confirmed. Therefore, [When Evolving] effects are gained and will trigger.

BT16-063.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect activate when performing a non-DNA digivolve?
BT16-063.answer:
The "until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of their Digimon" part activates even if not DNA digivolving.
The "place 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as the number of cards in your or their security stack at the bottom of their security stack" part only activates if DNA digivolving.

BT16-063.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect place 1 of my opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as the total number of cards in my or their security stack at the bottom of their security stack?
BT16-063.answer: No, this effect places 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as the number of cards in either your or their security stack at the bottom of their security stack, not the total number of cards.

BT16-063.question: I have 5 security cards, and my opponent has 1 security card. Can I refer to the number of my opponent's security cards for this card's [When Digivolving] effect so I don't place their Digimon at the bottom of the security stack?
BT16-063.answer:
No, you can't.
If your opponent has a Digimon with as high or lower a level than the number of either your or your opponent's security cards, you must place those Digimon at the bottom of their security stack for this card's [When Digivolving] effect.

BT16-065.question: Does the "when this card would be played" effect also activate when my opponent has a Digimon with the [Boss] trait?

When this card would be played, if there is a Digimon with the [Boss] trait, and I can return 6 cards with the [D-Brigade] trait from my trash to the top of the deck, can I reduce the play cost by 12?

BT16-066.question: Which player chooses whether or not a card is trashed and chooses the card to trash for this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] [When Digivolving]effect?

BT16-069.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?
BT16-069.answer:
Yes, you can process it.
Even if [Gesomon] or [X Antibody] isn't in this card's digivolution cards, this card's [When Digivolving] effect will prevent 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers without cards under it from suspending.

BT16-069.question: What kind of state does "with cards under it" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect refer to?
BT16-069.answer: It refers to a state where a card has one or more cards such as digivolution cards stacked under it.

BT16-070.question: Can I choose my [LM-020 Quantumon] that isn't affected by Digimon effects as the target of this card's [When Digivolving] effect, then delete just my opponent's Digimon without deleting my [LM-020 Quantumon]?

BT16-071.question: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to digivolve it into a Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name in my hand/trash regardless of its digivolution requirements?
BT16-071.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

BT16-072.question: 2 copies of this Digimon are deleted at the same time, and their [On Deletion] effects triggered simultaneously. Can I play 1 Tamer card with [Myotismon] in its text when the 1st effect activates, then use the 2nd effect to play a Tamer card with the same name as the Tamer card played by the 1st effect?

BT16-073.question: 2 copies of this Digimon are deleted at the same time, and their [On Deletion] effects triggered simultaneously. Can I play 1 Tamer card with [Myotismon] in its text when the 1st effect activates, then use the 2nd effect to play a Tamer card with the same name as the Tamer card played by the 1st effect?

BT16-074.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "<Draw 2> and trash 1 card in your hand" effect and the "you may play 1 Digimon card with [Pulsemon] in its text and 6000 DP or less from your trash without paying the cost. At the next end of your opponent’s turn, delete it" effect when activating this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
Do I delete the Digimon that was played by this card's [When Digivolving] effect at the end of my opponent's turn?
BT16-074.answer:
No, you only delete it at the end of your opponent's first turn after it's played by this effect.
If another effect prevents it from being deleted at the end of your opponent's first turn when it would be deleted, that Digimon isn't deleted at the end of your opponent's following turns.

BT16-074.question: What is the processing order for an effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion of a Digimon played by this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
BT16-074.answer: The pending processing for the effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion at the end of the turn are considered to be processing that triggers simultaneously. Therefore, the turn player can choose the processing order.

BT16-076.question: When I use this card's [All Turns] effect to digivolve into [Fenriloogamon] in my trash, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
BT16-076.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

BT16-077.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?
BT16-077.answer:
Yes, you can process it.
Even if this Digimon didn't DNA digivolve, this card's [When Digivolving] effect can give 1 of your Digimon <Rush> and that Digimon can attack.

BT16-077.question: I used [BT16-091 Beastly Storm Dance of Affection]'s effect to DNA digivolve into this card, then I used [BT16-091 Beastly Storm Dance of Affection]'s effect to attack. At such times, can a Digimon played using this card's [When Digivolving] effect gain <Rush> and attack?
BT16-077.answer: Because [BT16-077 Dinobeemon] is already using [BT16-091 Beastly Storm Dance of Affection]'s effect to attack, a played Digimon can gain <Rush>, but it can't use this card's effect to attack.

BT16-077.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to give <Rush> to 1 of my Digimon, but then choose to not attack with that Digimon?
BT16-077.answer:
No, you can't.
The Digimon that was given <Rush> by this effect must attack if possible.

BT16-077.question: I use BT16-077 [Dinobeemon]'s [When Digivolving] effect to play this card, give <Rush> to BT16-077 [Dinobeemon], and attack a player. Can I then use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to attack with this card?
BT16-077.answer:
No, it can't attack. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack.
In this case, BT16-077 [Dinobeemon] is already attacking using its [When Digivolving] effect.
This card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using this effect, even if you activate it.

BT16-077.question: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to play a card with an [On Play] effect, in what order do I process the part of this card's effect after "then" and the played card's [On Play] effect?
BT16-077.answer:
You first process the part of this card's effect after "then."
You use the part of this card's effect after "then" to give <Rush> to 1 of your Digimon, then that Digimon attacks.
After that, the [On Play] effect of the played card will activate before the counter timing.

BT16-078.question: If only I have a level 4 or lower Digimon, can I choose to not activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect and not delete my level 4 or lower Digimon?

BT16-080.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn" effect and the "delete 1 of their unsuspended Digimon" effect when activating this card's [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] effect?
How exactly do I perform "<Recovery +1 (Deck)> until there are 3 cards in your security stack" in this card’s [On Deletion] effect?
BT16-080.answer: If you have 2 or fewer cards in your security stack when the effect activates, repeat <Recovery +1 (Deck)> until there are 3 cards in your security stack. You don't have to do anything when the effect activates if you have 3 or more cards in your security stack.

BT16-082.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect activate when this Digimon itself moves from the breeding area to the battle area?
When one of my Digimon moves from the breeding area to the battle area during the breeding phase, does this card's [Your Turn] effect activate during the breeding phase or main phase?
BT16-082.answer: It activates during the breeding phase. If effects trigger during the breeding phase, the main phase will come after all effects have activated.

BT16-082.question: I moved one of my Digimon from the breeding area to the battle area when all of my Digimon's DP is reduced by an effect. The moved Digimon's DP becomes 0 and is deleted due to the DP-reducing effect, but does this card's [All Turns] effect activate?

I moved this card from the breeding area to the battle area when all of my Digimon's DP is reduced by an effect. At such times, if this card's DP becomes 0 and is deleted due to the DP-reducing effect after it's moved, can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect?
BT16-082.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
When a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves an area while activation is pending, the effect can no longer be activated.
In this case, the effect triggers when this card is moved, but because the DP becomes 0 before activation, this card is deleted and removed from the battle area, and the effect can't be activated.

BT16-083.question: Does this card's [On Deletion] effect return all Tamers of both players to their owners' hands?
BT16-083.answer: Yes, it returns all Tamers of both players to their owners' hands.

BT16-083.question: I activated this card's [End of Your Turn] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?
BT16-083.answer:
Yes, you can.
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

BT16-083.question: When I would play a Digimon card to the breeding area, can I perform a DigiXros or Assembly for the card to be played?
When a Digimon is played to the breeding area, does that Digimon's [On Play] effects or "when a Digimon is played" effects trigger?

BT16-084.question: The Digimon played using this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect digivolved. Is that Digimon returned to the hand at the end of my opponent's turn?
BT16-084.answer: Yes, it's returned. In such cases, only the top card is returned to the hand and all digivolution cards are trashed.

BT16-084.question: When one of my Digimon DNA digivolves into a red or yellow Digimon, does the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn" effect activate even if I don't suspend this Tamer?
BT16-084.answer:
No, it doesn’t activate.
The rest of the effect won't activate if you don't perform the specified action in effects with "by X" conditions.

BT16-085.question: The Digimon played using this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect digivolved. Is that Digimon returned to the hand at the end of my opponent's turn?
BT16-085.answer: Yes, it's returned. In such cases, only the top card is returned to the hand and all digivolution cards are trashed.

BT16-085.question: When one of my Digimon DNA digivolves into a blue or green Digimon, does the "trash any 3 digivolution cards under your opponent's Digimon" effect activate even if I don't suspend this Tamer?
BT16-085.answer:
No, it doesn’t activate.
The rest of the effect won't activate if you don't perform the specified action in effects with "by X" conditions.

BT17-016.question: The memory is at 0, I use this Digimon with ST7-05 [Growlmon] in its digivolution cards to attack, and it deleted an opponent's Digimon with <Retaliation> in battle. Is this Digimon deleted by the <Retaliation> effect at such times?
BT17-016.answer:

The turn player's effect activates first, the memory becomes 1, and this Digimon's [Your Turn] effect can no longer activate, therefore it's deleted by <Retaliation>.

BT17-018.answer:
No, it means for every 10 cards in the total sum of cards in your trash and the cards in your opponent's trash.
For example, if you have 12 cards in your trash and your opponent has 8 cards in their trash, the total would be 20. Therefore, you trash 2 cards from your opponent's security stack.

BT17-019.answer: No. You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can’t DNA digivolve using Digimon that aren’t specified in [DNA Digivolution].

BT17-020.answer: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.

I first used BT17-048 [Argomon]'s [On Deletion] effect to play this card. At such times, if I use this card's [On Play] effect to place [Argomon] in digivolution cards before activating the [On Deletion] effect, what happens to that effect?
BT17-051.answer: If a card is removed from the trash before a triggered [On Deletion] effect activates, that [On Deletion] effect can't be activated.

BT17-055.question: I chose 1 opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 8 or less as the target for "can't attack players" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect. If that opponent's Digimon digivolves during their next turn and becomes a Digimon with a play cost of 9 or more, can it now attack players?
BT17-055.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a target Digimon of this card's [When Digivolving] effect becomes a level 9 or higher Digimon, it can't attack players.

BT17-057.question: How many [Machinedramon] cards can I place under this card when I DigiXros it?
BT17-057.answer:
1 card.
Unless specified otherwise, you can only place 1 of each of the cards shown in the DigiXros requirements.

BT17-057.question: Does "cards from your trash may also be placed for this card's DigiXros" mean that I can place cards from my hand, battle area, and/or trash for the DigiXros?
BT17-057.answer: Yes, that's correct. In addition to Digimon from the hand or battle area, you may also place cards from the trash for the DigiXros.

BT17-057.question: What does this card's "when [...] would leave the battle area" mean, exactly?
BT17-057.answer: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.

BT17-059.question: If I use this card’s [When Digivolving] effect to place [Doomsday Clock] from my hand or trash as a digivolution card, can I choose to not play [Diaboromon] Tokens?
BT17-059.answer:
Yes, you can.
This effect reads "you may play," so if you perform the conditions specified for "by X," you may choose whether or not to activate the effect shown in text.

BT17-059.question: Does the inherited effect on a card like BT2-059 [Kurisarimon] or BT2-053 [Keramon] trigger twice when I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to play 2 [Diaboromon] Tokens?
BT17-059.answer:
No, it doesn't.
You can play 2 [Diaboromon] Tokens, but they are played at the same time during a single timing, therefore the effect only triggers once.

BT17-059.question: Can I also use this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect to switch the attack target to my unsuspended Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its name?

I attack my opponent's Digimon, and an attempt is made to delete this Digimon using an effect. After that, I activate this card's [All Turns] effect and play BT17-059 [Diaboromon]. Can I then activate BT17-059 [Diaboromon]'s [Opponent's Turn] effect?

BT17-064.question: This card has BT16-016 [Patamon] in its digivolution cards and attacked an opponent's Digimon that has 1 digivolution card. At such times, can I use BT16-016 [Patamon]'s inherited effect to trash the digivolution card of the opponent's Digimon and then activate this card's [Your Turn] effect?

No, you can't.

BT17-065.question: When exactly is the timing when this card's [Trash] [All Turns] effect triggers?

It triggers at the timing when this card is in the trash and your [Dorugamon] would be deleted.
[Trash] means that an effect can trigger and activate when the card is in the trash.

BT17-065.answer:
Yes, you can.
However, the DP-reducing effect will be carried over after the [Trash] effect activates and digivolution occurs, therefore deletion will occur again if the DP is still 0 after the effect activates and digivolution occurs.

BT17-065.question: I used this card's [Trash] effect to digivolve when my [Dorugamon] would be deleted due to its DP being reduced by 10000. Its DP became 0 due to the DP-reducing effect, but can I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect after it digivolves at such times?

BT17-068.question: What cards does "level 5 or lower card with [Dark Masters] in its text" in this card's inherited effect refer to?

BT17-069.question: The Digimon played using this card's [When Digivolving] effect digivolved. Is that Digimon returned to the hand at the end of my opponent's turn?
BT17-069.answer: Yes, it's returned. In such cases, only the top card is returned to the hand and all digivolution cards are trashed.

BT17-069.question: How does this card’s inherited effect work, exactly?
BT17-069.answer:
Normally, the turn will end and the turn will switch when the memory moves to 1 or more on your opponent's side. But while this effect is activated, the turn won't end unless the memory moves to 3 or more on your opponent's side.
Your turn will continue when your opponent's memory is at 1 or 2.

BT17-069.question: If the memory moves to 2 or less on my opponent's side during my opponent's turn, does the turn switch to my turn with this card's inherited effect?
BT17-069.answer: No, this effect only applies during your turn. Your opponent's turn continues until the memory moves to 1 or more from your perspective.

BT17-069.question: The memory moved to 3 or more on my opponent's side and the turn ended while this card's inherited effect was activated. If the memory moves to 1 or 2 on my opponent's side due to an [End of Your Turn] effect, does my turn continue?
When the memory moves to 3 or more on my opponent's side while this card's inherited effect is activated, does <Blitz> allow for attacking?
BT17-069.answer:
No. <Blitz> still requires the memory to be at 1 or more on your opponent's side for attacking.
Attacking is possible when your opponent's memory is at 1 or more.

BT17-070.question: Can I use this card’s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place 1 level 5 card with [Dark Masters] in its traits as a digivolution card even when my opponent doesn't have a level 5 or lower Digimon?

BT17-075.answer:
Yes, you do.
You perform the part of the effect after "then" regardless of whether or not a Tamer was played.

BT17-076.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card itself is played?

My BT6-083 [Eosmon] was played, then this card's [All Turns] effect and another effect triggered simultaneously. If another effect activates and the DP of my played BT6-083 [Eosmon] changes from 4000 to 5000, then I activate this card's [All Turns] effect, what is the DP of Digimon I can delete?
BT17-076.answer:
5000 DP or less.
If the same reference to a "played" trigger condition being performed isn't being made for an effect when it has a "when X is played" trigger condition, the state when the effect is processed will be referenced.
In this case, processing was performed when your BT6-083 [Eosmon] had 5000 DP, therefore you can delete a Digimon with 5000 DP or less.

BT17-076.question: Another of my [Eosmon] was played, then this card's [All Turns] effect and another effect triggered simultaneously. I activated the other effect, then my played [Eosmon] was removed from the battle area. If I then activate this card's [All Turns] effect, can I delete an opponent's Digimon?
BT17-076.answer:
No, you can't.
If the same reference to a "played" trigger condition being performed isn't being made for an effect when it has a "when X is played" trigger condition, the state when the effect is processed will be referenced.
In this case, because the Digimon that could be referenced by this card's [All Turns] effect was removed, you can't delete a Digimon.

BT17-077.question: What happens to Digi-Egg cards in the trash when this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect activates?
BT17-077.answer: If a Digi-Egg card is affected by an effect that places it at the bottom of the deck, it will be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck.

BT17-077.question: Does "if this effect returned level 7 white cards" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect mean that it will activate even if I return a card such as BT12-112 [Shoutmon X7: Superior Mode] that has 2 or more colors including white?
Do I gain 6 memory if I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return 2 level 7 white cards?
Which player returns cards from their trash to the bottom of the deck for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
BT17-077.answer: The player that activated the effect chooses themselves or their opponent, then all of the cards in the chosen player's trash are returned to the bottom of the deck.

BT17-078.question: I used this card's [On Play] effect to trash a BT13-007 [King Drasil_7D6] with a BT17-078 [Omnimon ACE] in its digivolution cards. Is BT17-078 [Omnimon ACE]'s <Overflow> processed at such times?
BT17-078.answer:
Yes, it's processed.
<Overflow> is processed when a card is sent from the area or from under a card to another area.
In this case, <Overflow> is processed because a card is placed in the trash from under another card.

BT17-078.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?
BT17-078.answer:
Yes, you can process it.
Even if this Digimon didn't DNA digivolve, this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect will delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

BT17-078.question: I activated this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?
BT17-078.answer:
Yes, you can.
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

BT17-079.question: My Digimon that gained <Security A. +1> and has this card in its digivolution cards was deleted in battle with an opponent's Digimon when my Digimon had 10000 DP, then I performed a security check using <Piercing>. If the [Security] effect on the checked card reduces the DP of the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards to 9000 or less, can I still perform the 2nd security check using this card's <Piercing>?
BT17-079.answer:
Yes, you can.
<Piercing> activates as soon as your opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle, therefore you can still perform a security check even if the effect is lost after activation.

BT17-080.question: Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to place this Tamer and 1 [Growlmon] and 1 [WarGrowlmon] from my trash as the bottom digivolution cards of 1 of my [Guilmon], but choose to not may digivolve into [Gallantmon]?

Yes, you can.
The effect reads "may digivolve," so you can choose whether or not to digivolve.

BT17-080.question: If the [Gallantmon] digivolved by this card's [End of Your Turn] effect has <Blitz>, can I activate it?
BT17-080.answer: <Blitz> can activate as long as your opponent has 1 or more memory when you would activate the effect.

BT17-081.question: Can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to gain 2 memory if I have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name and a Digimon with [Garurumon] in its name?
When I play a Digimon with [Greymon] or [Garurumon] in its name, then its DP becomes 0 and is deleted upon play due to a persistent effect, can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect?
BT17-081.answer:
Yes, you can.
Even if the played Digimon is removed before the effect activates, it triggers because the "when [...] Digimon is played" condition is met, then the effect can activate. However, the "if you have a Digimon with [XX] in its name" condition is no longer met once the Digimon is removed, therefore you don't gain 1 memory.

BT17-081.question: Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to attack using my Digimon with [Omnimon] in its name even when it's suspended?
BT17-081.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's [End of Your Turn] effect does not allow you to attack with Digimon that are in a state where they can't attack.

BT17-081.question: I attacked using BT5-086 [Omnimon]'s <Blitz> and unsuspended it using the other [When Digivolving] effect. After the attack ends, can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to attack again?
BT17-081.answer:
Yes, you can.
If BT5-086 [Omnimon] digivolves during the main phase, you can use the [End of Your Turn] effect to attack again after the attack from <Blitz> ends.

BT17-081.question: When I have 2 copies of this Tamer and 2 unsuspended Digimon with [Omnimon] in their names, can I activate the [End of Your Turn] effect on both copies of this card and attack using both of the Digimon with [Omnimon] in their names?
BT17-081.answer:
No, you can't.
The effect will trigger on both copies, but after the attack declaration is made for the 1st [Omnimon] and effects such as [When Attacking] effects have finished activating, the effect on the 2nd copy of this card that was pending activation will activate before the counter timing. However, a new attack declaration can't be made during an attack, and only the 1st [Omnimon]'s attack can be performed as a result.

BT17-082.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when my Digimon is played by <Partition>?
BT17-082.answer:
Yes, it triggers.
It triggers because <Partition> is an effect where the specified cards are played from digivolution cards.

BT17-083.question: Does this card's inherited effect also activate if a single effect such as "<Draw 1>. Then, trash 1 card in the hand" trashes the same number of cards as the number that were added from the draw?

BT17-084.question: Can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to suspend this Tamer when my level 5 or higher [Free] trait Digimon would be deleted in battle, even if I don't have any level 4 or lower Digimon cards in that Digimon's digivolution cards?

BT17-084.question: When my level 5 or higher [Free] trait Digimon would be deleted in battle, I used this card's [All Turns] effect to play a level 4 or lower Digimon card with <Retaliation> in its inherited effects from that Digimon's digivolution cards. BT17-087.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place BT12-038 [GeoGreymon] as the bottom digivolution card of an opponent's BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] that's treated as a Digimon, does that BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] gain BT12-038 [GeoGreymon]'s inherited effect?

Yes, it gains the inherited effect.

BT17-087.question: What does an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect do, exactly?
BT17-087.answer:
It causes that card to also be treated as a Digimon with X000 DP.
For example, if a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon, it can attack like a standard Digimon, and it will gain inherited effects from cards stacked under it.
However, even if a Tamer is played and then treated as a Digimon in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn.

BT17-087.question: Can I use the [All Turns] effect on BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] to gain memory if it's treated as a Digimon and suspends while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
BT17-087.answer:
Yes, you can gain memory.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

BT17-087.question: Can I use the [All Turns] effect on BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] to gain memory if it's treated as a Digimon and suspends while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
BT17-087.answer:
Yes, you can gain memory.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

BT17-087.question: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to place an opponent's BT12-038 [GeoGreymon] from the battle area as the bottom digivolution card of their BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] that's treated as a Digimon, does that BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] gain BT12-038 [GeoGreymon]'s inherited effect?

BT17-087.answer: No, it is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer.

BT17-087.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect and it activates an effect, is it treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect?
BT17-087.answer:
Yes, it's treated as an effect of both.
Because the card is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the activated effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect.

BT17-087.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
BT17-087.answer: Yes, it's deleted upon the rule check timing.

BT17-087.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?
BT17-087.answer:
If an effect has triggered and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the play cost, level, and DP are overwritten by the newer effect.
However, if an effect has already activated and the card is affected by a "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, the already activated effect will be overwritten.
Any other effects such as <Rush> that are later gained will be added.

BT17-087.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?

When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

BT19-101.question: This card with no digivolution cards can't be suspended because of its [All Turns] effect, but does this card's <Overclock ([Composite] trait)> effect allow it to attack without suspending?

If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.

BT25-020.question: During an attack by my Digimon with <Piercing>, I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect, the attacking Digimon and an opponent's Digimon battle, and my opponent's Digimon was deleted in battle. However, if the number of checks is modified by <Security A.>, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.

BT25-020.question: During an attack by my Digimon with <Piercing>, I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to have that Digimon and an opponent's Digimon battle, and my opponent's Digimon was deleted in battle. BT25-103.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
BT25-103.answer: Yes, such attacks can be ended. "End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

BT25-103.question: If an attack is ended by an "end the attack" effect, do [End of Attack] effects still trigger?
After activating this card's [Counter] effect, can I activate another [Counter] effect?
BT25-103.answer: No. Only one [Counter] effect can be activated per an attack.

BT25-104.question: Does a burst digivolve without notes also trash the top card of the stack at the end of the turn it digivolved, as with normal burst digivolve?
BT25-104.answer:
Yes, you trash it.
The standard rules apply even when notes aren't shown.

BT25-104.question: I used [Final Shining Burst], and its [Main] effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0. At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of zero deleted?
BT25-104.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet.
After trashing the used Option card or digivolving by Arts Digivolve, all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted upon the rule check. Then, if the deleted card has an [On Deletion] effect, it will trigger simultaneously with this card's [When Digivolving] effect.

BT25-104.question: What does "activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side" mean, exactly?
BT25-104.answer:
A [Main] effect shown on the DUAL card's Option side will activate.
Activated effects on the Option side are treated as Option card effects.

BT25-104.question: Is an "activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side" effect considered to be using an Option card?
BT25-104.answer:
No, it isn't considered to be using an Option card.
This effect directly activates a [Main] effect shown on the DUAL card's Option side.

BT25-104.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving][When Attacking] effect to activate the [Main] effect on the Option side and give -15000 DP to a Digimon that isn't affected by Digimon effects?
BT25-104.answer:
Yes, you can.
If an effect on the Option side is activated, it's considered to be an Option card effect.
Because it isn't a Digimon effect, the DP will be reduced by -15000.

BT25-104.question: What does an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect do, exactly?
BT25-104.answer:
It causes that card to also be treated as a Digimon with X000 DP.
For example, if a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon, it can attack like a standard Digimon, and it will gain inherited effects from cards stacked under it.
However, even if a Tamer is played and then treated as a Digimon in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn.

BT25-104.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, is it no longer considered a Tamer?
BT25-104.answer: No, it is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer.

BT25-104.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect and it activates an effect, is it treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect?
BT25-104.answer:
Yes, it's treated as an effect of both.
Because the card is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the activated effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect.

BT25-104.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
BT25-104.answer: Yes, it's deleted upon the rule check timing.

BT25-104.question: If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?
BT25-104.answer: In the case of multiple triggered effects that state "is also treated as an X000 DP Digimon", the later effect overwrites the play cost, level and DP. However, if the card was under the effect of a persistent effect that states "is also treated as an X000 DP Digimon", that persistent effect will continue to overwrite the information. Any gained effects such as <Rush> will be added on top of that.

BT25-104.question: Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
BT25-104.answer:
Yes, you can.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

BT25-104.question: If an opponent's card has "isn't affected by Digimon effects" and it's chosen for an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" Tamer effect that treats it as a Digimon, will the chosen opponent Digimon be affected by effects?
BT25-104.answer:
No, it won't be affected by effects.
When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore the chosen opponent Digimon won't be affected by effects.

BT25-104.question: I have a [Marcus Damon] that is treated as a Digimon with 6000 DP. My Digimon in the battle area digivolves into this card, and I use this card's [All Turns] effect to increase that [Marcus Damon]'s DP to 12000 and give it <Rush>. What happens to that [Marcus Damon] if this card is then removed from the battle area?
BT25-104.answer:
It will be treated as a Digimon with 6000 DP, and it will lose <Rush>.
This card's [All Turns] effect is always activated while it's in the battle area.
As soon as this card is removed from the battle area, the effect will be lost, and the [Marcus Damon] will be treated as it was before.

BT25-104.question: Can I reference this card as an Option card with the traits shown on this card?
BT25-104.answer:
Yes, you can.
This card is treated as an Option card with the [DATA SQUAD] trait.

BT25-104.question: The battle area currently contains this card with digivolution cards and a Marcus Damon that is being treated as a Digimon due to this card's effect. My opponent activates the effect "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -X000 DP until the end of turn. Then, <De-Digivolve X> 1 of their Digimon" and reduces Marcus Damon's DP to 0 then deletes this card with <De-Digivolve>. At this time, the Marcus Damon has lost its DP and is no longer treated as a Digimon due to this card's deletion. Is it deleted upon a rule check?
BT25-104.answer: No, it is not deleted. The Marcus Damon loses its DP and is no longer being treated as a Digimon before a rule check occurs. Therefor, it is no longer subject to the rule "Digimon with 0 DP are destroyed" when a rule check occurs, and it is not destroyed.

BT26-001.question: What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
BT26-001.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

BT26-001.question: When does "when your effects add to decks" trigger?
BT26-001.answer:
This effect triggers when a card is placed in the deck from any area other than the deck.
It triggers regardless of whether the card is placed on the top or the bottom of the deck. However, it does not trigger when a card is revealed from the deck and returned.

BT26-001.question: When an effect such as "<Draw 1>. Then, if your hand has 6 or more cards, return 1 card in your hand to the bottom of the deck" removes cards from the deck then adds cards to it, does the effect "when your effects add to decks" trigger?
BT26-001.answer:
Yes, it does.
It also triggers when an effect adds cards to the deck then removes them.

BT26-001.question: When one of my effects adds cards to my opponent's deck, does this card's "when your effects add to decks" effect trigger?

BT26-003.question: Can I change the attack target of a Digimon that isn't affected by effects with an effect that "changes the attack target"?
Can I activate this card's inherited effect while I don't have a [Glowing Dawn] trait Digimon and trash a card under one of my Tamers?

BT26-004.question: If I use this card's inherited effect to place a card under a Tamer with cards under it, in what order do I place the card?
BT26-004.answer: The card is placed on the bottom of the cards under the Tamer.

BT26-004.question: Can I change the stacking order of face-down cards under a Tamer?
Can I search/look at face-down cards under a Tamer?
BT26-004.answer:
Only the player of those cards can search or look at them.
The opponent player can't search or look at them.

BT26-004.question: What happens if a face-down card under a Tamer is trashed?
BT26-004.answer: It's placed face-up in the trash.

BT26-005.question: Does this card's inherited effect allow me to play the card under the Tamer after trashing it?

BT26-006.question: Does this card's inherited effect allow me to trash just 1 specified card?
BT26-006.answer:
No.
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.
The conditions for this inherited effect require you to trash two specified cards.

BT26-006.question: I attacked with a Digimon that has this card as a digivolution card and attempted to play a card with DigiXros with this card's inherited effect. At such times, if I place the attacking Digimon underneath the played card with its DigiXros effect, what happens to the attack?
BT26-006.answer: Since the attacking Digimon is removed, the attack doesn't succeed.

BT26-006.question: Using this card's inherited effect, I trash a digivolution card with the effect "when effects trash this card from digivolution cards" and try to play a card with DigiXros. At such times, if I activate [EX10-064 Yuu Amano & Nene Amano]'s effect and place the trashed card under the card with DigiXros, can I activate the trashed card's "when effects trash this card from digivolution cards" effect?
BT26-006.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
When a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves its current area while activation is pending, the effect can no longer be activated.
In this case, the trashed card's "when effects trash this card from digivolution cards" effect triggers when you use the effect to trash it from digivolution cards, however, it's removed from the trash before the effect can activate.

BT26-009.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

BT26-010.question: I have a Digimon with <Detach> that this card is linked to. That Digimon attacked my opponent's Digimon, but both Digimon had the same DP and both lost the battle. At such times, if I activate <Detach> immediately before my Digimon would be deleted and trash this card with <Piercing> in its link effects, only the opponent's Digimon would be deleted in battle, but can I activate <Piercing> in those link effects?
BT26-010.answer:
No, you can't.
<Detach> triggers and activates immediately before both Digimon lose the battle and would be deleted.
<Piercing> is lost when your opponent's Digimon is deleted, therefore you can't activate it.

BT26-011.question: What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
BT26-011.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

BT26-012.question: There are two copies of this card in the battle area. Can I activate both of their [Main] effects and play or use one specified card with its cost reduced by the combined amount from both effects?
BT26-012.answer:
No, you can't.
You can't simultaneously activate multiple effects that play or use a card.

BT26-012.question: If a Digimon with the effect "Players can't reduce play costs," such as [ST12-03 Solarmon], is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Main] effect and play a specified card?
BT26-012.answer: You can activate it and play the card, but the cost will not be reduced.

BT26-012.question: If a Digimon with the effect "Players can't play Digimon by effects," such as [BT9-047 Pomumon], is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Main] effect and play a specified card?
BT26-012.answer: You can activate it, but the card can't be played.

BT26-014.question: I activated this card's [On Deletion] effect and returned it from the trash to my hand by processing the first part. Can I then process the part of this card's effect that follows after "then"?
BT26-014.answer:
Yes, you can.
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

BT26-015.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

BT26-015.question: Due to this card's effect, the DP on my opponent's Digimon become 0. At this point in time, are those Digimon with 0 DP immediately deleted?
BT26-015.answer:
No, they are not immediately deleted at this point in time.
All activated effects are resolved, after which a rule check occurs. At that point in time, all Digimon with 0 DP are deleted simultaneously.

BT26-015.question: After using this card's [Your Turn] effect to give a Digimon DP, can I choose not to attack with it?
BT26-015.answer:
No, you can't.
The Digimon that gets additional DP from this effect must attack if possible.

BT26-016.question: Can I only return one card to the bottom of the deck from the trash with this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
BT26-016.answer:
No, you can't.
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.
The conditions for this [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect require you to return three cards to the bottom of the deck.

BT26-016.question: I used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to delete an opponent's Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect, and I used the part of the effect after "then" to return that card from their trash to the bottom of the deck. Can that deleted card's [On Deletion] effect activate at such times?
BT26-016.answer:
No, it can't be activated.
When a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves its current area while activation is pending, the effect can no longer be activated.
In this case, the deleted card's [On Deletion] effect triggers, but it's removed from the trash before the effect can activate.

BT26-016.question: Does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect allow me to choose my trash and my opponent's trash?
BT26-016.answer:
Yes, you can choose your trash and your opponent's.
Additionally, you can choose any combination of three cards from both trashes, for example, one card from your own trash and two cards from your opponent's trash.

BT26-016.question: Which player chooses the cards that are to be returned to the deck from my opponent’s trash by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
BT26-016.answer:
The player who activated this card's effect.
Which cards and what order to return them in are both specified by the player who activated this effect, then they are returned to the deck.

BT26-016.question: I chose 3 cards including a Digi-Egg card from the trash for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect. At such times, the rules place the Digi-Egg card at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck when it would be returned to the deck. Is this effect's "by" condition met?
When returning a Security card to the bottom of the deck with this card's [All Turns] effect, can I look at that card's information?

BT26-017.question: Multiple effects trigger when this card is deleted. In what order can they be activated?
BT26-017.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

BT26-021.answer:
No, you can't.
You can't simultaneously activate multiple effects that play a card.

What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?
BT26-028.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating.
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer be activated by triggering or by effects that activate that card's "[When Digivolving]" effects.

BT26-028.question: I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack. Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
BT26-028.answer:
Yes, you can.
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

BT26-028.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?

A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
BT26-028.answer:
No, it doesn't count.
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

BT26-028.question: This card has 3 different cards in its App Fusion requirements. What combinations are possible for App Fusion?
BT26-028.answer:
App Fusion is possible with the following combinations.
●[Aidmon] with [Supplemon] link card
●[Aidmon] with [Spamon] link card
●[Supplemon] with [Aidmon] link card
●[Supplemon] with [Spamon] link card
●[Spamon] with [Aidmon] link card
●[Spamon] with [Supplemon] link card

BT26-029.question: When performing a security check, if a [Security] effect, a "when this Digimon checks an opponent's security" effect, and a "when a security stack is removed from" effect trigger simultaneously, what order do they activate in?
BT26-029.answer:
The [Security] effect is activated first.
When a [Security] effect is checked, it is activated immediately without waiting.
Activate the other triggered effects in order, starting with the turn player's effects.

BT26-029.question: What does a "can't trash stacked cards" effect do, exactly?
BT26-029.answer:
This means that the effect prevents "perform XX on stacked cards" processing.
For example, a "can't trash stacked cards" effect prevents trashing stacked cards from the top by <De-Digivolve> (which trashes the top stacked cards) or similar effects, and prevents trashing stacked cards from the bottom by "trash the bottom digivolution cards" or similar effects.
However, because the effect only prevents processing that "performs XX on stacked cards", you can perform XX with processing that applies the action to a Digimon itself.

BT26-029.question: If a Digimon has been given the "can't return any of its stacked cards to hands or decks" effect with this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, can that Digimon be returned with effects such as "Return Digimon to the hand" or "Return Digimon to the deck"?
BT26-029.answer: Yes, the Digimon can be returned.

BT26-030.question: If this card is checked from a security stack, does it battle with the attacking Digimon after its [Security] effect activates?
BT26-030.answer: Yes, it battles after its [Security] effect activates.

BT26-031.question: What happens for "1 player with the most security cards" if both players have the same number of security cards?
BT26-031.answer: The player that activated the effect chooses 1 player.

BT26-033.question: If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiple of my specified Digimon or Tamers would leave the battle area simultaneously, are all of those Digimon and Tamers prevented from leaving?
BT26-033.answer:
Yes, all of those Digimon and Tamers are prevented from leaving.
This card's [All Turns] effect affects all cards without having to choose them.

BT26-033.question: Is Wide Plasment's first effect always active?
BT26-033.answer:
Yes, it is always active.

BT26-034.answer: It refers to the positions at 4 and to the right of it on your side.

What does "may battle" mean, exactly?
BT26-037.answer:
This effect immediately initiates a battle.
If this effect is activated, the chosen Digimon battle according to the standard rules.

BT26-037.question: If 2 Digimon including a Digimon that has an "effects don't affect" effect are chosen for a "may battle" effect, can those Digimon battle?
BT26-037.answer:
Yes, they can battle.
A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect can still be chosen for an effect. In addition, a battle itself is a rule that compares DP, not an effect. Therefore, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen, and then it can battle.
If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.

When does "when this Digimon wins a battle" trigger?
BT26-038.answer:
It triggers when the battle is won.
When the Digimon with this effect wins a battle, the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted, then the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect can be activated.

BT26-038.question: Does a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect also trigger when a battle against a Security Digimon is won?

A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted. At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the effects that trigger upon the losing Digimon being deleted?

BT26-038.question: A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle. The check is performed with the card left revealed.

BT26-100.question: What is a {Security} effect?

A {Security} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is face up in the security stack.

The [Security] effect is activated first.

Activate the other triggered effects in order, starting with the turn player's effects.
