BT4-037.answer: No. You don't have any security cards to trash, so you can't activate this effect.

BT4-047.question: Does this card's [At End of Opponent's Turn] effect mean that if I have no cards left in my security stack, at the end of my opponent's turn I lose the game?
BT4-047.answer: No. The effect only trashes cards from your security stack and isn't the same as you taking an attack. If you have no cards left in your security stack at the end of your opponent's turn, you continue the game as normal.

BT4-047.question: Do the [Security] effects on cards trashed by this card's [At End of Opponent's Turn] effect activate?
If I have multiple copies of this Digimon in my battle area, do I trash multiple security cards at the end of my opponent's turn?

BT4-048.question: Do I always have to activate this card's effect when I attack?
BT4-048.answer: No, you can choose not to.

BT4-048.question: Can I activate this card's [When Attacking] effect if I have no cards left in my security stack?
BT4-048.answer: No. If you can't add cards from your security stack to your hand, you can't activate the effect.

BT4-048.question: I attack with this Digimon, then activate its [When Attacking] effect to unsuspend it and give 1 of my opponent's Digimon -6000 DP. If I attack again on the same turn, can I give 1 of my opponent's Digimon an additional -6000 DP?
BT4-048.answer: No. The effect has [Once Per Turn], so it doesn't activate on any attacks past the first one.

BT4-052.question: If this card is a digivolution card and is trashed by <Digi-Burst>, when does this card return to hand: before or after <Digi-Burst> activates?

BT4-054.question: Can this card's effect be activated against my opponent's unsuspended Digimon?
BT4-054.answer: No. The effect targets "1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon," so you can't target unsuspended Digimon.

BT4-058.question: Can I use this card's effect on [Orochimon] itself?

BT4-059.question: Can this card's inherited effect be activated no matter what color my Tamer is?
BT4-059.answer: Yes, since there's no color specified.

BT4-060.question: Can I use this card's effect to suspend one my own Digimon?
BT4-060.answer: Yes, as long as it's a level 4 or lower Digimon, you can suspend it -- including your own Digimon.

BT4-060.question: Can I use this card's effect to suspend a level 4 Digimon when it Digivolves?
BT4-060.answer: No, digivolving doesn't count as the card being played, so you can't suspend it.

BT4-060.question: Can I use this card's effect to suspend a level 4 or lower Digimon when it moves from the breeding area to the battle area?
BT4-060.answer: No. Moving from the breeding area doesn't count as the card being played, so you can't suspend it.

BT4-062.question: Can I use this card's effect to return Digimon that were already suspended to their owners' decks?

BT4-064.question: If this card is a digivolution card and is trashed by <Digi-Burst>, when does this card return to hand: before or after <Digi-Burst> activates?

BT4-066.question: My opponent has a [BT4-066 Golemon] in play. If [BT4-066 Golemon] is chosen as part of this card’s effect, [BT4-066 Golemon]’s deletion will cause my opponent’s black Digimon to each receive -1000 DP. Can I choose more of my opponent’s Digimon with this card’s effect to cover the gap to reach 8000 DP?
BT4-066.answer: No. When [BT4-066 Golemon] is deleted, reducing the DP of your opponent’s Digimon, this card’s effect will have already finished activating. As such, you cannot choose additional Digimon with this card’s effect midway.

BT4-066.question: Does this card's effect also activate for [BT4-066 Golemon] itself?

BT4-071.question: I have 2 copies of this Digimon in my battle area, and both are deleted at the same time by an opponent's skill. Do both copies activate their [On Deletion] skills?
BT4-071.answer: No. The effects for both copies are triggered, but since the cards themselves have been deleted and sent to the trash, they're no longer in the battle area, which means their effects can't be activated.

BT4-072.question: Can I choose [BT4-072 Gogmamon] itself as the target for this card's effect?

BT4-075.question: What exactly does this card's [When Attacking] effect do?
BT4-075.answer: When this Digimon attacks, no matter what its target is, this effect allows your opponent to choose any of their unsuspended Digimon. If they do, this Digimon is forced to attack it instead.

BT4-075.question: When attacking with this card, am I required to announce the target of attack?
Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to attack my opponent's unsuspended Digimon?
BT4-075.answer: You can't announce that you're attacking an opponent's unsuspended Digimon, but your opponent can force this Digimon to attack one of their unsuspended Digimon if they choose to.

BT4-075.question: My opponent attacks with [BT4-075 Blastmon]. If I have an unsuspended Digimon in play, am I forced to switch the target of attack to it?
BT4-075.answer: No, the player who is currently being attacked gets to decide whether or not to switch the target. If they choose not to, the attack proceeds as it was originally declared.

BT4-075.question: I have this Digimon in play, unsuspended, when my opponent attacks with [BT4-075 Blastmon]. Can [Blastmon]'s effect be used to switch the target of attack to this Digimon?
BT4-075.answer: Yes, it can. If your opponent uses [Blastmon]'s effect to switch the target of attack, a battle occurs as if this Digimon was attacked normally.

BT4-077.question: If this card is a digivolution card and is trashed by <Digi-Burst>, when does this card return to hand: before or after <Digi-Burst> activates?

BT4-078.question: Can I use this card's effect to trash 2 Option cards in my hand to gain 2 memory?
BT4-078.answer: No, you can only trash 1 Option card per attack, so you can only gain 1 memory.

BT4-084.question: If my opponent uses the effect on a card like [BT2-041 ShineGreymon] to suspend 2 or more of their Tamers, does this card's inherited effect allow me to gain a memory for each Tamer suspended?
BT4-084.answer: No. Even if your opponent suspends multiple Tamers simultaneously, this card's inherited effect treats all of it as a single timing instance, so you only gain 1 memory.

BT4-086.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] effect to delete this card itself to gain 9 memory?
BT4-086.answer: No, this card's [On Play] effect can delete [Cerebusmon], which is a different card from [Cerberusmon: Werewolf Mode]. As such, you can't use it to delete this card itself.

BT4-086.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] effect to delete one of my other [Cerberusmon: Werewolf Mode] cards to gain 9 memory?
BT4-086.answer: No, this card's [On Play] effect can delete [Cerebusmon], which is a different card from [Cerberusmon: Werewolf Mode]. As such, you can't use it to delete this card itself.

BT4-087.question: Do Digimon played from the trash with this card's [When Digivolving] effect also gain <Rush> from this card's [Your Turn] effect?
If I use this card's effect to play a Digimon from the trash, then digivolve that Digimon during the same turn, does that Digimon gain <Rush>?
BT4-087.answer: Yes, it does. Digimon that gain <Rush> from this card's effect keep it after Digivolving, and can attack the turn they come into play.

BT4-088.question: You use this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect to trash a card in your opponent's security stack. Does that card's [Security] effect activate?
Which player chooses the cards to trash from your opponent's hand with this card's [On Deletion] effect?
BT4-088.answer: Your opponent chooses the 2 cards to trash from their hand.

BT4-088.question: While this Digimon is in my battle area, my opponent's Digimon checks my security stack and flips over [BT1-107 Holy Wave]. Its [Security] effect activates, adding a card to my security stack. I ended up with the same number of cards in my security stack, but does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect still activate?
BT4-088.answer: Yes, a card was removed from your security stack, so it activates.

BT4-088.question: I have 2 copies of this Digimon in my battle area when an opponent's Digimon does a security check, removing a card from my security stack. Do the [Opponent's Turn] effects on both copies activate, trashing 2 of my opponent's security cards?
BT4-088.answer: Yes, they both activate, trashing 2 of your opponent's security cards.

BT4-088.question: If my opponent uses a card like [BT2-020 Gallantmon] to trash a card in my security directly, can I activate this card's effect?

BT4-090.question: I pay memory to digivolve into this Digimon. Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack even though my memory gauge is now at 1 or greater on my opponent's side?
BT4-090.answer: Yes, you can. It doesn't become your opponent's turn until the attack ends or you declare that you're not making an attack.

BT4-090.question: I play a Digimon, then digivolve into this card on the same turn. Can I attack with it?
BT4-090.answer: No, this effect doesn't ignore the ironclad rule that Digimon can't attack the turn they came into play, so you can't attack.

BT4-090.question: If I have other effects that activate on digivolution, can I attack before activating those effects after digivolving into this card?
BT4-090.answer: No. You can activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect first and announce your attack, but you must activate all other effects before making the attack itself.

BT4-090.question: Can I attack my opponent's unsuspended Digimon with this card when not attacking through its [When Digivolving] effect?

BT4-091.question: Can I activate this card's [When Digivolving] skill against the same Digimon twice in a row?
Can I activate this card's [When Digivolving] skill once, take a different action, then activate it a second time?

BT4-094.question: Does this card's effect grant +1000 DP no matter what color my Digimon are?
BT4-094.answer: Yes, there's no color specified, so the +1000 DP is granted no matter what color your Digimon are.

BT4-095.question: Can I only activate this card's [Your Turn] effect when digivolving into a Digimon with [When Digivolving] <Digi-Burst>?
BT4-095.answer: No, you can activate it when digivolving into any Digimon with <Digi-Burst>.

BT4-097.question: When my opponent's Digimon attacks and checks my security, I activate this card's effect to gain 1 memory, moving the memory counter to 1 on my side. Does the attack end, even if my opponent's Digimon has checks remaining from <Security Attack +1>?
BT4-097.answer: No, as long as there are attacks and effects that have triggered but haven't finished resolving yet, the attack continues regardless of the memory gauge's current position.

BT4-097.question: While this Tamer is in my battle area, my opponent's Digimon checks my security stack and flips over [BT1-107 Holy Wave]. Its [Security] effect activates, adding a card to my security stack. The number of cards in my security stack remained the same, but can I still suspend this card to gain 1 memory?
BT4-097.answer: Yes, because a card was removed from your security stack.

BT4-097.question: While this Tamer is in my battle area, I use [BT1-087 Matt Ishida]'s effect to add a yellow card from my security stack to my hand, triggering <Recovery +1 (Deck)> and adding a card to my security stack. The number of cards in my security stack remained the same, but can I still suspend this card to gain 1 memory?
BT4-097.answer: Yes, because a card was removed from your security stack.

BT4-097.question: If my opponent uses a card like [BT2-020 Gallantmon] to trash a card in my security directly, can I activate this card's effect?
If I activate an effect like [BT4-104 Blinding Ray] to remove cards from my own security stack, can I activate this card's effect?
If this card is played by its [Security] effect, can I suspend it to gain 1 memory?
BT4-097.answer:
"No, you can't.
Since this card hasn't been played when it is revealed from your security, the condition for [When a card is removed from your security stack] can't be triggered, so this card's effect can't be activated."

BT4-097.question: My security cards were revealed due to the [When Digivolving] effect of this opponent's card, and 1 of them was trashed. Can I treat this as "when a card is removed from your security stack" and activate [BT4-097 Kari Kamiya]'s effect?
BT4-097.answer:
Yes, you can activate it.
When a revealed card is trashed from the deck or security stack, it is not considered to be trashed from the deck or security stack, but it is considered that a card was removed from the security stack, so [BT4-097 Kari Kamiya]'s effect can be activated.

BT4-098.question: I use this card on one of my Digimon, which I use to attack an opponent's Digimon. Does this count as the Digimon being blocked? Do I gain 3 memory?
BT4-098.answer: No, your opponent has to use <Blocker> to block the attack in order for you to gain 3 memory.

BT4-098.question: I activate this card's [Security] effect. I move a Digimon from my breeding area to the battle area, then play a Digimon from my hand. Do these Digimon get <Security Attack +1> from this card's effect?
BT4-098.answer: Yes. The effect applies to all of your Digimon, including those that enter the battle area after the start of your turn.

BT4-100.question: Can I use this card when my opponent doesn't have a Digimon with 6000 DP or less in play to play a Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less from my hand without paying its memory cost?

BT4-101.question: I use this card to grant my Digimon this card's effect. I then use one of my Digimon to attack an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards. Does my opponent's Digimon get deleted in battle?
BT4-101.answer:
No, it's deleted by this card's effect, not by battle.
As such, effects that read, "deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives," and effects like <Retaliation> don't activate.

BT4-101.question: My opponent uses this card during their turn, then attacks one of my Digimon with no digivolution cards. Can I block with one of my other Digimon to prevent that Digimon from being deleted?
BT4-101.answer: No. This card's effect deletes your Digimon before blocker timing.

BT4-101.question: My opponent uses this card during their turn, then attacks one of my Digimon with no digivolution cards. If I block with one of my other Digimon, will it be deleted by this card's effect?
BT4-101.answer: No, the effect granted by this card will only delete the Digimon that was the target of the attack. If you block to force the target of attack to change, the blocking Digimon won't be deleted, and the battle will occur normally.

BT4-101.question: One of my Digimon has been granted the effect from this card. If I use it to attack an opponent's Digimon with higher DP, is my Digimon deleted after losing the battle?
BT4-101.answer: No, you can delete your opponent's Digimon with this card's effect before the battle begins. The attacking Digimon is not deleted.

BT4-101.question: I use this card, then attack an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards using a Digimon with <Piercing>. Does <Piercing> take effect?
BT4-101.answer: No, a Digimon with <Piercing> has to attack and delete an opponent's Digimon and survive the battle, but this card's effect deletes the opposing Digimon before the battle begins. As such, <Piercing> does not apply.

BT4-101.question: I use [BT-112 Dimension Scissor], which allows 1 of my Digimon to unsuspend every time it deletes an opponent's Digimon. If I then use this card and attack an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards, can I unsuspend my Digimon using Dimension Scissor's effect after deleting the opponent's Digimon using this card's effect?
BT4-101.answer: No, Dimension Scissor requires the Digimon to attack and delete an opponent's Digimon and survive the battle. This card's effect deletes the opposing Digimon before the battle begins, so the effect doesn't apply.

BT4-101.question: I use this card, then attack an opponent's Digimon with 1 digivolution card. If I use a [When Attacking] effect to trash the opposing Digimon's digivolution card, what happens?
BT4-101.answer:
The opposing Digimon isn't deleted by the effect granted by this card.
If the opponent's Digimon has 1 or more digivolution cards at the time you declare the attack, it can't be targeted by the effect granted by this card, even if it loses all of its digivolution cards later.

BT4-102.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand, then return up to 2 of my opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to their owners' hands?
BT4-102.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

BT4-102.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my token that was played as a Digimon from the battle area to the hand, then return up to 2 of my opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to their owners' hands?
BT4-102.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your token is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be removed from the game instead of being returned to the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

BT4-103.question: My opponent has 7 cards in hand. I use this card to return their Digimon to their hand, resulting in them having 8 cards in hand. Does my opponent place that Digimon at the bottom of their deck?
BT4-103.answer: No, this card's effect already returned the Digimon to their hand. The effect doesn't activate again, and the Digimon you chose remains in your opponent's hand.

BT4-104.question: If I activate an effect like [BT4-104 Blinding Ray] to remove cards from my own security stack, can I activate this card's effect?
If I use this card when my security stack is empty, do I gain 2 memory?
BT4-104.answer: Yes. When your security stack is empty, you gain 2 memory.

BT4-105.question: I use this card's effect to place a Digimon on top of my security stack. Does that Digimon's [On Deletion] effect(s) activate?
BT4-105.answer: It wasn't deleted, so [On Deletion] effects don't activate.

BT4-105.question: Can I use this card's effect to place my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] on top of my security stack from the battle area?
BT4-105.answer:
No, you can't.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to place in the security stack, according to the rules it will be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the security stack.
A card isn't actually added to the security stack, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the security stack" don't trigger.

BT4-105.question: Can I use this card's effect to place my token that was played as a Digimon on top of my security stack from the battle area?
BT4-105.answer:
No, you can't.
If your token is chosen as the target to place in the security stack, according to the rules it's removed from the game instead of being placed in the security stack.
A card isn't actually added to the security stack, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the security stack" don't trigger.

BT4-105.question: If I choose my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] or token that is treated as a Digimon in the battle area as the target for this card's effect, it isn't placed in the security stack. In such cases, do "when a card is removed from the security stack" effects trigger because a card wasn't added to the security stack even though it normally should have been added?

I used this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use BT4-105 [Tactical Retreat!], then I placed this card itself on top of the security stack. At such times, after using BT4-105 [Tactical Retreat!], will it be placed in the security stack by the "place the Option card used with this effect on top of your security stack face down instead of placing it in your trash" effect?
BT4-105.answer: Yes, it will be placed in the security stack.

BT4-105.question: If I use [BT4-105 Tactical Retreat!] on this card, can I place it on top of my security stack face down?
BT4-105.answer: No. This card is a Digi-Egg card, so if it would be moved to your security stack, it’s instead placed at the bottom of your Digi-Egg deck face down.

BT4-108.question: Can I use this card when I have no Digimon to suspend an opponent's Digimon, or when my opponent has no Digimon to unsuspend my own Digimon?

BT4-109.question: I use this card's effect to give a Digimon +3000 DP. If that Digimon now has 16000 DP or more, does it gain <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>?
BT4-109.answer: Yes, it does. Even if the Digimon's original DP is less than 16000, if it becomes 16000 or greater after getting +3000 DP from this card's effect, it gains <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>.

BT4-109.question: I use this card's effect to give one of my Digimon <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>. If another effect reduces that Digimon to 15000 or less, does it lose <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>?
BT4-109.answer: No. Once the Digimon meets the conditions to gain <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>, it keeps them until the end of your opponent's next turn, even if its DP is reduced to 15000 or less.

BT4-109.question: I use this card's effect to give a Digimon +3000 DP, but it still has less than 16000 DP. If I then use another DP-boosting effect to raise its DP to 16000 or more, does it gain <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>?
BT4-109.answer: No, it doesn't. The Digimon must have 16000 DP at the time this card's effect is activated for it to gain <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>.

BT4-110.question: This card has an effect that reads, "For each of your Digimon with [D-Brigade] in its type, add +1 to the maximum play cost of the Digimon you can choose with this effect." What does this mean?
BT4-110.answer: If you have a Digimon with [D-Brigade] in its type, you can choose a Digimon with a play cost of 4 or less. (3 or less + 1 = 4 or less.) If you have 2 Digimon with [D-Brigade], you can choose a play cost of 5 or less, if you have 3 Digimon it becomes 6 or less, and so on.

BT4-111.question: If I use this card when I have 9 cards in my trash, does this card become the 10th card in my trash, allowing me to gain 1 memory?
BT4-111.answer: No, Option cards go to the trash after their effects activate, so you still have 9 cards in your trash when the effect checks to see how many cards there are. You don't gain 1 memory.

BT4-114.question: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect on [AncientGarurumon] itself?
What cards are unsuspended by this card's [When Attacking] effect?
BT4-114.answer: Up to 2 total of your Digimon with [Garurumon] in their names or your [Hybrid] trait Digimon.

BT5-003.question: If this card is a digivolution card, does the Digimon it's part of count towards this card's inherited effect?
BT5-003.answer: Yes, the Digimon this card is a digivolution card in counts towards the effect.

BT5-006.question: This card is a digivolution card in one of my Digimon. An opponent's effect causes that Digimon and another one of my Digimon to reach 0 DP simultaneously. Does this card's inherited effect give the Digimon it's a part of +2000 DP, protecting it from being deleted?
BT5-006.answer: No. The Digimon is reduced to 0 DP and deleted before this card's inherited effect activates.

BT5-007.question: If the 3 cards revealed with this card's effect don't include both a Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name and a Digimon card with [Omnimon] in its name, am I allowed to add one of the cards to my hand, or do both cards have to be present?
BT5-007.answer: You can add one of the cards to your hand. As long as one of the Digimon cards revealed has either [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name, you can add it to your hand.

BT5-008.question: What does this card's "can't reduce digivolution costs" effect do, exactly?
BT5-008.answer:
It negates effects that read, "reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by X," like <Digisorption> and [BT3-103 Hidden Potential Discovered!].
Even if your opponent activates effects like these, it won't reduce the memory cost of their digivolutions. They have to pay the digivolution cost on the card in order to digivolve.

BT5-008.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. If I activate <Digisorption> on a card in my hand, can I reduce digivolution costs with it?

My opponent has this Digimon in play. Can I use effects like [BT2-111 Beelzemon]'s "digivolve into this card in your hand for a memory cost of X, ignoring this card's digivolution requirements" effect?
BT5-008.answer: Yes. [BT2-111 Beelzemon]'s effect doesn't reduce digivolution costs--it allows you to ignore digivolution requirements and digivolve for a specific memory cost, so you can still activate it.

BT5-009.question: If the 5 cards revealed with this card's effect don't include both a Digimon card with [Shoutmon] in its name and a Digimon card with <Blitz>, am I allowed to add one of the cards to my hand, or do both cards have to be present?
BT5-009.answer: You can add a card to your hand. As long as one of the Digimon cards revealed has either [Shoutmon] in its name or <Blitz>, you can add it to your hand.

BT5-009.question: If the 5 cards revealed with this card's effect include 2 copies of [BT5-019 ShoutmonDX], can I add both copies to my hand?
BT5-009.answer: Yes, [BT5-019 ShoutmonDX] has [Shoutmon] in its name, and it also has <Blitz>. The effect is looking for "1 Digimon card with [Shoutmon] in its name and 1 Digimon card with <Blitz>," which means you can add both to your hand.

BT5-009.question: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?
BT5-009.answer: 1 card with [Shoutmon] in its name and 1 card with <Blitz>.

BT5-014.question: Can I digivolve into this card from a [Shoutmon] in my breeding area?
BT5-014.answer: No, you can't digivolve from a [Shoutmon] in your breeding area using this card's effect.

BT5-014.question: Do I have to attack with <Blitz> to get <Security Attack +1> from this card's inherited effect?
BT5-014.answer: No. As long as the Digimon this card is a digivolution card in has <Blitz>, it gains <Security Attack +1>, regardless of whether it attacks or not.

BT5-014.question: Can I digivolve one of my [Shoutmon] in the battle area into this card in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?

BT5-017.question: This card has 2 [When Digivolving] effects. If <Blitz> resolves first, does the other [When Digivolving] effect resolve after the attack ends?
BT5-017.answer: No. If you activate <Blitz> first, after activating any [When Attacking] or [When one of your Digimon attacks] effects, you activate the other [When Digivolving] effect before the counter timing occurs.

BT5-018.question: I attack with this Digimon, and use its [When Attacking] effect to trash a red Digimon card with 3000 DP in my hand to give this Digimon +3000 DP. If I use an effect to attack again in the same turn and use this card's effect to trash a red Digimon with 1000 DP in my hand, does this Digimon gain a total of +4000 DP? Or does it go from getting +3000 DP to just +1000 DP?
BT5-018.answer: The effect persists during the same turn, so the Digimon gains a total of +4000 DP.

BT5-019.question: If the 5 cards revealed with this card's effect include 2 copies of [BT5-019 ShoutmonDX], can I add both copies to my hand?
BT5-019.answer: Yes, [BT5-019 ShoutmonDX] has [Shoutmon] in its name, and it also has <Blitz>. The effect is looking for "1 Digimon card with [Shoutmon] in its name and 1 Digimon card with <Blitz>," which means you can add both to your hand.

BT5-019.question: I digivolve a level 5 Digimon into this card. Can I place a red level 4 or lower Digimon card or level 7 Digimon card from my hand at the top of this card's digivolution cards?

I use this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to place a level 3 Digimon card at the top of its digivolution cards. This Digimon is then targeted with a <De-Digivolve 1> effect, trashing this card. What happens to the Digimon?
BT5-019.answer: It becomes a level 3 Digimon. The digivolution cards placed below it remain, and their inherited effects can still be activated.

BT5-019.question: I use this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to place a level 3 Digimon card at the top of its digivolution cards. This Digimon is then targeted with a <De-Digivolve 2> effect. What happens?
BT5-019.answer: The <De-Digivolve> effect trashes this card, and the Digimon becomes a level 3 Digimon. <De-Digivolve> can't be used to trash any more cards once the Digimon it's targeting becomes level 3, and the effect ends. Any digivolution cards placed below it remain, and their inherited effects can still be activated.

BT5-019.question: Multiple effects trigger when this card digivolves. In what order can they be activated?
BT5-019.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

BT5-019.question: This card has 2 [When Digivolving] effects. If <Blitz> resolves first, does the other [When Digivolving] effect resolve after the attack ends?
BT5-019.answer: No. If you activate <Blitz> first, after activating any [When Attacking] or [When one of your Digimon attacks] effects, you activate the other [When Digivolving] effect before the counter timing occurs.

BT5-020.question: If the 3 cards revealed with this card's effect don't include both a Digimon card with [Garurumon] in its name and a Digimon card with [Omnimon] in its name, am I allowed to add one of the cards to my hand, or do both cards have to be present?
BT5-020.answer: You can add one of the cards to your hand. As long as one of the Digimon cards revealed has either [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name, you can add it to your hand.

BT5-021.question: What does this card's "can't reduce digivolution costs" effect do, exactly?
BT5-021.answer:
It negates effects that read, "reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by X," like <Digisorption> and [BT3-103 Hidden Potential Discovered!].
Even if your opponent activates effects like these, it won't reduce the memory cost of their digivolutions. They have to pay the digivolution cost on the card in order to digivolve.

BT5-021.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. If I activate <Digisorption> on a card in my hand, will I be able to reduce digivolution costs with it?

My opponent has this Digimon in play. Can I use effects like [BT2-111 Beelzemon]'s "digivolve into this card in your hand for a memory cost of X, ignoring this card's digivolution requirements" effect?
BT5-021.answer: Yes. [BT2-111 Beelzemon]'s effect doesn't reduce digivolution costs--it allows you to ignore digivolution requirements and digivolve for a specific memory cost, so you can still activate it.

BT5-021.question: If a Digimon such as BT5-021 [Syakomon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and digivolve 1 of my Digimon into a specified card?
BT5-021.answer: You can activate the effect and digivolve, but its cost won't be reduced.

BT5-021.question: If a Digimon such as BT5-021 [Syakomon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and digivolve 1 of my Digimon into a specified card?
BT5-021.answer: You can activate the effect and digivolve, but its cost won't be reduced.

BT5-021.question: If a Digimon such as BT5-021 [Syakomon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and digivolve 1 of my Digimon into a specified card?
BT5-021.answer: You can activate the effect and digivolve, but its cost won't be reduced.

BT5-021.question: If a Digimon such as [BT5-021 Syakomon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and digivolve 1 of my Digimon into a specified card?
BT5-021.answer: You can activate the effect and digivolve, but its cost won't be reduced.

BT5-022.question: When I use this card's inherited effect to return an opponent's Digimon to its owner's hand, can I gain 1 memory?
BT5-022.answer: No. When you return a Digimon to its owner's hand, the game doesn't treat the digivolution cards as being trashed, so you don't gain 1 memory.

BT5-022.question: When I use this card's inherited effect to trash the digivolution cards of 2 of my opponent's Digimon at the same time, can I gain 2 memory?
BT5-022.answer: No. Even if you trash the digivolution cards of 2 of your opponent's Digimon at the same time, you can only use this effect to gain 1 memory per turn.

BT5-030.question: This Digimon gains <Blocker> by an effect. If I block with this Digimon in response to an opponent's attack, what happens?
BT5-030.answer:
Battle occurs as normal.
This card's effect essentially means "this Digimon can't be chosen as a target of attack by your opponent," which means that if you block with this Digimon, the target of attack can still be switched to this Digimon.

BT5-030.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. Can I use [BT4-090 Chaosmon]'s [When Digivolving] effect to attack it?
I have this Digimon in play, unsuspended, when my opponent attacks with [BT4-075 Blastmon]. Can [Blastmon]'s effect be used to switch the target of attack to this Digimon?
BT5-030.answer: Yes, it can. If your opponent uses [Blastmon]'s effect to switch the target of attack, a battle occurs as if this Digimon was attacked normally.

BT5-032.question: I attack with this Digimon when my opponent has no Digimon in play with no digivolution cards. I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to trash the digivolution cards of an opponent's Digimon. If this results in my opponent having a Digimon card with no digivolution cards in play, can I activate <Jamming> on the same attack?
BT5-032.answer: Yes. If this card's [When Attacking] effect results in an opponent's Digimon having no digivolution cards, this card gains <Jamming>.

BT5-032.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. I attack my opponent with a Digimon that has <Security Attack +1>, and flip over [BT1-101 Howling Crusher] from their security stack. If its [Security] effect results in the attacking Digimon having no digivolution cards, does the attack end immediately?
BT5-032.answer: No. You've already declared the attack, so even if your attacking Digimon loses its digivolution card, [Hexeblaumon]'s effect doesn't end the attack midway.

BT5-032.question: I attack my opponent with this Digimon, which has <Security Attack +1>, and flip over a Digimon card with a [Security] effect during the first security check. If this results in a Digimon with no digivolution cards entering my opponent's battle area, does this Digimon gain <Jamming> starting with the next security check?
BT5-032.answer: No. This card's [When Attacking] effect has already finished resolving. Even if a Digimon with no digivolution cards enters play afterwards, this card doesn't gain <Jamming>.

BT5-033.question: What does this card's "can't reduce digivolution costs" effect do, exactly?
BT5-033.answer:
It negates effects that read, "reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by X," like <Digisorption> and [BT3-103 Hidden Potential Discovered!].
Even if your opponent activates effects like these, it won't reduce the memory cost of their digivolutions. They have to pay the digivolution cost on the card in order to digivolve.

BT5-033.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. If I activate <Digisorption> on a card in my hand, will I be able to reduce digivolution costs with it?

My opponent has this Digimon in play. Can I use effects like [BT2-111 Beelzemon]'s "digivolve into this card in your hand for a memory cost of X, ignoring this card's digivolution requirements" effect?
BT5-033.answer: Yes. [BT2-111 Beelzemon]'s effect doesn't reduce digivolution costs--it allows you to ignore digivolution requirements and digivolve for a specific memory cost, so you can still activate it.

BT5-034.question: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?
BT5-034.answer: Up to 2 total yellow [Warrior] trait Digimon cards and yellow [Holy Warrior] trait Digimon cards.

BT5-035.question: Does this card's effect count this Digimon itself?
BT5-035.answer: Yes, it does. This Digimon counts toward this card's effect.

BT5-035.question: I have 2 Digimon in play. Can I use this card's effect to give -1000 DP each to 2 of my opponent's Digimon?
BT5-035.answer: No, you can't. The effect only targets 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

BT5-035.question: After playing this Digimon, I play another Digimon during the same turn. Since I now have more Digimon in play, can I give my opponent's Digimon an additional -1000 DP?
BT5-035.answer: No, you can't. The [On Play] effect has already finished activating.

BT5-037.question: What does "Look at your security stack" mean, exactly?
BT5-037.answer: It means you can look at all of the cards in your security stack, without revealing them to your opponent. When you choose a card in your security stack to add to your hand, reveal it to your opponent. The other cards should remain hidden.

BT5-037.question: What happens if there are no cards in my security stack that can be added to my hand with this card?
BT5-037.answer: <Security +1 (Deck)> doesn't occur. Shuffle your security stack, and the effect ends.

BT5-038.question: I flip over an opponent's Security Digimon during a security check, and this card's inherited effect reduces its DP to 0. Is the Digimon deleted on the spot, without a battle?
BT5-038.answer: No. Even if a Security Digimon is reduced to 0 DP, it still battles with the Digimon performing the security check.

BT5-038.question: This card's inherited effect reduces a Security Digimon's DP to 0, but it has a [Security] effect. What happens?
If a Security Digimon has its DP reduced by this card's inherited effect and is later played due to its [Security] effect, does it still have its DP reduced when it enters play?
BT5-038.answer: No. It's no longer a Security Digimon once it enters play, so it doesn't have its DP reduced by this card's effect.

BT5-041.question: I flip over an opponent's Security Digimon during a security check, and this card's inherited effect reduces its DP to 0. Is the Digimon deleted on the spot, without a battle?
BT5-041.answer: No. Even if a Security Digimon is reduced to 0 DP, it still battles with the Digimon performing the security check.

BT5-041.question: This card's inherited effect reduces a Security Digimon's DP to 0, but it has a [Security] effect. What happens?
A Security Digimon has its DP reduced by this card's inherited effect. If that Security Digimon is later played by its [Security] effect, does it still have its DP reduced when it enters play?
BT5-041.answer: No. It's no longer a Security Digimon once it enters play, so it doesn't have its DP reduced by this card's effect.

BT5-044.question: My opponent moves a Digimon from their breeding area to their battle area during the breeding phase. Does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate?
BT5-044.answer: Yes, it activates during the breeding phase.

BT5-044.question: During a security check, my opponent's Security Digimon has its DP reduced to 0 by this card's [Your Turn] effect. Is the Security Digimon deleted on the spot, without a battle?
BT5-044.answer: No. Even if a Security Digimon is reduced to 0 DP, it still battles with the Digimon performing the security check.

BT5-044.question: This card's [Your Turn] effect reduces a Security Digimon's DP to 0, but it has a [Security] effect. What happens?
A Security Digimon has its DP reduced by this card's [Your Turn] effect. If that Security Digimon is later played by its [Security] effect, does it still have its DP reduced when it enters play?
BT5-044.answer: No. It's no longer a Security Digimon once it enters play, so it doesn't have its DP reduced by this card's effect.

BT5-045.question: What cards can be played using this card's [When Attacking] effect?
BT5-045.answer: 1 yellow level 3 Digimon card or 1 yellow [Warrior] trait Digimon card.

BT5-047.question: This card is being deleted. Can I use this card's effect to place it at the bottom of 1 of my green Digimon's digivolution cards?

This card that was targeted by [BT11-043 KingSukamon]'s effect and had its name changed to [Sukamon] is deleted. If I have no other [Palmon] in the trash, can I place this same card at the bottom of the digivolution cards of one of my green Digimon from the trash with it's [On Deletion] effect?
BT5-047.answer:
Yes, you can.
The [On Deletion] effect is activated while treated as [Sukamon], but the name changing effect is lost when the card is deleted and placed in the trash, so you can treat this card as a [Palmon] card.

BT5-059.question: If the 5 cards revealed with this card's effect don't include both a Digimon card with [Unidentified] in its type and an [Arata Sanada] card, am I allowed to add one of the cards to my hand, or do both cards have to be present?
BT5-059.answer: You can add a card to your hand. As long as one of the cards revealed is either a Digimon card with [Unidentified] in its type or an [Arata Sanada] card, you can add it to your hand.

BT5-059.question: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?

BT5-060.question: I use this card's [On Play] effect to check the top card of my deck. What happens to that card?
BT5-060.answer: After checking the card, place it back on top of your deck face down.

BT5-063.question: A Digimon has <Rush> thanks to this card's inherited effect. If that Digimon digivolves into a Digimon with a different name, can that Digimon attack the same turn it entered play?
BT5-063.answer: No, it can't. The Digimon loses <Rush> when its name changes, so it can't attack.

BT5-065.question: If I use this card's effect to play a Digimon, is it treated as a Security Digimon even in my battle area?
BT5-065.answer: No, it's treated as a normal Digimon once it comes into play.

BT5-065.question: Can I play this Digimon with its [Security] effect even if it loses the battle against the attacking Digimon?
BT5-065.answer: Yes, regardless of the battle's outcome, you get to play this Digimon at the end of the battle.

BT5-065.question: This card is flipped over during a security check, but the attacking Digimon still has security checks remaining. Is this card played off its [Security] effect first, or do I have to wait until my opponent finishes the rest of their security checks?
BT5-065.answer: This Digimon is played after the battle with the attacking Digimon ends, and before the next check is performed.

BT5-067.question: Can I digivolve into this card from a [Keramon] in my breeding area?
BT5-067.answer: No, you can't digivolve from a [Keramon] in your breeding area using this card's effect.

BT5-067.question: What's a token?
BT5-067.answer: Tokens are special cards that some effects put into play to represent Digimon or Tamers. This card's effect, for example, plays a token that's treated as a Digimon named [Diaboromon]. For a more detailed explanation of how tokens work, check the official rule manual.

BT5-067.question: Can I digivolve one of my [Keramon] in the battle area into this card in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?

BT5-070.question: This card's <Digi-Burst> effect reads, "Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less. If no Digimon was deleted by this effect..." How does this effect work, exactly?
BT5-070.answer: "If no Digimon was deleted by this effect" refers to times where, when <Digi-Burst> is activated, your opponent doesn't have a Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less in play, or an effect makes it so that there are no Digimon you can delete. Essentially, it means there was no Digimon in play that could be deleted by "Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less."

BT5-070.question: If my opponent has a Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less in play, can I activate this card's <Digi-Burst> and choose not to delete my opponent's Digimon in order to trash the top card of their security stack?
BT5-070.answer: No. If you use this card's <Digi-Burst> and your opponent has a Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less, you must target that Digimon when you activate the effect. If a valid target exists, you must choose it as part of the effect.

BT5-070.question: My opponent has 2 Digimon in play with play costs of 6 or less. One of them has an effect that reads, "This Digimon can't be deleted by your opponent's effects," while the other does not. If I activate this card's <Digi-Burst>, can I choose the Digimon that "can't be deleted by your opponent's effects" in order to trash the top card of my opponent's security stack?
BT5-070.answer: Yes. Digimon with play costs of 6 or less are valid targets. If you choose it, the "can't be deleted by your opponent's effects" will prevent it from being deleted, allowing you to trash the top card of your opponent's security stack instead.

BT5-071.question: This Digimon's DP is reduced to 0 by an opponent's effect. Does this card's [On Deletion] effect activate?
BT5-071.answer: No. When a Digimon is deleted at 0 DP, it's deleted by the game rules, not a card effect, so the game doesn't treat it as if it was deleted by an effect.

BT5-072.question: Can this card's effect be used to return a level 3 Digimon card with an [On Deletion] inherited effect from my trash to my hand?
BT5-072.answer: No. This effect can't be used to return a level 3 Digimon card with an [On Deletion] inherited effect from your trash to your hand.

BT5-081.question: I use this card's effect to play a card like [BT5-081 ChaosGallantmon], which has an effect that reads, "delete 1 of your other Digimon to..." Does deleting the purple Digimon for this card's effect cause the "delete 1 of your other Digimon" effect to activate?
BT5-081.answer: No. Your purple Digimon has already been deleted when [ChaosGallantmon] enters play, so it doesn't activate.

BT5-081.question: When this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect doesn't delete any of my opponent's Digimon, does the effect let it digivolve into [BT5-081 ChaosGallantmon], [BT9-017 Gallantmon (X Antibody)], or [EX2-073 Gallantmon Crimson Mode]?
BT5-081.answer:
Digivolution into [BT9-017 Gallantmon (X Antibody)] is possible.
Digivolution into [BT5-081 ChaosGallantmon] isn't possible because the digivolution requirements aren't met.
[EX2-073 Gallantmon Crimson Mode] is level 7, so digivolution isn't possible.

BT5-082.question: If I have another Digimon in play, can I choose any one of this card's three effects?
If I don't have another Digimon in play, what order do I activate this card's three effects in?
BT5-082.answer: The owner of the card gets to decide the order they activate in.

BT5-084.question: What's a token?
BT5-084.answer: A token is a special card played from an effect that is treated as a Digimon or Tamer. This card's effect can play tokens treated as Digimon named "Diaboromon." For detailed rules pertaining to tokens, check the rule manual.

BT5-084.question: Do Diaboromon tokens meet the white color requirement?

BT5-085.question: When playing this card, can I delete one of my [Diaboromon] tokens to reduce its play cost by 12?
What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?
BT5-085.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating.
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving] effect" activate.

BT5-085.question: I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack. Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
BT5-085.answer:
Yes, you can.
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

BT5-085.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?

A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
BT5-085.answer:
No, it doesn't count.
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

BT5-086.question: When this card digivolves, can I activate <Blitz> first to attack, then use the "Unsuspend this Digimon" effect to unsuspend this Digimon?
BT5-086.answer: Yes. If you activate <Blitz> first, you declare the attack and suspend the Digimon at that point in time. If you then activate the "Unsuspend this Digimon" effect, you can unsuspend this Digimon itself.

BT5-086.question: When this Digimon is deleted, I activate this card's [All Turns] effect to have this Digimon remain in the battle area. Does this cause "When another Digimon is deleted" effects to activate?
BT5-086.answer: No. This card's [All Turns] effect prevents other effects from deleting this Digimon or returning it to its owner's hand or deck, so it isn't treated as being deleted by the game rules.

BT5-087.question: This [When Digivolving] effect plays up to 2 black and/or purple Digimon cards with play costs of 8 or less from my trash. Can I play cards that weren't trashed using this card's effect?
BT5-087.answer: Yes, you can. Any cards in your trash that are black and/or purple Digimon cards with play costs of 8 or less can be played.

BT5-087.question: What cards can be played using this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
BT5-087.answer: Up to a total of 2 black Digimon cards with play costs of 8 or less or purple Digimon cards with play costs of 8 or less.

BT5-089.question: My opponent has a suspended Digimon with <Reboot>. Upon my turn, can I use this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect to gain 2 memory before that opponent Digimon unsuspends in the unsuspend phase?
BT5-089.answer:
Yes, you can.
[Start of Your Turn] effects trigger and activate before cards are unsuspended for the unsuspend phase.

BT5-089.question: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to reveal cards from my deck, but then choose to not digivolve?
BT5-089.answer:
Yes, you can choose to not digivolve.
In such cases, you return all of the revealed cards to the bottom of your deck in any order.

BT5-089.question: When a digivolution would occur by this card's [Your Turn] effect, when exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw and where do I draw from?
BT5-089.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when this card is placed on top of that Digimon for the digivolution, and you draw from the unrevealed cards in your deck.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

BT5-089.question: If I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before returning the remaining cards to the bottom of the deck?
Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect when I have 2 or fewer cards in my deck?
BT5-089.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you reveal as many cards from your deck as possible.

BT5-089.question: 2 copies of this card are in the battle area. Can I activate the [Your Turn] effect on the 2 copies of this card, reveal 6 cards from the top of my deck, and then digivolve my Digimon into a card among them?
BT5-089.answer:
No, you can't.
When your Digimon attacks, the [Your Turn] effects on the 2 copies of this card trigger simultaneously. Effects that trigger simultaneously can be activated 1 at a time, therefore you can activate the [Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card, and once all effects have been resolved, you can then activate the [Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card.

BT5-089.question: When a green level 5 Digimon with a [When Attacking] effect attacks, in what order can this card's [Your Turn] effect and the attacking Digimon's [When Attacking] effect activate?
BT5-089.answer:
The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
However, if this card's [Your Turn] effect is activated first and that Digimon digivolves, its [When Attacking] effect is considered to be lost and can no longer activate.

BT5-089.question: My green Digimon that isn't level 5 attacks, and another effect digivolves it into a green level 5 Digimon. Can I then activate this card's [Your Turn] effect?
BT5-089.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
This card's [Your Turn] effect triggers when a green level 5 Digimon attacks. It doesn't trigger when other Digimon attack, therefore it can't be activated.

BT5-090.question: What's a token?
BT5-090.answer: Tokens are special cards that some effects put into play to represent Digimon or Tamers. This card's effect, for example, plays a token that's treated as a Digimon named [Diaboromon]. For a more detailed explanation of how tokens work, check the official rule manual.

BT5-091.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect also give "[When Attacking] Lose 1 memory" to my level 3 Digimon?
If I have 2 copies of this Tamer in play and attack with a level 3 Digimon, do I lose 2 memory?
BT5-091.answer: Yes. Each effect activates separately, resulting in you losing a total of 2 memory.

BT5-092.question: When does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger, exactly?
BT5-092.answer:
It will trigger when a Digimon is played by an effect such as the effect on BT5-092 [Nokia Shiramine] or when a Digimon digivolves by an effect such as the effect on P-103 [Offense Training].
It won't trigger for effects that aren't digivolution effects, such as BT4-011 [Agunimon]'s effect that treats a Tamer as a level 3 red Digimon or BT6-060 [Deputymon]'s effect that allows digivolution requirements to be ignored.

BT5-093.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If [BT5-093 Tai Kamiya & Matt Ishida], [BT9-084 Tai Kamiya & Kari Kamiya], or [P-012 Tai Kamiya (V-Tamer)] is one of the cards revealed, can I add that card to my hand?
BT5-093.answer: Yes, those are Tamer cards with [Tai Kamiya] in their names, so you can add one to your hand.

BT5-093.question: Can I play cards that include [Tai Kamiya] in their names, like [BT5-093 Tai Kamiya & Matt Ishida], with this card's inherited effect?
BT5-093.answer: No, this card's inherited effect can only play cards specifically named [Tai Kamiya].

BT5-094.question: I have a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer card. Can I use this card's effect to place a red level 4 or lower Digimon card from my hand at the bottom of one of my Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer card?

I use this card's effect to place a Digimon card under one of my Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer card. If <De-Digivolve> causes that card to become a Tamer card again, what happens to the digivolution cards under it?
BT5-094.answer: It remains stacked on top of the digivolution cards, but since it's no longer a Digimon, it can no longer activate inherited effects. If it digivolves back into a Digimon, it will be able to use inherited effects again.

BT5-097.question: When choosing which Digimon to trash a digivolution card from and which Digimon to return to its owner's deck with this card's effect, can I choose different cards for each one?

BT5-099.question: If I have 2 Digimon in play, can I activate this card's effect to give an opponent's Digimon -3000 DP twice, for a total of -6000 DP?

BT5-101.question: If my opponent has a level 7 Digimon in play and I use this card when my opponent's security stack is empty, do I win the game?
BT5-101.answer: No. There are no security cards to trash, but this doesn't allow you to win the game.

BT5-103.question: My opponent activates this card's [Security] effect. If I then attack with a Digimon that has <Piercing> and delete an opponent's Digimon in battle, do I check my opponent's security cards?
BT5-103.answer: Yes, it's possible to attack your opponent's Digimon, which means you can perform checks off of <Piercing>.

BT5-104.question: My opponent doesn't have a Digimon I can target with <De-Digivolve 2> in play. Can I still use this card to create a [Diaboromon] token?
I only have a [Diaboromon] token in my battle area. Can I use this card to create a new [Diaboromon] token?

BT5-105.question: My opponent doesn't have a Digimon I can target with <De-Digivolve 3> in play. Can I still use this card to delete all of my opponent's Digimon with play costs of 3 or less?

BT5-107.question: I use this card's effect to play a card like [BT5-081 ChaosGallantmon], which has an effect that reads, "delete 1 of your other Digimon to..." Does deleting the purple Digimon for this card's effect cause the "delete 1 of your other Digimon" effect to activate?
BT5-107.answer: No. Your purple Digimon has already been deleted when [ChaosGallantmon] enters play, so it doesn't activate.

BT5-108.question: Can I activate this card's effect if my opponent doesn't have both an unsuspended level 4 and level 5 Digimon in play?
BT5-108.answer: Yes. As long as your opponent has either an unsuspended level 4 or level 5 in Digimon in play, you can activate this card's effect.

BT5-108.question: What cards are deleted by this card's [Main] effect?
BT5-108.answer: 1 of your opponent's unsuspended level 4 Digimon and 1 of your opponent's unsuspended level 5 Digimon.

BT5-109.question: After using this card, can I reduce the digivolution cost of my level 6 Digimon digivolving to level 7 when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?

After using this Digimon's effect to digivolve it into [AncientGreymon], I use [BT5-109 Mega Digimon Fusion!] to digivolve it into a level 7 Digimon. At the end of the turn, which effect takes precedence: This card's "delete this Digimon at the end of the turn" effect, or [Mega Digimon Fusion!]'s "return the Digimon that digivolved with this effect to the bottom of its owner's deck" effect?
BT5-109.answer: They both trigger at the same time, so you can choose which order to activate them in. The one you activate first takes precedence.

BT5-109.question: After using this Digimon's effect to digivolve it into [AncientGarurumon], I use [BT5-109 Mega Digimon Fusion!] to digivolve it into a level 7 Digimon. At the end of the turn, which effect takes precedence: This card's "delete this Digimon at the end of the turn" effect, or [Mega Digimon Fusion!]'s "return the Digimon that digivolved with this effect to the bottom of its owner's deck" effect?
BT5-109.answer: They both trigger at the same time, so you can choose which order to activate them in. The one you activate first takes precedence.

BT5-110.question: Does this card's effect delete all of my Digimon and Tamers, too?

I have this card and BT19-053 [QueenBeemon] in the battle area. My opponent uses BT5-110 [All Delete] and I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my Digimon would leave the battle area at the same time, and this Digimon is prevented from leaving. What happens if BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect activates afterward?
BT5-110.answer:
BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect places all of your Digimon with the [Royal Base] trait into your security stack.
In such cases, this card's [All Turns] effect prevents this Digimon from being deleted, but if BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect activates afterward, you can place all of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon that were affected by the deletion effect into your security stack.

BT5-111.question: Can I digivolve a Digimon with [Omnimon] in its name in the breeding area into this card?
Can I use a "digivolve your Digimon" effect to digivolve my Digimon with [Omnimon] in its name in the battle area into this card in my hand?
Can I trash just 1 digivolution card for the conditions of this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?
BT5-111.answer:
No, you can't.
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.
The conditions for this [Opponent's Turn] effect require you to trash the specified number of digivolution cards.

BT5-111.question: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
BT5-111.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

BT5-111.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
BT5-111.answer:
Yes, such attacks can be ended.
"End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

BT5-111.question: Do [End of Attack] effects activate if I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect and end the attack from an opponent's Digimon?

Can I use this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect to play [BT5-111 Omnimon X Anti-body], [BT10-068 Gankoomon (X Antibody)], and [BT10-086 Omnimon (X Antibody)] from the digivolution cards of my Digimon in the breeding area?

BT5-112.question: What does "without battling" in this card's [Security] effect mean?
BT5-112.answer: If this card is flipped over as a Security Digimon, it's played in its owner's battle area without battling the attacking Digimon. Even if the attacking Digimon has lower DP than this card, no battle occurs, and the attacking Digimon is not deleted.

BT5-112.question: This card is flipped over during a security check. If the attacking Digimon has extra security checks remaining from <Security Attack +>, what happens?
BT5-112.answer: After playing this Digimon, the remaining checks are performed.

BT5-112.question: Can this card's [When Digivolving] effect be used to delete a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?
My opponent only has 1 BT5-112 [Omnimon Zwart Defeat] in the battle area. If that BT5-112 [Omnimon Zwart Defeat] is deleted and this card is chosen as its [On Deletion] effect, is this card deleted?
BT5-112.answer:
Yes, it's deleted.
If this card's [All Turns] effect activates while your opponent has a Digimon with 13000 DP or more, as soon as that Digimon leaves, the effect will no longer be activated.

BT6-001.question: I attack my opponent using a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this Digimon's effect activate?
BT6-001.answer: Yes. Even if the Digimon is blocked, if you declared an attack against your opponent, the effect activates.

BT6-002.question: I activate an effect that reads "Return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to their hand. Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon" to return an opponent's Digimon to their hand. When your opponent's digivolution cards are trashed as a result, can you activate this card's inherited effect?
BT6-002.answer:
No, you can’t.
Trash all of the digivolution cards of those Digimon"" is an explanation of what happens to the digivolution cards of the Digimon when it returns to their hand. It doesn't count as trashing digivolution for the purposes of this card's effect.

BT6-004.question: I attack my opponent using a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this card's effect activate?
BT6-004.answer: No, if you declared an attack against your opponent, this card's effect doesn't activate, even if they use another Digimon to block it.

BT6-006.question: I activate an effect that reads “<Draw 1> (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, trash 1 card in your hand.” Does this card’s inherited effect activate?

BT6-007.question: I have 2 copies of this Digimon in my battle area. If I play a Tamer with [Tai Kamiya] in its name, can I activate the effects on both Digimon to gain a total of 2 memory?
BT6-007.answer: Yes. The effects on both Digimon activate, so you gain 2 memory.

BT6-007.question: I play a Tamer with [Tai Kamiya] in its name from my security using its security effect. If this Digimon’s effect causes the memory gauge to move to 1 or greater on my side, does it immediately become my turn?
BT6-007.answer: No. The turn doesn’t switch over until the attack completely finishes resolving.

BT6-008.question: I make a normal, non-<Blitz> attack with this Digimon. Can I use this card’s inherited effect to draw a card with <Draw 1>?
BT6-008.answer: Yes. As long as a Digimon with <Blitz> is in this card’s digivolution cards, <Draw 1> will activate even if you make a normal, non-<Blitz> attack.

BT6-009.question: This card’s effect reveals 2 copies of the same card with [Huckmon], [Jesmon], or [Sistermon] in their names from the top of my deck. Can I add both copies to my hand?

BT6-011.question: If I have 2 Digimon with [Sistermon] in their names in play, can I use this card’s effect to delete 2 of my opponent’s Digimon with 5000 DP or less?
BT6-011.answer: No. Even if you have multiple Digimon with [Sistermon] in their names in play, you can only use this Digimon’s effect to delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon.

BT6-013.question: Can this Digimon digivolve into a Digimon with “Black/Level 5” digivolution requirements?
BT6-013.answer: Yes. During your turn, this Digimon is treated as both a red and black Digimon, so it can digivolve into a Digimon with black digivolution requirements.

BT6-013.question: This card is in my breeding area. Can I digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a black Digimon?
BT6-013.answer: No, you can't. [Your Turn] effects don't activate from breeding areas, so the card isn't treated as a black card. You can't digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a black Digimon.

BT6-016.question: I use this Digimon’s [When Attacking] effect to play a Digimon card with [Sistermon] in its name. Does this Digimon’s [Your Turn] effect activate?

BT6-017.question: When this Digimon digivolves, can I intentionally choose not to use a 7-cost Option card in my hand to delete 1 of my opponent’s Digimon with 4000 DP or less?
BT6-017.answer: Yes, you can choose not to use an Option card. If you don’t use one, you can delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with 4000 DP or less.

BT6-018.question: If I use this card’s [When Attacking] effect to delete 1 of my opponent’s Digimon with 13000 DP or less, can I use this card’s [Your Turn] effect to trash the top card of my opponent’s security stack?

BT6-019.question: I have 2 copies of this Digimon in my battle area. If I play a Tamer with [Matt Ishida] in its name, can I activate the effects on both Digimon to gain a total of 2 memory?
BT6-019.answer: Yes. The effects on both Digimon activate, so you gain 2 memory.

BT6-019.question: Is a "while your opponent has no Digimon with XX" condition also met when my opponent has no Digimon?

BT6-020.question: Does this card’s inherited effect activate when my opponent has no Digimon in play in their battle area?

BT6-021.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. What happens if an effect is activated that causes you to gain memory on activation and lose memory at end of turn? (i.e. [BT1-090 Gravity Crush], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], [BT1-040 WereGarurumon], [BT1-058 Chirinmon], [BT1-075 Digitamamon], etc.)
BT6-021.answer: You can't use Option/Digimon card effects to gain memory, but you can still lose memory if a card effect specifies as such. At the end of the turn, you’ll lose memory as specified by each effect.

BT6-021.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. Can I gain memory from the security effect of [ST2-13 Hammer Spark]?
BT6-021.answer: No, this Digimon prevents you from gaining memory from security effects.

BT6-024.question: Is a "while your opponent has no Digimon with XX" condition also met when my opponent has no Digimon?

BT6-027.question: Does this card’s inherited effect activate when my opponent has no Digimon in play in their battle area?

BT6-028.question: “Your Digimon can't be blocked by your opponent's Digimon this turn.” How does this effect work, exactly?
BT6-028.answer: If you attack with a Digimon, your opponent's Digimon can’t change the target of attack by blocking.

BT6-031.question: If this card's effect is activated on the opponent's turn, how long does the effect last?
BT6-031.answer: When the effect of this card is activated on the opponent's turn, it lasts until the end of that turn.

BT6-032.question: I have 2 Digimon with this card in their digivolution cards in my battle area, and a card is removed from my security stack. Do the inherited effects on both Digimon activate, activating <Draw 1> twice and drawing me 2 cards?
BT6-032.answer: Yes. Both effects activate, so you can draw a total of 2 cards.

BT6-033.question: When I play this card, does its [On Play] effect force me to trash cards from my security stack until there are 3 cards left?
BT6-033.answer: No, this card’s [On Play] effect allows you to trash any number of cards, from zero cards, up to however many cards you need to trash for you to have 3 cards left in your security stack.

BT6-033.question: How does this card’s [On Play] effect work if I have 3 or fewer cards in my security stack?
BT6-033.answer: You can’t trash any security cards, so the effect does nothing.

BT6-033.question: I have 5 cards in my security stack. Can I use this card’s [On Play] effect to only trash 1 security card and gain 1 memory?

BT6-034.question: Does this card’s inherited effect activate when a security card is removed from my security stack by one of my own effects?

BT6-040.question: Does this card’s inherited effect activate when a security card is removed from my security stack by one of my own effects?

BT6-041.question: Can I activate this card’s effect when my security stack is empty?
BT6-041.answer: No. You must trash a card from your security stack in order to have one of your opponent’s Digimon get -5000 DP.

BT6-044.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect force me to trash the top card of my security stack?
BT6-044.answer: No, this card’s [When Digivolving] effect reads “you may,” so you can choose whether or not to trash the top card of your security stack.

BT6-044.question: Can I activate this card’s [When Digivolving] effect when my security stack is empty?
BT6-044.answer: No. You must trash a card from your security stack in order to activate it.

BT6-044.question: I use this card’s [When Digivolving] effect to trash a card from my security stack. If there are 3 or fewer cards left in my security stack, does this card’s [All Turns] effect trigger?

I have 2 or more copies of this Digimon in play. My opponent attacks with a Digimon, removing a card from my security stack. Do all of the effects on copies of this Digimon activate simultaneously, activating <Recovery +1 (Deck)> for each one?
BT6-044.answer:
Fundamentally, this is possible. However, the effects don’t activate simultaneously, but one at a time in order. Once <Recovery> results in you having 4 cards in your security stack, any remaining copies of the effect don't activate.
Any [BT6-044 Dynasmon] whose effects don’t activate can still be activated later in the turn.

BT6-044.question: An opponent’s Digimon performs a security check, flipping over a card with a [Security] effect. Which activates first: This card’s [All Turns] effect, or the [Security] effect?
BT6-044.answer:
The [Security] effect activates first.
After the [Security] effect and any effects triggered by its activation have finished activating, this card’s [All Turns] effect activates.

BT6-047.question: I use this card’s effect to reveal 5 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a card with [Menoa Bellucci] in its name or a Digimon card with [Eosmon] in its name, can I still add a card to my hand?
BT6-047.answer: Yes, you can. As long as either a card with [Menoa Bellucci] in its name or a Digimon card with [Eosmon] in its name are among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT6-049.question: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?
BT6-049.answer:
Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.
In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.

BT6-049.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
BT6-049.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

BT6-049.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
BT6-049.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

BT6-049.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
BT6-049.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

BT6-049.question: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
Can I choose to not digivolve with this card's 1st effect?
BT6-049.answer:
No, you can't.
For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.

BT6-050.question: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?
BT6-050.answer:
Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.
In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.
