BT6-050.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

BT6-050.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
BT6-050.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

BT6-050.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
BT6-050.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

BT6-050.question: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
Can I choose to not digivolve with this card's 1st effect?
BT6-050.answer:
No, you can't.
For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.

BT6-056.question: Does this card’s [Security] effect activate even if it loses the battle against the attacking Digimon?
BT6-056.answer: Yes, it activates at the end of the battle, regardless of outcome.

BT6-056.question: This card is flipped over during a security check, but the attacking Digimon still has security checks remaining. Does this Digimon’s effect activate first, or do I have to wait until my opponent finishes the rest of their security checks?
BT6-056.answer: This Digimon’s [Security] effect activates after the battle with the attacking Digimon ends, and before the next check is performed.

BT6-058.question: If I use this card's effect to play a Digimon, is it treated as a Security Digimon even in my battle area?
BT6-058.answer: No, it's treated as a normal Digimon once it comes into play.

BT6-058.question: Can I play this Digimon with its [Security] effect even if it loses the battle against the attacking Digimon?
BT6-058.answer: Yes, regardless of the battle's outcome, you get to play this Digimon at the end of the battle.

BT6-058.question: This card is flipped over during a security check, but the attacking Digimon still has security checks remaining. Is this card played off its [Security] effect first, or do I have to wait until my opponent finishes the rest of their security checks?
BT6-058.answer: This Digimon is played after the battle with the attacking Digimon, and before the next check is performed.

BT6-060.question: I use this card’s effect to reveal 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a Digimon card with [Three Musketeers] in its type or a 7-cost Option card, can I still add a card to my hand?
BT6-060.answer: Yes, you can. As long as either a Digimon card with [Three Musketeers] in its type or a 7-cost Option card are among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

BT6-060.question: Can I digivolve this Digimon in the battle area into a card with the [Three Musketeers] trait in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?
When does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger, exactly?
BT6-060.answer:
It will trigger when a Digimon is played by an effect such as the effect on BT5-092 [Nokia Shiramine] or when a Digimon digivolves by an effect such as the effect on P-103 [Offense Training].
It won't trigger for effects that aren't digivolution effects, such as BT4-011 [Agunimon]'s effect that treats a Tamer as a level 3 red Digimon or BT6-060 [Deputymon]'s effect that allows digivolution requirements to be ignored.

BT6-060.question: When does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger, exactly?
BT6-060.answer:
It will trigger when a Digimon digivolves by an effect such as the effect on P-103 [Offense Training].
It won't trigger for effects that aren't digivolution effects, such as BT4-011 [Agunimon]'s effect that treats a Tamer as a level 3 red Digimon or BT6-060 [Deputymon]'s effect that allows digivolution requirements to be ignored.

BT6-060.question: I used a DUAL card with the [Three Musketeers] trait as an Option card from my hand. Can I then use Arts Digivolve to digivolve this card into the card I used, ignoring digivolution requirements?
BT6-060.answer:
No, you can't.
A used Option card is treated as not being in any area until its [Main] effect has been resolved and the card would be trashed.
You can’t ignore digivolution requirements because it isn't treated as a card in the hand.

BT6-060.question: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect at the same time as an effect such as P-107 [Defense Training]'s effect that digivolves?

BT6-061.question: Can this Digimon digivolve into a Digimon with “Red/Level 5” digivolution requirements?
BT6-061.answer: Yes. During your turn, this Digimon is treated as both a red and black Digimon, so it can digivolve into a Digimon with black digivolution requirements.

BT6-061.question: This card is in my breeding area. Can I digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a red Digimon?
BT6-061.answer: No, you can't. [Your Turn] effects don't activate from breeding areas, so the card isn't treated as a red card. You can't digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a red Digimon.

BT6-062.question: My opponent only has 1 unsuspended Digimon in play, and I attack with a Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards. When my opponent blocks and suspends their unsuspended Digimon, does my attacking Digimon immediately lose <Security Attack +1> from this card’s inherited effect?
BT6-062.answer: Yes. As soon as your opponent no longer has an unsuspended Digimon in play, your attacking Digimon loses <Security Attack +1> from this card’s inherited effect.

BT6-065.question: I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to reveal cards from the top of my deck. If I reveal a 7-cost Option card, do I have to use it?
BT6-065.answer:
No, this card’s [When Digivolving] effect reads “you may,” so you can choose whether or not to use the Option card.
If you don’t use it, you delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with a play cost of 4 or less.

BT6-065.question: If I have 4 or fewer cards in my deck, does this Digimon’s [When Digivolving] effect activate?
BT6-065.answer: Yes, it does. Reveal as many cards from your deck as you can, then perform the rest of the effect as normal.

BT6-067.question: What does “Delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest play cost” mean, exactly?
BT6-067.answer: The effect deletes your opponent’s Digimon with the lowest play cost. If multiple Digimon are tied for lowest, all of them are deleted.

BT6-067.question: My opponent only has 1 unsuspended Digimon in play, and I attack with this Digimon. When my opponent blocks and suspends their unsuspended Digimon, does my attacking Digimon immediately lose <Security Attack +1> from this card’s effect?
BT6-067.answer: Yes. As soon as your opponent no longer has an unsuspended Digimon in play, your attacking Digimon loses <Security Attack +1> from this card’s inherited effect.

BT6-068.question: When I play this card, do I have to trash 1 card in my hand?
BT6-068.answer:
No, the effect reads “you may,” so you can choose whether or not to trash the card.
If you don't trash a card, you don’t get to return a Digimon card with [Seven Great Demon Lords] or [Three Musketeers] in its type from your trash to your hand.

BT6-072.question: Can I activate this card’s effect when my hand is empty?
BT6-072.answer: No. You must trash a card in your hand in order to activate it.

BT6-075.question: Can I use this card’s [On Play] effect to place a [Ginkakumon Promote] from my trash in this card’s digivolution cards?
BT6-075.answer: No. This card’s [On Play] effect can only be used to place cards whose names match either [Kinkakumon] or [Ginkakumon] exactly, therefore you can't place [Ginkakumon Promote] in digivolution cards.

BT6-075.question: If I have both [Kinkakumon] and [Ginkakumon] in my trash, does this card’s [On Play] effect force me to place both cards in this card’s digivolution cards?
BT6-075.answer: No, "You may place..." means that you can choose if you want to place them as digivolution cards or not. However, if you choose to place, you must place as many digivolution cards as possible. So, if you have both [Kinkakumon] and [Ginkakumon], you can't choose to place only one of them.

BT6-077.question: This card is in my breeding area. Can I digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a black Digimon?
BT6-077.answer: No, you can't. Effects don't activate from breeding areas, so the card isn't treated as a black card. You can't digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a black Digimon.

BT6-077.question: Can I activate this card’s effect when my hand is empty?
BT6-077.answer: No. You must trash a card in your hand in order to activate it.

BT6-079.question: I have 9 cards in my trash when this Digimon is deleted. If this results in my having 10 cards in my trash, does this card’s [On Deletion] effect activate?
BT6-079.answer: Yes. The [On Deletion] effect activates after the card moves to your trash, meeting the requirement for you to have 10 cards in your trash.

BT6-082.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect placed a [BT10-016 Jesmon (X Antibody)] as a digivolution card, then that card's [When Digivolving] effect played a [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc], then I activated <Blitz> in this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack. When does [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc]'s [On Play] effect activate?
BT6-082.answer:
Since both the [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] having been played and this Digimon attacking with <Blitz> happened during this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect, the Digimon being played and the attack are treated as having happened at the same time for the purpose of triggering effects.
The turn player can choose the order in which to activate the [On Play] effect and any potential [When Attacking] and such effects.

BT6-082.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect placed a [BT10-016 Jesmon (X Antibody)] as a digivolution card, then that card's [When Digivolving] effect played a [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc], then I activated <Blitz> in this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack, and when the [When Attacking] effect deleted one of my opponent's Digimon, my [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] was deleted by the [On Deletion] effect of the opponent's Digimon. [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc]'s [On Play] effect hasn't activated yet, so does it activate?
BT6-082.answer:
No, it doesn't activate.
The [On Play] effect from [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] was triggered, but it cannot activate because the [Sistermon Blanc] is deleted before it is able to activate.

BT6-083.question: If I don’t play a Tamer using this card’s [On Play] effect, does that prevent my opponent from playing a Tamer card, as well?
BT6-083.answer: No. Even if you choose not to play a Tamer, your opponent can still use this card’s effect to play a Tamer of their own.

BT6-083.question: My BT6-083 [Eosmon] was played, then this card's [All Turns] effect and another effect triggered simultaneously. If another effect activates and the DP of my played BT6-083 [Eosmon] changes from 4000 to 5000, then I activate this card's [All Turns] effect, what is the DP of Digimon I can delete?
BT6-083.answer:
5000 DP or less.
If the same reference to a "played" trigger condition being performed isn't being made for an effect when it has a "when X is played" trigger condition, the state when the effect is processed will be referenced.
In this case, processing was performed when your BT6-083 [Eosmon] had 5000 DP, therefore you can delete a Digimon with 5000 DP or less.

BT7-029.answer: No. No matter which timing the effect is triggered at, it is still the same effect and can only be activated [Once Per Turn]. If the effect has been triggered at [When Digivolving] and activated, it can not be activated again on the same turn, even if it's triggered [When Attacking].

BT7-031.question: I trash this card from a Digimon's digivolution cards to activate <Digi-Burst>. Do I return this card to its owner's hand before or after the <Digi-Burst> effect activates?
BT7-031.answer: Return this card to its owner’s hand after <Digi-Burst> activates.

BT7-035.question: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?
BT7-035.answer:
Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.
In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.

BT7-035.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
BT7-035.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

BT7-035.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
BT7-035.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

BT7-035.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
BT7-035.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

BT7-035.question: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?

BT7-040.question: When digivolving into this card from my hand, I activate an effect on another card that reduces digivolution costs. What happens to this card’s digivolution cost?

If you have 4 security cards and activate an effect that reduces digivolution costs by 2, the final digivolution cost will be 2. (4 minus 2.)

BT7-040.question: This card’s <Digi-Burst> reads “up to 4.” Can I activate the effect if I have 3 or fewer digivolution cards?
BT7-040.answer: Yes, you can. This card's <Digi-Burst up to 4> allows you to choose any number of digivolution cards to trash, from 1 to 4. If you have 3 or fewer digivolution cards, you can activate the effect as long as you can trash 1 or more of them.

BT7-040.question: I trash 2 digivolution cards to activate this card's <Digi-Burst>. Can I have 2 of my opponent's Digimon both get -3000 DP?
BT7-040.answer: No, this effect can only target 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

BT7-041.question: I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect when I have 2 or fewer security cards to go up to 3 security cards with <Recovery>. Do I now gain 2 memory for being at 3 or more security cards?
BT7-041.answer: No. If you digivolve into this card while at 2 or fewer security cards, you only go up to 3 security cards with <Recovery>.

BT7-049.question: When a digivolution would occur by this card's [When Attacking] effect, when exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw, and where do I draw from?
BT7-049.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when this card is placed on top of that Digimon for the digivolution, and you draw from the unrevealed cards in your deck.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

BT7-049.question: If I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before returning the remaining cards to the bottom of the deck?
Can I activate this card's [When Attacking] effect when I have 2 or fewer cards in my deck?
BT7-049.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you reveal as many cards from your deck as possible.

BT7-051.question: I have a card with [Hybrid] or [Insectoid] in its traits in this Digimon's digivolution cards. Does this card’s [When Attacking] effect force me to digivolve this Digimon into a Digimon card with [Insectoid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits in my hand?
BT7-051.answer: No. The effect reads, “This Digimon can digivolve,” so you can choose not to.

BT7-051.question: When digivolving with this card's [When Attacking] effect, paying the digivolution cost moves the memory gauge to 1 or more on my opponent’s side. What happens to the attack?
BT7-051.answer: The attack continues. The turn doesn’t switch over just yet. If the memory gauge is still at 1 or more on your opponent’s side after the attack ends and any effects triggered by it finish activating, only then does the turn switch over.

BT7-051.question: I attack with [EX1-035 Kabuterimon] and digivolve into this card with its [When Attacking] effect. Can I then digivolve again on the same attack with this card's [When Attacking] effect?
BT7-051.answer: No, it is too late to trigger this card's [When Attacking] effect, since the Digimon didn't have it when the attack was declared.

BT7-051.question: When digivolving into a Digimon card in my hand with [Insectoid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits with this card's [When Attacking] effect, can I ignore that card's digivolution requirements?
BT7-051.answer: No, you can’t ignore its digivolution requirements.

BT7-055.question: My opponent unsuspends 2 or more of their Digimon. Does this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect allow my opponent to unsuspend all of their Digimon by trashing 1 card in their hand?
BT7-055.answer: No. Your opponent must trash 1 card in their hand for each Digimon they unsuspend.

BT7-055.question: If an effect would cause an opponent’s Digimon to unsuspend, does this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect force my opponent to trash a card in their hand?
BT7-055.answer: No. The [Opponent's Turn] effect cannot force the opponent to trash cards in their hand. However, no matter how the Digimon would become unsuspended, whether from an effect or your opponent's unsuspend phase, the Digimon cannot unsuspend unless the opponent trashes a card in their hand.

BT7-055.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. If I have 3 suspended Digimon in play, do I need to have 3 or more cards in hand during my unsuspend phase in order to unsuspend my Digimon?
BT7-055.answer:
No, you can choose which of your Digimon to unsuspend, and trash a card in your hand for each one.
Digimon will not unsuspend unless you choose to trash a card in your hand, so even if you have fewer cards in hand than suspended Digimon in play, you can still choose to unsuspend specific Digimon.

BT7-055.question: Does this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect require my opponent to trash cards in their hand to also unsuspend their Tamer cards?
BT7-055.answer: No. This effect only affects Digimon. Your opponent can unsuspend their Tamers normally, without trashing cards in their hand.

BT7-055.question: I have two of these Digimon in play. Does my opponent have to trash 2 cards in their hand for each Digimon they want to unsuspend?
BT7-055.answer: Yes. Your opponent’s Digimon now have two copies of “[Your Turn] You must trash 1 card in your hand to unsuspend this Digimon” on them, which means they have to trash 2 cards in their hand to unsuspend 1 of their Digimon.

BT7-056.question: I reveal 3 cards with this card's [On Play] effect. If the cards revealed only include either a card with [X Antibody] in its traits or [Kota Domoto], can I still add a card to my hand?
BT7-056.answer: Yes. Even if you revealed only a card with [X Antibody] in its traits or [Kota Domoto], you still add that card to your hand.

BT7-056.question: When one of my effects digivolves a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, does this card’s inherited effect activate?
BT7-056.answer: No. When a Digimon digivolves, even if it happens due to an effect, it is not counted as an effect placing digivolution cards under that Digimon.

BT7-056.question: If one of my effects places 2 or more cards at the same time under a Digimon that has this card's inherited effect, do I gain that much memory?
BT7-056.answer: No. Even if multiple cards are added to the Digimon’s digivolution cards, you only gain 1 memory.

BT7-056.question: When this card is placed in one of my Digimon’s digivolution cards, does this card’s inherited effect activate?
BT7-056.answer:
Yes, it activates.
This card's inherited effect is a [Your Turn] effect, so it can be activated when this card becomes a digivolution card under a Digimon in the battle area. Therefore, when this card itself is added, the effect is triggered as an inherited effect.

BT7-058.question: Can this card's [When Attacking] effect place one of my [DeadlyAxemon] with no digivolution cards at the bottom of this Digimon’s digivolution cards?
BT7-058.answer: Yes, you can choose a [DeadlyAxemon] with no digivolution cards with this effect.

BT7-058.question: Can this card's [When Attacking] effect place one of my [DeadlyAxemon] with BT9-109 [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards at the bottom of this Digimon’s digivolution cards?

[DarkKnightmon]'s [All Turns] effect is a "when this Digimon would be deleted" effect that interrupts deletion when it activates, but can I use this card's "your opponent can't play Digimon by effects until the end of their turn" effect to prevent [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] from being played from [DarkKnightmon]'s digivolution cards?

As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.

BT7-075.question: A purple Tamer card is in this Digimon’s digivolution cards. If this Digimon is deleted, can its [On Deletion] effect play that purple Tamer card from my trash without paying its memory cost?

BT7-079.question: I do not play a purple Tamer card from my trash with this card’s [When Digivolving] effect. Does the “for each Tamer you have in play, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon” part of the effect activate?
BT7-079.answer: Yes. Even if you don’t play a Tamer from your trash, everything following “Then,” still activates.

BT7-080.question: A Tamer card is in a Digimon’s digivolution cards. If that Digimon is deleted, can this card's [All Turns] effect play the Tamer card that used to be in that Digimon’s digivolution cards from my trash without paying its memory cost?

BT7-081.question: I reveal 5 cards with this card's [On Play] effect. If the cards revealed only include either a card with [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits or a Tamer card, can I still add a card to my hand?
BT7-081.answer: Yes. Even if you revealed only a card with [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits or a Tamer card, you still add that card to your hand.

BT7-082.question: Can I place a [Sistermon Blanc (Awakened)] from my hand or trash at the bottom of this Digimon's digivolution cards with this card's [On Play] effect?
BT7-082.answer: No, you can't. This effect can only place [Sistermon Blanc].

BT7-082.question: Can this card's [On Deletion] effect return [BaoHuckmon], [SaviorHuckmon], or [Sistermon Ciel (Awakened)] from my trash to my hand?
BT7-082.answer: Yes. Those cards have [Huckmon] and/or [Sistermon] in their names, so you can add one of them to your hand.

BT7-083.question: Can I place a [Sistermon Ciel (Awakened)] from my hand or trash at the bottom of this Digimon's digivolution cards with this card's [On Play] effect?
BT7-083.answer: No, you can't. This effect can only place [Sistermon Ciel].

BT7-083.question: Can this card's [On Deletion] effect return [BaoHuckmon], [SaviorHuckmon], or [Sistermon Blanc (Awakened)] from my trash to my hand?
BT7-083.answer: Yes. Those cards have [Huckmon] and/or [Sistermon] in their names, so you can add one of them to your hand.

BT7-083.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "Also treated as Name: [Sistermon Noir (Awakened)] and "Also treated as Trait: [Virus]" have been changed to "(Rule) Also treated as Name: [Sistermon Noir (Awakened)] and Trait: [Virus]") "
BT7-083.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the name [Sistermon Noir (Awakened)] and the [Virus] trait.

BT7-085.question: How do I activate this card’s inherited effect?
BT7-085.answer: Some Digimon cards can digivolve onto Tamers. Digivolve such a Digimon onto this card, and it will become part of that Digimon’s digivolution cards, allowing you to activate this card’s inherited effect.

BT7-085.question: Can I activate this card's [Main] effect to place 5 cards with [Hybrid] in their traits under this Tamer from my trash, and then choose not to digivolve into [EmperorGreymon]?
BT7-085.answer: Yes. The card text reads, “you may,” so you can choose to only place 5 cards with [Hybrid] in their traits under this Tamer without digivolving.

BT7-085.question: If I only have 4 cards in my trash with [Hybrid] in their traits, can I activate this card's [Main] effect to place 4 cards from my trash under this Tamer without digivolving?
When I activate this Tamer's [Main] effect and do not digivolve into [EmperorGreymon], can I instead digivolve into some other level 6 Digimon, like [AncientGreymon]?
BT7-085.answer: No. With this Tamer's [Main] effect, you cannot digivolve into any other Digimon than [EmperorGreymon].

BT7-085.question: After using this card, I activate [BT7-085 Takuya Kanbara]’s [Main] effect. Can I use this card's effect specifically to trash cards with [Hybrid] in their traits from my hand, so that I can place them under [Takuya Kanbara] using its effect?
BT7-085.answer:
No, you can't.
You don't trash the card in your hand with this effect until you digivolve. [BT7-085 Takuya Kanbara]’s [Main] effect reads, “You may place 5 cards with [Hybrid] in their traits from your trash under this Tamer in any order,” and is used to digivolve into [EmperorGreymon]. As such, you place the cards under [Takuya Kanbara] before you begin digivolving, at which point you can trash a card in your hand with this card's effect.

BT7-086.question: How do I activate this card’s inherited effect?
BT7-086.answer: Some Digimon cards can digivolve onto Tamers. Digivolve such a Digimon onto this card, and it will become part of that Digimon’s digivolution cards, allowing you to activate this card’s inherited effect.

BT7-086.question: When this card's [When Digivolving] effect prevents a Digimon from attacking or blocking, if that Digimon gains a digivolution card afterwards, can it attack or block?
BT7-086.answer: No. Once a Digimon is targeted by this card's inherited effect, it becomes unable to attack or block until the end of your opponent’s turn, even if it gains a digivolution card.

BT7-087.question: How do I activate this card’s inherited effect?
BT7-087.answer: Some Digimon cards can digivolve onto Tamers. Digivolve such a Digimon onto this card, and it will become part of that Digimon’s digivolution cards, allowing you to activate this card’s inherited effect.

BT7-087.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate when an opponent's effect returns one of my Digimon to its owner's hand?
Can I activate this card's [Main] effect to place 5 cards with [Hybrid] in their traits under this Tamer from my hand, and then choose not to digivolve into [MagnaGarurumon]?
BT7-087.answer: Yes. The card text reads, “you may,” so you can choose to only place 5 cards with [Hybrid] in their traits under this Tamer without digivolving.

BT7-087.question: If I only have 4 cards in my hand with [Hybrid] in their traits, can I activate this card's [Main] effect to place 4 cards from my hand under this Tamer without digivolving?

I have P-153 [MagnaGarurumon] with this card in digivolution cards in the battle area. I activated this card's inherited effect, then I used P-153 [MagnaGarurumon]'s [End of Attack] effect to place P-153 [MagnaGarurumon] as my top security card, and this card became the Digimon's top card. At such times, does this card still have "this Digimon can't be blocked for the turn"?
BT7-087.answer: Yes, it still has it. If this Digimon digivolves into a Digimon again during this turn, that Digimon can't be blocked for the turn.

BT7-087.question: When I activate this Tamer's [Main] effect and do not digivolve into [MagnaGarurumon], can I instead digivolve into some other level 6 Digimon, like [AncientGarurumon]?
BT7-087.answer: No. With this Tamer's [Main] effect, you cannot digivolve into any other Digimon than [MagnaGarurumon].

BT7-088.question: Can I digivolve this Tamer to a [MagnaGarurumon] in my hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon other than this card's is activated?

BT7-089.question: How do I activate this card’s inherited effect?
BT7-089.answer: Some Digimon cards can digivolve onto Tamers. Digivolve such a Digimon onto this card, and it will become part of that Digimon’s digivolution cards, allowing you to activate this card’s inherited effect.

BT7-091.question: How do I activate this card’s inherited effect?
BT7-091.answer: Some Digimon cards can digivolve onto Tamers. Digivolve such a Digimon onto this card, and it will become part of that Digimon’s digivolution cards, allowing you to activate this card’s inherited effect.

BT7-098.question: I use this card, then, during a security check, I flip one of my opponent’s Security Digimon, whose DP is reduced to 0 by this card’s [Main] effect. Is the opponent’s Security Digimon deleted without a battle taking place?
BT7-098.answer: No. Even if a Security Digimon’s DP is reduced to 0, they still battle the Digimon performing the security check.

BT7-100.question: Can I use option cards that can change their cost to 7 on certain conditions such as [BT7-100 Qualialise Blast] or [BT11-108 DG Dimension] with this card’s [On Play] effect?
BT7-100.answer:
No, you can’t. Since those options are cards that have effects that “reduce the cost by…” or “its memory cost is equal to…” when they would be used, their cost has not actually changed when activating this card’s [On Play] effect, so they can’t be used with this card’s effect.
However, since [BT2-099 Glorious Burst] always has the effect of reducing its use cost when used from the hand, if you have 2 yellow Tamers, it can be used with this card’s effect as its use cost will be 7.

BT7-100.question: My security stack is empty. Can I use this card without paying any memory?
BT7-100.answer: Yes. When your security stack is empty, this card’s memory cost is 0.

BT7-100.question: I use this card to have an opponent’s Digimon get -3000 DP, then play a [Rasenmon]. Can I have that [Rasenmon] gain <Security Attack +1>?
BT7-100.answer: No. You didn’t have a [Rasenmon] in play when you used this card, so it's too late to give it <Security Attack +1>.

BT7-101.question: Can I use this card when I don’t have a Digimon with [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] in play? If I can, what does the effect do?
BT7-101.answer:
You can use this card, but no effect will occur.
This will still trigger any effects that trigger when you use Option cards, however.

BT7-105.question: I use this card’s effect, but there are either no black Digimon cards with play costs of 4 or less among the revealed cards, or there is one, but I choose not to play it. Do I discard this card instead of placing it in my battle area?
BT7-105.answer: No. Whether or not you play a Digimon with this card’s effect is irrelevant. You still place it in your battle area.

BT7-106.question: I don’t have a Digimon with 5 or more digivolution cards and [X Antibody] in its traits in play. Can I delete 1 of my opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less and [X Antibody] in its traits with this card's effect?

I have a Digimon with 5 or more digivolution cards and [X Antibody] in its traits in play. Can I delete 1 of my opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less and [X Antibody] in its traits with this card's effect?

BT7-107.question: I use this card's effect to delete 1 of my purple Digimon. Can I then return that Digimon card to my hand with this card's effect?
I use this card’s effect to delete 1 of my purple Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect and return it to my hand. What happens to the [On Deletion] effect?
BT7-107.answer: The [On Deletion] effect is triggered, but it cannot activate because the Digimon card leaves the trash before that.

BT7-107.question: This card is linked to my Digimon. If I use BT7-107 [Calling From the Darkness]'s [Main] effect to delete that Digimon and return the deleted Digimon card to the hand, can I then activate this card's link effect?
BT7-107.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
If a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that link card. If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated.
In this case, if this card and the linked Digimon are deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for the linked Digimon card.
If the deleted Digimon card with the effect that's pending activation leaves the trash, the [On Deletion] link effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated.

BT7-107.question: This card is linked to my Digimon. If I use BT7-107 [Calling From the Darkness]'s [Main] effect to delete that Digimon and return the deleted Digimon card to the hand, can I then activate this card's link effect?
BT7-107.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
If a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that link card. If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated.
In this case, if this card and the linked Digimon are deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for the linked Digimon card.
If the deleted Digimon card with the effect that's pending activation leaves the trash, the [On Deletion] link effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated.

BT7-107.question: This card is linked to my Digimon. If I use BT7-107 [Calling From the Darkness]'s [Main] effect to delete that Digimon and return the deleted Digimon card to the hand, can I then activate this card's link effect?
BT7-107.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
If a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that link card. If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated.
In this case, if this card and the linked Digimon are deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for the linked Digimon card.
If the deleted Digimon card with the effect that's pending activation leaves the trash, the [On Deletion] link effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated.

BT7-108.question: Does “For each Digimon with [Hybrid] in its traits and each Tamer you have in play, delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon” mean that I can delete 1 of my opponent’s Digimon for each pair of [Hybrid] Digimon and Tamer I have in play?
BT7-108.answer:
No. The number of Digimon you can delete is equal to the total number of Digimon with [Hybrid] in their traits and Tamers you have in play.
For example, if you have 2 Digimon with [Hybrid] in their traits and 1 Tamer in play, you can choose a total of 3 of your opponent’s Digimon.

BT7-109.question: I have 10 or more cards in my trash. Can I use this card’s effect to play 1 purple level 5 Digimon card?

BT7-110.question: “If you have a Digimon with [Hybrid] in its traits in play, you may use this Option card without meeting its color requirements.“ How does this effect work, exactly?
BT7-110.answer: If you have a Digimon with [Hybrid] in its traits in your battle area, you can use this Option card even if you don’t have a white Digimon or Tamer in play.

BT7-111.question: This card has an effect that has both [On Play] and [When Digivolving] timings. What does this mean, exactly?
BT7-111.answer: It means the effect can be activated both [On Play] and [When Digivolving].

BT7-111.question: Can I digivolve one of my [Lucemon] in the battle area into this card in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?
Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to digivolve into a BT7-111 [Lucemon: Chaos Mode] in the trash?
BT7-111.answer:
No, you can't.
You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements.

BT7-111.question: Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to digivolve into a BT7-111 [Lucemon: Chaos Mode] in the trash?
BT7-111.answer:
No, you can't.
You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements.

BT7-111.question: Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to digivolve into a BT7-111 [Lucemon: Chaos Mode] in the trash?
BT7-111.answer:
No, you can't.
You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements.

BT7-112.question: When can this card's 1st effect activate?
BT7-112.answer:
After declaring a digivolution and revealing this card, you can activate the effect immediately before choosing the card to digivolve.
When you choose to activate it, if the "by" condition is met, you may also choose one of your Tamers in addition to Digimon for the card to digivolve. The chosen Tamer is also treated as a level 6 Digimon during this digivolution.

BT7-112.question: Can I choose to not digivolve after activating this card's 1st effect?
BT7-112.answer:
No, you can't.
After declaring a digivolution and activating this card's 1st effect, you must choose one of your cards to digivolve and then digivolve it, just as in the procedure for normal digivolution.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.

BT7-112.question: Can I choose 10 total cards to return to the deck from both my hand and trash for this card's 1st effect, such as 5 cards from my hand and 5 cards from my trash?
Can I choose cards such as 5 Tamer cards and 5 [Hybrid] trait cards for the 10 cards to return to the deck for this card's 1st effect?
Can I return just 9 cards from my hand or trash to the bottom of the deck for this card's 1st effect?
BT7-112.answer:
No, you can't.
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.
The conditions for this inherited effect require you to return the specified number of cards to the bottom of the deck.

BT7-112.question: Can I digivolve from a Digimon after activating this card's 1st effect?
Can I use BT18-096 [Lord of Devastation and Rebirth]'s [Main] effect to choose one of my Tamers, then activate this card's 1st effect and Digivolve that Tamer?
BT7-112.answer:
Yes, you can activate this card's 1st effect and digivolve it.
However, you can't digivolve one of your Tamers into this card unless the conditions for activating this card's 1st effect are met.

BT7-112.question: Can I use BT18-096 [Lord of Devastation and Rebirth]'s [Main] effect to choose one of my Digimon, then activate this card's 1st effect and digivolve one of my Tamers?
BT7-112.answer:
No, you can only digivolve the chosen Digimon.
You use BT18-096 [Lord of Devastation and Rebirth]'s [Main] effect to choose one of your Digimon or Tamers, then digivolve the chosen card. You can activate this card's 1st effect, but you can't change the card to digivolve.

BT7-112.question: If I activate EX1-071 [Win Rate: 60%!]'s [Main] effect and then declare digivolution of this card, do I perform EX1-071 [Win Rate: 60%!]'s "would digivolve" effect processing or activate this card's 1st effect first?
BT7-112.answer:
You activate this card's 1st effect first.
You declare digivolution of this card, then activate this card's 1st effect immediately before choosing the card to digivolve.
After that, you choose your Digimon to digivolve and process EX1-071 [Win Rate: 60%!]'s "would digivolve" effect. If you would digivolve from a Tamer, EX1-071 [Win Rate: 60%!]'s effect can't be processed.

BT7-112.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
BT7-112.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

BT7-112.question: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?
BT7-112.answer:
Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.
In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.

BT7-112.question: When returning cards from my hand or trash to the bottom of the deck for this card's 1st effect, do I have to reveal them to my opponent?
BT7-112.answer:
Yes, you reveal them to your opponent.
The cards to be returned are revealed, then both players confirm the order in which they're returned to the bottom of the deck.

BT7-112.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
BT7-112.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

BT7-112.question: I used [BT7-112 Susanoomon]'s effect to return 10 Tamer cards and/or cards with the [Hybrid] trait to the bottom of my deck, then I chose to trash [BT7-112 Susanoomon] instead of digivolving it. Does this card's inherited effect still activate in such cases?
BT7-112.answer: No. It doesn't activate in such cases because [BT7-112 Susanoomon] is trashed by the rules, not an effect.

BT7-112.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
BT7-112.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

BT7-112.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?

BT8-002.question: Is a "while your opponent has no Digimon with XX" condition also met when my opponent has no Digimon?

BT8-003.question: If there are 6 cards in my security stack, does this card’s effect grant +2000 DP?
BT8-003.answer:
No, it can't.
This effect can't be used on Digimon in the breeding area.

BT8-005.question: When this card is placed in one of my Digimon’s digivolution cards, does this card’s inherited effect activate?

BT8-006.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate when one of my own effects trashes a card from my deck?
One of my effects reveals cards from the top of my deck and trashes one or more of them. Does this cause this card’s inherited effect to activate?
BT8-006.answer: No, cards revealed from the top of your deck aren't considered to be “trashed from your deck,” so this card’s inherited effect doesn’t activate.

BT8-008.question: Due to an effect, this Digimon has another [BT10-011 Canoweissmon] and a [BT8-008 Gammamon] under it as its digivolution cards. If I play a red Tamer, how exactly does [BT8-008 Gammamon]'s "When you play a red Tamer, <Draw 1> (Draw 1 card from your deck)" effect work in this situation?
BT8-008.answer: This card's effect and inherited effect mean that this Digimon gains [BT8-008 Gammamon]'s effects twice, so <Draw 1> is activated twice and you draw a total of 2 cards.

BT8-009.question: Can this card’s effect add a２-color Option card to my hand if one of its colors is red?
Can this card’s effect add a card with a "this Digimon is also treated as red" effect to my hand?
BT8-009.answer: No. Effects don't activate for cards revealed from your deck.

BT8-010.question: If I have 2 yellow Digimon in play, does this effect reduce this card’s play cost by 2?
BT8-010.answer: No. Even if you have 2 yellow Digimon in play, this effect can only reduce the play cost by a maximum of 1.

BT8-012.question: After this Digimon gets +3000 DP from the [When Attacking] effect, its <Armor Purge> activates. What happens to the +3000 DP?
BT8-012.answer: The effect has already been activated, so the +3000 DP effect persists for the turn.

BT8-013.question: I digivolve a [BT8-013 BetelGammamon] into a [BT8-084 Kimeramon] and place this card as one of [BT8-084 Kimeramon]'s digivolution cards with its [When Digivolving] effect. Can I now activate [BT8-013 BetelGammamon]'s [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect through this card's inherited effect and attack?
BT8-013.answer: No, you can't. If this card is added to digivolution cards by [BT8-084 Kimeramon]'s [When Digivolving] effect, you get [BT8-013 BetelGammamon]'s <Blitz> effect through this card, but the time to trigger <Blitz> has already passed, so <Blitz> doesn't activate.

BT8-016.question: Does this card’s [Your Turn] effect also count this Digimon itself as a Digimon with [Tyrannomon] in its name, granting it <Security Attack +1>?

BT8-018.question: I have this card in the battle area, and it's suspended. Can my opponent's BT8-018 [Marsmon] attack their unsuspended Digimon?
BT8-018.answer:
No, it can't attack.
If a "can" or "may" effect activates at the same timing as a "can't" effect, the "can't" effect takes precedence.

BT8-018.question: I have this card in the battle area, and it's suspended. Can my opponent's BT8-018 [Marsmon] attack their unsuspended Digimon?
BT8-018.answer:
No, it can't attack.
If a "can" or "may" effect activates at the same timing as a "can't" effect, the "can't" effect takes precedence.

BT8-019.question: How does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect work, exactly?
BT8-019.answer: Your opponent chooses 1 of their Digimon. Next, delete all Digimon in play, from both you and your opponent, except for this Digimon and the Digimon your opponent chose. Then you gain 1 memory for every Digimon that was deleted by this effect.

BT8-019.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect delete Digimon in breeding areas, too?
BT8-019.answer: No, Digimon in breeding areas cannot be affected by effects, so they aren't deleted.

BT8-019.question: For this card’s [When Digivolving] effect, can my opponent choose a Digimon in their breeding area?
BT8-019.answer: No, Digimon in breeding areas cannot be affected by effects, so they can't be chosen. Additionally, note that this effect doesn't delete Digimon in breeding areas, regardless of whether they could be chosen or not.

BT8-019.question: How does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect work if my opponent has no Digimon in play?
BT8-019.answer: All of your other Digimon besides this one are deleted, and you gain 1 memory for each Digimon deleted in this way.

BT8-019.question: When this card's [When Digivolving] effect deletes Digimon in play, can you and your opponent activate <Decoy>, <Armor Purge>, and similar effects to prevent their deletion?

BT8-020.question: How does this card’s inherited effect work, exactly?
BT8-020.answer: At the end of your turn, this effect allows you to DNA digivolve a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, along with one of your other Digimon, into a Digimon in your hand that has [DNA Digivolution]. Note that this happens before it becomes your opponent’s turn.

BT8-020.question: With this card's inherited effect, can I DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in my hand that doesn't have [DNA Digivolution]?
BT8-020.answer: No. You can't ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can’t DNA digivolve into a Digimon card that doesn't have [DNA Digivolution].

BT8-020.question: Does this card's inherited effect allow me to DNA digivolve into a card other than the Digimon specified by [DNA Digivolution] in the hand?
BT8-020.answer: No. You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can’t DNA digivolve using Digimon that aren’t specified in [DNA Digivolution].

BT8-021.question: Can this card's effect add a 2-color Option card to my hand if one of its colors is blue?
Can this card’s effect add a card with a "this Digimon is also treated as blue" effect to my hand?
BT8-021.answer: No. Effects don't activate for cards revealed from your deck.

BT8-022.question: If BT8-022 [SnowAgumon]'s [On Play] effect is used to choose a Digimon without digivolution cards, can that effect's trashing be replaced by this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?
BT8-022.answer:
Yes, it can.
Once replaced, you choose and trash 2 digivolution cards of this card.

BT8-023.question: My opponent doesn't have any Digimon with digivolution cards in play, meaning this card's [When Digivolving] effect can't trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of my opponent's Digimon. Do I still activate the "1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards gets -3000 DP for the turn" part of the effect?
BT8-023.answer: Yes. Even if you can't trash any of your opponent’s digivolution cards, you still get to give -3000 DP to 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards.

BT8-024.question: When this card's [Your turn] effect activates and I <Recovery +1 (Deck)>, when exactly does this happen?
BT8-024.answer: The effect triggers "when this Digimon would digivolve," so it occurs after declaring the digivolution, but before paying the digivolution cost.

BT8-028.question: Does this card’s effect activate when your opponent’s Digimon digivolves to level 5 or higher?
BT8-028.answer: No, digivolving doesn't count as playing a card, so the effect doesn't activate.

BT8-028.question: Does this card’s effect activate when your opponent moves a level 5 or higher Digimon from the breeding area to the battle area?
BT8-028.answer: No, moving a Digimon from your breeding area doesn't count as playing it, so the effect doesn't activate.

BT8-029.question: If my opponent has a Digimon with digivolution cards in their breeding area, can this Digimon attack?
BT8-029.answer: Yes. Digimon in breeding areas aren’t counted by the effect, so this Digimon can attack.

BT8-029.question: Does this card’s inherited effect activate when my opponent activates <Digi-Burst>?

BT8-032.question: If both blue and green cards are in this card’s digivolution cards, do I activate both parts of this card’s [When Attacking] effect?
If a single blue and green multicolor card is in this card’s digivolution cards, do I activate both parts of this card’s [When Attacking] effect?

BT8-033.question: Can I use this card’s effect to add a two-color Option card to my hand if one of its colors is yellow?
Can this card’s effect add a card with a "this Digimon is also treated as yellow" effect to my hand?
BT8-033.answer: No. Effects don't activate for cards revealed from your deck.

BT8-036.question: If the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself blue, does this card’s inherited effect activate?

BT8-038.question: After I use this card’s [When Digivolving] effect to gain +2000 DP for each card with [Armor Form] in its traits in my trash, I use <Armor Purge> to trash this card. What happens to the DP boost?
BT8-038.answer: The effect has already been activated, so the DP boost persists for the turn.

BT8-039.question: If I have 2 Tamers in play, can this card's [When Digivolving] effect give up to 6 of my opponent's Digimon -5000 DP?
BT8-039.answer: No. No matter how many Tamers you have in play, the effect gives -5000 DP to up to 3 of your opponent's Digimon.

BT8-040.question: This card's effect trashes a red card in my hand. Does this make this Digimon a red/yellow 2-color Digimon, allowing me to <Draw 2>?
BT8-040.answer: Yes, the Digimon is now treated as having two colors, so you <Draw 2>.

BT8-040.question: This card's effect trashes a blue/green multicolor card in my hand. Does this make this Digimon a yellow/blue/green 3-color Digimon?
BT8-040.answer: Yes, the Digimon is now treated as having three colors.

BT8-043.question: If I have multiple Tamers in play, can this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect give <Security Attack -2> to a different one of my opponent’s Digimon for each Tamer I have in play?
BT8-043.answer: Yes. The effect activates for each Tamer you have in play, and you can choose a different target for each activation.

BT8-043.question: When I activate this card’s [On Play][When Digivolving] effect multiple times, is each activation treated as its own timing?
BT8-043.answer: No, it’s treated as a single timing.

BT8-044.question: I digivolve one of my suspended Digimon into this Digimon. Does this card's [Your Turn] effect let me unsuspend this Digimon itself?
BT8-044.answer:
No, it doesn't.
This Digimon's [Your Turn] effect only triggers when your other Digimon digivolve.

BT8-048.question: If I choose an opponent's Digimon for this card's [When Digivolving] effect, and that Digimon loses <Blocker> due to digivolving, <De-Digivolve>, or some other reason, can that Digimon now attack and block again?
BT8-048.answer: No. Once a Digimon with <Blocker> is targeted by this card's [When Digivolving] effect, it becomes unable to attack or block until the end of your opponent’s next turn, even if it loses <Blocker>.

BT8-050.question: With this card's [When Digivolving] effect, can I suspend this Digimon itself in order to suspend 1 of my opponent's Digimon?

BT8-053.question: If BT8-053 [Lighdramon] and P-117 [Veemon] are revealed by this card's [On Play] effect, can I choose BT8-053 [Lighdramon] to add as the blue card but choose to not add P-117 [Veemon] to my hand?

BT8-055.question: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect before my opponent's Digimon unsuspends in the unsuspend phase due to <Reboot>?
BT8-055.answer: Yes, you can. Digimon with <Reboot> unsuspend at the same time as the current player's turn. This effect activates "if this Digimon is unsuspended", so it activates immediately after.

BT8-057.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. During my turn, I use an Option card like [BT1-109 Smashed Potatoes] or [EX1-071 Win Rate: 60%!] which has an effect that activates “the next time one of your Digimon digivolves”. After that, all of my opponent’s Digimon become suspended. If I then digivolve one of my Digimon, are the effects from the Option cards I used earlier negated?
BT8-057.answer: No. You already used the Option cards and activated their effects, so this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect can’t negate them.

BT8-057.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. If I have an Option card with <Delay> that I used from my hand earlier, can I activate its <Delay> effect?
BT8-057.answer:
Yes, you can.
Activating <Delay> on Option cards that are already in your battle area doesn't count as using an Option card.

BT8-059.question: What does a "players can't ignore digivolution requirements" effect do, exactly?
BT8-059.answer:
This effect prevents players from ignoring digivolution requirements.
This effect affects both players.

BT8-059.question: Is DNA digivolution or Burst Digivolve possible while a "players can't ignore digivolution requirements" effect is activated?
BT8-059.answer: Yes, DNA digivolution and Burst Digivolve are possible.

BT8-059.question: Is digivolution without paying the cost possible while a "players can't ignore digivolution requirements" effect is activated?
BT8-059.answer:
Yes, such digivolving is still possible.
Digivolving without paying the cost isn't the same as ignoring the digivolution requirements.

BT8-059.question: If a "players can't ignore digivolution requirements" effect is activated, is digivolution possible using effects such as those that ignore parts of the digivolution requirements such as levels?
BT8-059.answer: No, players can’t ignore part of the digivolution requirements.

BT8-059.question: Is digivolution using BT10-067 [Justimon: Critical Arm]'s [When Attacking] effect possible while a "players can't ignore digivolution requirements" effect is activated?
Is digivolution from a Tamer using BT4-011 [Agunimon]'s 1st effect possible while a "players can't ignore digivolution requirements" effect is activated?
BT8-059.answer:
Yes, such digivolution is possible.
Effects that add to card information for digivolution aren't the same as effects that ignore digivolution requirements.

BT8-061.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [Mamemon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Mamemon].")
BT8-061.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Mamemon] name.

BT8-062.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon].")
BT8-062.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] names.

BT8-064.question: If the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself red, does this card’s inherited effect activate?

BT8-065.question: Can this card's effect add a total of up to 4 Digimon cards with [Mamemon] in their names from both my hand and/or trash to the top of my deck?
BT8-065.answer: Yes, you can add up to 4 cards in any combination from your hand and/or trash.

BT8-066.question: Can this card's [Your Turn] effect digivolve it into any Digimon card regardless of digivolution requirements, so long as it has [X Antibody] in its traits?
BT8-066.answer: No. Digivolution requirements cannot be ignored unless an effect explicitly instructs you to ignore them.

BT8-068.question: How does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect work if my opponent has no Digimon in play?
BT8-068.answer:
You can reveal 3 cards, then trash all of them.
Note that the effect reads, “you may,” so you can choose whether or not to activate the effect when digivolving, regardless of whether or not your opponent has any Digimon in play. If you choose not to activate it, you don't reveal or trash any cards.

BT8-068.question: What does “memory cost of 10 or less” refer to?

BT8-070.question: If this card has both red and black digivolution cards, can this card's [When Digivolving] effect delete both Digimon and Tamers?

If this card has both red and black digivolution cards, can this card's [When Digivolving] effect delete both 6 play cost worth of my opponent’s Digimon, and 6 play cost worth of my opponent’s Tamers?
BT8-070.answer: No. The total play costs of the chosen Digimon and Tamers must add up to 6 or less.

BT8-070.question: If a single red and black multicolor card is in this card’s digivolution cards, can I activate both parts of this card’s [When Digivolving] effect?

BT8-071.question: What does "players can't reduce play costs" mean, exactly?
BT8-071.answer: This effect prevents costs from being reduced when play costs are to be paid. This effect affects both players.

BT8-071.question: If a "players can't reduce play costs" effect has activated, can a card be played using a "play without paying the cost" effect?
BT8-071.answer:
Yes, it can be played.
"Play this card without paying the cost" effects aren't effects that reduce the play cost.

BT8-071.question: If a "players can't reduce play costs" effect has activated, can a play cost be reduced using an effect on a Digimon in the breeding area?
BT8-071.answer:
No, play costs can't be reduced.
A "players can't reduce play costs" effect isn't an effect that affects cards that activate play-cost-reducing effects, it's an effect that affects players. Therefore, the target players can't reduce play costs.

BT8-071.question: If a "players can't reduce play costs" effect has activated, is DigiXrosing possible?
BT8-071.answer:
Yes, DigiXrosing is possible.
However, it isn't possible to reduce play costs through DigiXrosing. Therefore, a player can't declare to play a card in a state where its play cost can't be paid.

BT8-071.question: My opponent has [BT8-071 Psychemon] in play. Can this Digimon’s [Your Turn] effect still reduce the play cost of cards with [D-Reaper] in their traits when I would play them?
BT8-071.answer: No. [BT8-071 Psychemon]’s effect doesn’t target Digimon themselves, so you can’t activate this card's effect to reduce the play cost of cards.

BT8-071.question: The memory is at 0, and my opponent has 2 Digimon including BT8-071 [Psychemon] in the battle area. Can I declare to play this card, then suspend my opponent's 2 Digimon including BT8-071 [Psychemon]?
BT8-071.answer:
No, you can't.
You can't pay the cost because you can't use BT8-071 [Psychemon]'s effect to reduce it, therefore you can't declare to play this card in the first place.

BT8-071.question: The memory is at 1 or more, and my opponent has 2 Digimon including BT8-071 [Psychemon] in the battle area. Can I declare to play this card, then suspend my opponent's 2 Digimon including BT8-071 [Psychemon]?
BT8-071.answer:
Yes, you can.
You can't use BT8-071 [Psychemon]'s effect to reduce the play cost, but the original play cost can be paid, therefore you can declare to play this card.
After declaring to play it, you can use the 1st effect to suspend 2 Digimon, but you can't reduce the play cost, therefore you must pay the original play cost of 11 in order to play this card.

BT8-072.question: If I reveal a non-purple Digimon card with this card’s [On Play] effect, can I trash it?
BT8-072.answer: No. This card’s effect can only trash purple Digimon cards.

BT8-074.question: Is this card’s effect triggered by the activation of an effect that reads, “Reveal the top X cards of your deck... Trash the remaining cards.”?
BT8-074.answer: No, cards revealed from the top of your deck aren't considered to be “trashed from your deck,” so this card’s effect doesn’t trigger.

BT8-079.question: Is this card’s inherited effect triggered by the activation of an effect that reads, “Reveal the top X cards of your deck... Trash the remaining cards.”?
BT8-079.answer: No, cards revealed from the top of your deck aren't considered to be “trashed from your deck,” so this card’s effect doesn’t trigger.

BT8-082.question: If both purple and yellow cards are in this card’s digivolution cards, can I activate both parts of this card’s [When Digivolving] effect?
If a single purple and yellow multicolor card is in this card’s digivolution cards, can I activate both parts of this card’s [When Digivolving] effect?

BT8-083.question: I activated this card's [On Play] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. Can I then process the rest of this effect?
BT8-083.answer:
Yes, you can.
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

BT8-084.question: How does this card’s [Your Turn] effect work, exactly?
BT8-084.answer:
The effect allows this card to be treated as both white (its original color), and as the colors of its digivolution cards.
For example, if a red card and green card are in this card’s digivolution cards, this card is treated as a 3-color white/red/green card.

BT8-084.question: I digivolve a [BT8-013 BetelGammamon] into a [BT8-084 Kimeramon] and place this card as one of [BT8-084 Kimeramon]'s digivolution cards with its [When Digivolving] effect. Can I now activate [BT8-013 BetelGammamon]'s [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect through this card's inherited effect and attack?
BT8-084.answer: No, you can't. If this card is added to digivolution cards by [BT8-084 Kimeramon]'s [When Digivolving] effect, you get [BT8-013 BetelGammamon]'s <Blitz> effect through this card, but the time to trigger <Blitz> has already passed, so <Blitz> doesn't activate.

BT8-085.question: This card has an effect that reads, “When one of your Digimon with 2 or more colors attacks”―does this include the colors of the attacking Digimon’s digivolution cards?
BT8-085.answer: No. The effect can only be activated if the Digimon itself has 2 or more colors.

BT8-087.question: Is this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect triggered when I block an opponent’s attack with one of my blue Digimon?
BT8-087.answer: No. The effect only triggers when your opponent chooses one of your blue Digimon as a target of attack.

BT8-088.question: Can I activate both parts of this card’s [Start of Your Main Phase] effect if I have both a blue Digimon and green Digimon in play?
If I have a single blue and green multicolor Digimon in play, can I activate both parts of this card’s [Start of Your Main Phase] effect?
This card's effect reveals 3 cards. If a [BT8-088 Davis Motomiya & Ken Ichijoji] is among the cards revealed, can I add that card to my hand?
BT8-088.answer: Yes, it's a Tamer card with [Davis Motomiya] in its name, so you can add it to your hand.

BT8-089.question: This card has an effect that reads, “When one of your Digimon with 2 or more colors attacks”―does this include the colors of the attacking Digimon’s digivolution cards?
BT8-089.answer: No. The effect can only be activated if the Digimon itself has 2 or more colors.

BT8-094.question: Does this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect activate when an effect from a card like [BT1-089 Mimi Tachikawa] moves a level 3 Digimon from your opponent's breeding area to their battle area outside of their breeding phase?

During the breeding phase, I move a Digimon from the breeding area to the battle area and due to this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect of my opponent, and the memory gauge moves to 1 or more on my opponent's side. In this case, do I have a main phase?
BT8-094.answer: No, the main phase doesn't take place and the turn ends.

BT8-095.question: I used this card's [Main] effect to give <Security A. +1> to one of my Digimon with <Armor Purge>, then that Digimon attacked and checked 1 security card. At such times, if that Digimon loses a battle with a Security Digimon and would be deleted, but <Armor Purge> causes a stacked card to be trashed and prevents the deletion, is the additional security check performed?
BT8-095.answer: Yes, you perform the additional security check.

BT8-096.question: Does this card’s “If you have a Digimon in play with...2 or more colors in one of its digivolution cards” count a Digimon that has both a red card and a blue card in its digivolution cards?
BT8-096.answer:
No, it doesn't.
The effect is looking for a Digimon with a digivolution card that has 2 or more colors.

BT8-096.question: Does this card’s “If you have a Digimon in play with...2 or more colors in one of its digivolution cards” count a Digimon with a card like [BT3-040 Shakkoumon]’s “This Digimon is also treated as blue” in its digivolution cards?
BT8-096.answer:
No, it doesn't.
Effects that grant additional colors don't do anything as digivolution cards, so the card is only treated as a single color.

BT8-097.question: If my opponent has 7 or more Digimon in play, does this card’s effect get reduced to negative 1, effectively gaining me a memory for using it?
BT8-097.answer:
No. It just reduces the cost of the card to 0.
Note that in general, costs can’t be reduced to less than 0.

BT8-097.question: I use this card, then attack my opponent. During the security check, I flip over a Digimon card with the effect, “[Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying its memory cost.” What happens to this Security Digimon?
BT8-097.answer: After the battle between the attacking Digimon and Security Digimon, the effect prevents the Digimon from being played, so it's placed in the trash.

BT8-097.question: My opponent used this card on my [BT7-063 DarkKnightmon]. [DarkKnightmon]'s [All Turns] effect is a "when this Digimon would be deleted" effect that interrupts deletion when it activates, but can I use this card's "your opponent can't play Digimon by effects until the end of their turn" effect to prevent [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] from being played from [DarkKnightmon]'s digivolution cards?
BT8-097.answer:
Yes, they can't be played.
This card's [Main] effect was changed to "Your opponent can't play Digimon by effects until the end of their turn. Delete all of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less." Therefore, first the effect that prevents playing Digimon is applied, then Digimon with 6000 DP or less are deleted.
Please see the notices regarding changes to the rules/rulings on the official website.

BT8-097.question: If this card's effect is activated on the opponent's turn, how long does the effect last?
BT8-097.answer: When the effect of this card is activated on the opponent's turn, it lasts until the end of that turn.

BT8-097.question: An Option card's use cost is 1 or less when used from the hand due to an effect such as BT2-099 [Glorious Burst] or BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s 1st effect. When such a card is used, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
BT8-097.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If a card's cost itself is reduced when it's used from the hand, it's considered to be using an Option card with a use cost after the reduction is applied. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect doesn't trigger.

BT8-097.question: Can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to play a [Petrification] Token during the turn I activated BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s [Main] effect?
BT8-097.answer:
Yes, you can.
This card's [All Turns] effect plays one of your cards.
Cards can be played by your effects even after a "your opponent can't play Digimon by effects" effect has activated.

BT8-097.question: What does a "your opponent can't play XX by effects" effect do, exactly?
BT8-097.answer:
Such effects prevent your opponent from playing XX by effects.
With this card's effect, your opponent can no longer play Digimon by effects such as BT10-018 [Gaossmon]'s [On Deletion] effect or BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon]'s [When Digivolving] effect.
This effect affects the opponent player.

BT8-097.question: I activate a "your opponent can't play XX by effects" effect, and in the same turn, my opponent activates an effect that reveals cards and plays a specified card from their deck. Is the card revealed from the deck but not played?
BT8-097.answer: Yes. Your opponent reveals cards, but then doesn't play the specified card.

BT8-097.question: Can an opponent's Digimon be played if I activate a "your opponent can't play Digimon by effects" effect, and in the same turn, I activate an effect such as EX5-060 [Dragomon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect that plays an opponent's Digimon card?
BT8-097.answer:
Yes, it can be played.
"Your opponent can't play Digimon by effects" is an effect that prevents your opponent from playing Digimon by effects. Your effects can still play an opponent's Digimon.

BT8-097.question: Can my Digimon be played if I activate a "your opponent can't play Digimon by effects" effect, and in the same turn, my opponent activates an effect such as EX5-060 [Dragomon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect that plays an opponent's Digimon card?
BT8-097.answer:
No, it can't be played.
"Your opponent can't play Digimon by effects" is an effect that prevents your opponent from playing Digimon by effects. Your Digimon can't be played by an opponent's effect.

BT8-105.question: What does “Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose play costs add up to 15 or less” mean, exactly?
BT8-105.answer: You can choose any number of your opponent's Digimon, as long as the play costs of the chosen Digimon add up to 15 or less.
