You perform the digivolution bonus draw when this card is placed on top of that Digimon for the digivolution, and you draw from the unrevealed cards in your deck.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

BT9-104.question: If I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before trashing the remaining cards?

BT9-105.question: When choosing the target for "then, place 1 card with [X Antibody] in its traits from your trash under 1 of your Digimon with [X Antibody] in its traits as its bottom digivolution card" can I choose a card with the [X Antibody] trait that was revealed from my deck and trashed for this card's effect?

BT9-106.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve into any Digimon card from my trash as long as it has [Dex]/[DeathX] in its name?
BT9-106.answer: No, this effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card from your trash that meets the digivolution requirements and has [Dex]/[DeathX] in its name.

BT9-106.question: Can I activate an effect that reduces the digivolution cost when digivolving using this card's [Main] effect?
BT9-106.answer: Yes, as long as the activation conditions are met.

BT9-107.question: If I use this card's [Main] effect to trash 2 cards in my hand, can I activate <De-Digivolve 1> on 2 of my opponent's Digimon?
BT9-107.answer:
No, you can't.
This effect only activates <De-Digivolve> on 1 of your opponent's Digimon. For the part of the effect after "then," you can also choose a Digimon other than the target Digimon for <De-Digivolve>.

BT9-107.question: When I use this card's [Main] effect to trash 2 cards in my hand, does <De-Digivolve 1> activate twice or does <De-Digivolve 2> activate once?
BT9-107.answer:
<De-Digivolve 1> activates twice, <De-Digivolve 2> doesn't activate once.
Even if a Tamer card or Option card becomes the top card after trashing the top card, <De-Digivolve> can trash a card regardless of its card category, therefore you go on to trash the 2nd card. However, if a card with an "isn't affected by effects" becomes the top card after the first <De-Digivolve 1>, it won't be affected by the second <De-Digivolve 1> and won't be trashed.

BT9-109.question: Can this card's [When Attacking] effect place one of my [DeadlyAxemon] with BT9-109 [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards at the bottom of this Digimon’s digivolution cards?
BT9-109.answer: Yes, it can. In such cases, [DeadlyAxemon] becomes a different Digimon, therefore the BT9-109 [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards is trashed according to the rules.

BT9-109.question: Does this card have inherited effects even though it's an Option card?
BT9-109.answer:
Yes. This card's [Main] effect can place it in a Digimon’s digivolution cards, and it has inherited effects.
As with Digi-Egg cards and Digimon cards, this card's inherited effects can activate while it's placed in a Digimon’s digivolution cards.

BT9-109.question: Can this card's inherited effect digivolve a Digimon that doesn't meet the digivolution requirements into a Digimon card with [X Antibody] in its traits in my hand?
BT9-109.answer: No, you can’t ignore digivolution requirements when using this card's effect.

BT9-109.question: Can I activate an effect that reduces the digivolution cost when digivolving using this card's inherited effect?
BT9-109.answer: Yes, as long as the activation conditions are met.

BT9-109.question: Can this card be trashed by <Digi-Burst> effects on Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards?
BT9-109.answer: No. Trashing by <Digi-Burst> is also trashing by an effect.

BT9-109.question: What happens if this card becomes the top card after a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is affected by <De-Digivolve>?
BT9-109.answer:
As with Digimon without DP, this card can't exist in the battle area as the top card, therefore it's trashed. This isn't considered deletion.
If this card has other digivolution cards under it, they are also trashed.

BT9-109.question: What happens if a "trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of your opponent's Digimon" effect activates on a Digimon with this card as its bottom digivolution card?
BT9-109.answer: Effects can't trash this card, therefore only the digivolution card on top of this card is trashed.

BT9-109.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper], and this card is the bottom card. Does the "you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper]s to set this Digimon's play cost to 0" effect activate when my [EX2-055 Reaper] is played?
BT9-109.answer: It can activate in such cases if you declare to trash 8 cards and then trash 7 cards except for [BT9-109 X Antibody].

BT9-109.question: If [BT9-109 X Antibody] is in this card’s digivolution cards, can this card’s [End of Your Turn] effect return [BT9-109 X Antibody] from this card’s digivolution cards to the bottom of my deck?
BT9-109.answer: Yes. You're not trashing it, so there’s nothing preventing you from returning it to your deck.

BT9-109.question: My Digimon with [Veedramon] in its name attacks and becomes suspended. After that, it digivolves into a different Digimon with the [When Attacking] effect of [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards. If the card it digivolved into has a [When Digivolving], if I suspend this card with this card's [All Turns] effect, can I activate the [When Digivolving] effect of the card it digivolved into?
When this card's effect places 1 of my other blue Digimon as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, if that Digimon has [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards, what happens to that card?
BT9-109.answer: It's not being trashed by the effect, it's being trashed because of the rules, so [BT9-109 X Antibody] does still get trashed.

BT9-109.question: When I use this card's effect to place a blue Digimon as the bottom digivolution card of another Digimon, what happens if that Digimon has [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards?
BT9-109.answer: It's not being trashed by the effect, it's being trashed because of the rules, so [BT9-109 X Antibody] does still get trashed.

BT9-109.question: When this card's effect places [Shoutmon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards, what happens if [Shoutmon] has [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards?
BT9-109.answer: It's not being trashed by the effect, it's being trashed because of the rules, so [BT9-109 X Antibody] does still get trashed.

BT9-109.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under this card, and [BT9-109 X Antibody] is the bottom card. Does the "you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper]s to set this Digimon's play cost to 0" effect activate when my [EX2-055 Reaper] is played?
BT9-109.answer: It can activate in such cases if you declare to trash 8 cards and then trash 7 cards except for [X Antibody].

BT9-109.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under my EX2-007 [Mother D-Reaper], including 1 BT9-109 [X Antibody]. Can this card's 1st effect activate when this card would be played?
BT9-109.answer: Yes, it can be activated. As long as you can trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom other than cards that can't be trashed, the play cost will be 0.

BT9-110.question: Does this card's "if there are 3 or more Digimon in play" refer to 3 or more total Digimon in play by both me and my opponent?
Can I activate just the "delete 1 Digimon without [X Antibody] in its traits" effect when there are 3 or more Digimon in play?
BT9-110.answer:
No, you can't.
When there are 3 or more Digimon in play, you must delete all Digimon without [X Antibody] in their traits.

BT9-111.question: If this card’s [End of Your Turn] effect gains me enough memory to bring the memory gauge to 0 or greater on my side, does it briefly become my opponent’s turn before switching back to my turn again?
BT9-111.answer: No. In this case, your turn simply continues without switching over.

BT9-111.question: If [BT9-109 X Antibody] is in this card’s digivolution cards, can this card’s [End of Your Turn] effect return [BT9-109 X Antibody] from this card’s digivolution cards to the bottom of my deck?
BT9-111.answer: Yes. You're not trashing it, so there’s nothing preventing you from returning it to your deck.

BT9-112.question: If my Digimon is targeted by the [End of Opponent's Turn] effect of my opponent's [BT9-112 DeathXmon] while it has this card in its digivolution cards, does this card's inherited effect prevent it from being deleted due to my opponent's effect?
BT9-112.answer: No, this card's inherited effect has the [Opponent's Turn] timing, but the turns haven't changed at the end of your turn, so this card's inherited effect can't be activated and the effect of your opponent's [BT9-112 DeathXmon] can't be prevented.

BT9-112.question: When playing this card, do I reduce its memory cost by 3 for each pair of Digimon and Tamer cards my opponent has in play?
BT9-112.answer:
No, you reduce its memory cost by 3 based on the total number of Digimon and Tamer cards your opponent has in play.
For example, if your opponent has 2 Digimon and 1 Tamer, this adds up to 3 cards total, which means you get to reduce the play cost by 9.

EX1-001.question: If a Digimon card with [Agumon] in its name and a Tamer card are among the cards revealed with this card’s inherited effect, can I add both to my hand?
EX1-001.answer: No, you can only add one or the other.

EX1-001.question: Can I add a non-red Digimon card with [Agumon] in its name or a non-red Tamer card to my hand off this card’s inherited effect?

EX1-002.question: I attack my opponent with a Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this card's effect activate?
EX1-002.answer:
Yes, it does.
[When Attacking] effects activate before your opponent gets to activate <Blocker>.

EX1-003.question: I attack my opponent with a Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this card's effect activate?
EX1-003.answer:
Yes, it does.
[When Attacking] effects activate before your opponent gets to activate <Blocker>.

EX1-004.question: Can I play cards that include [Tai Kamiya] in their names, like [BT5-093 Tai Kamiya & Matt Ishida], with this card's inherited effect?
EX1-004.answer: No, this card's inherited effect can only play cards specifically named [Tai Kamiya].

EX1-005.question: If a card such as EX1-005 [Tyrannomon] has an effect that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?
EX1-005.answer:
The card information gained from the effect remains as-is.
For example, if EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s original card information is changed, its original color will become white, and EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s effect will also treat it as green, making it a 2-color white and green Digimon.

EX1-005.question: If a card such as EX1-005 [Tyrannomon] has an effect that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?
EX1-005.answer:
The card information gained from the effect remains as-is.
For example, if EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s original card information is changed, its original color will become white, and EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s effect will also treat it as green, making it a 2-color white and green Digimon.

EX1-005.question: When this card is revealed from my deck with an effect like the one on [ST4-03 Tentomon], can I add it to my hand as if it was a green Digimon?
EX1-005.answer: No. This card’s effects aren't activated when you reveal it from your deck with an effect. As such, the card isn't considered to be a green Digimon card, and can’t be added to your hand.

EX1-005.question: If this Digimon is in my battle area, can I digivolve it into a Digimon with “Green/Level 4” digivolution requirements?
EX1-005.answer: If it’s your turn, then yes, you can.

EX1-005.question: If this Digimon is in my breeding area, can I digivolve it into a Digimon with “Green/Level 4” digivolution requirements?
EX1-005.answer: No, you can't. Effects don't activate from breeding areas, so this Digimon isn't treated as green, and you can't digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a green level 4 Digimon.

EX1-006.question: I attack my opponent with a Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this card's effect activate?
EX1-006.answer:
Yes, it does.
[When Attacking] effects activate before your opponent gets to activate <Blocker>.

EX1-008.question: I have a Digimon that gained <Security Attack +1> from another card’s effect, and which also gained <Piercing> from this card’s inherited effect. I attack an opponent's Digimon with it, and perform a security check with <Piercing>. The first card checked has a <De-Digivolve 1> [Security] effect, which trashes the top card of my attacking Digimon, turning it into a Digimon without [Machine] or [Dragonkin]. This causes the Digimon to also lose <Piercing>. Do I still perform the second check?

EX1-008.question: I attack my opponent with this Digimon. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this card's effect activate?

[When Attacking] effects activate before your opponent gets to activate <Blocker>.

[When Attacking] effects activate before your opponent gets to activate <Blocker>.

EX1-009.question: If an opponent's Digimon gains <Blocker> from an effect or as an inherited effect from one of its digivolution cards, can I delete that Digimon with this card's effect?

EX1-010.question: I attack my opponent with this Digimon. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this card's effect activate?
EX1-010.answer:
Yes, it does.
[When Attacking] effects activate before your opponent gets to activate <Blocker>.

EX1-011.question: If a Digimon card with [Gabumon] in its name and a Tamer card are among the cards revealed with this card’s inherited effect, can I add both to my hand?

EX1-011.question: Can I add a non-blue Digimon card with [Gabumon] in its name or a non-blue Tamer card to my hand off this card’s inherited effect?

EX1-013.question: During my main phase, I have an unsuspended Digimon in play with this card in its digivolution cards. If one of my effects unsuspends that Digimon, does this card’s inherited effect activate?
EX1-013.answer: No. The Digimon is already unsuspended, so this card’s inherited effect doesn’t activate. The Digimon must go from suspended to unsuspended for the effect to activate.

EX1-019.question: This card’s inherited effect reads, “This Digimon can't be blocked.” How does this effect work, exactly?
EX1-019.answer: If you attack with a Digimon that has this inherited effect while the effect is active, your opponent's Digimon can't change the target of the attack by blocking.

EX1-019.question: I have a Digimon with [Imperialdramon] in its name and this card in its digivolution cards. Can it attack an opponent’s suspended Digimon?

My opponent attacks with a Digimon with [Imperialdramon] in its name and this card in its digivolution cards. Even though I can't block it, can I still try to block with my Digimon with <Blocker> just to suspend my Digimon?
EX1-019.answer: No, you can't. If your Digimon has the "...can't be blocked" effect, your opponent's Digimon can't block or suspend to block.

EX1-021.question: If I have 5 cards in hand when activating this card’s [When Digivolving] effect, how much memory do I gain?
If an opponent's Digimon gains an [On Deletion] effect from an effect or as an inherited effect from one of its digivolution cards, can this card's [When Attacking] effect target that Digimon?

EX1-022.question: If I have 4 blue cards in my digivolution cards, does this card’s [Your Turn] effect grant +4000 DP?
EX1-022.answer:
No. “For each color” refers to unique colors.
Blue is a single color, so the effect only grants +1000 DP.

EX1-026.question: An opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP from this card's inherited effect. During the same turn, I end up with 2 or fewer cards in my security stack. Does the -2000 DP granted by this card’s inherited effect go away?
EX1-026.answer: No. So long as you had 3 or more security cards at the time you activated this card’s inherited effect, the -2000 DP will persist until the end of the turn, even if you end up with 2 or fewer security cards.

EX1-027.question: I have 4 security cards left. My opponent attacks me with a Digimon, and flips this card from my security stack during their security check. Does <Recovery +1 (Deck)> activate off this card’s [Security] effect?
EX1-027.answer: Yes. Flipping this card from your security stack reduces your total security cards from 4 to 3, so the effect activates.

EX1-028.question: My Digimon gets +1000 DP from this card's inherited effect. During the same turn, I end up with 2 or fewer cards in my security stack. Does the +1000 DP granted by this card’s inherited effect go away?
EX1-028.answer: No. So long as you had 3 or more security cards at the time you activated this card’s inherited effect, the +1000 DP will persist until the end of your opponent’s next turn, even if you end up with 2 or fewer security cards.

EX1-029.question: I have a Digimon in play with this card in its digivolution cards. [BT1-087 T.K. Takaishi]’s effect adds a yellow card from my security stack to my hand, and adds a card to my security stack with <Recovery +1 (Deck)>. The number of cards in my security stack ultimately remained the same, but can I still gain 1 memory from this card’s inherited effect?
EX1-029.answer: Yes. <Recovery +1 (Deck)> added a card to your security, so you gain 1 memory.

EX1-029.question: This Digimon gets +4000 DP from its effect. During the same turn, I end up with 2 or fewer cards in my security stack. Does the +4000 DP granted by this card’s effect go away?
EX1-029.answer: No. So long as you had 3 or more security cards at the time you activated this card’s inherited effect, the effect will persist until the end of your opponent’s next turn, even if you end up with 2 or fewer security cards.

EX1-030.question: This Digimon’s attack ends and I attack my opponent with another Digimon. Does this card’s [When Attacking] effect still give my opponent’s Security Digimon -3000 DP?
EX1-030.answer: Yes. The effect gives “all of your opponent’s Security Digimon -3000 DP for the turn,” so every Security Digimon flipped over for the duration of the turn gets -3000 DP.

EX1-030.question: After giving 1 of my opponent’s Digimon and all of my opponent’s Security Digimon -3000 DP, I end up with 2 or fewer security cards. Does this card’s -3000 DP effect go away?
EX1-030.answer: No. So long as you had 3 or more security cards at the time you activated this card’s effect, the effect will persist until the end of the turn, even if you end up with 2 or fewer security cards.

EX1-032.question: I digivolve this card while it’s unsuspended. Can I still trash the top card of my security stack with this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

EX1-033.question: Does this card’s inherited effect reduce the digivolution costs of my other Digimon, or just the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards?
EX1-033.answer: When any one of your Digimon digivolves, as long as it meets the requirements, the memory cost of the digivolution is reduced by 1.

EX1-033.question: I activate this card’s inherited effect, then digivolve into a Digimon without [Insectoid] or [Ancient Insect] in its traits. Does this waste the inherited effect?
EX1-033.answer: No. As long as it’s the same turn, the effect will persist until you digivolve into a Digimon card with [Insectoid] or [Ancient Insect] in its traits.

EX1-033.question: If a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards somehow attacks 2 or more times in the same turn, does the -1 digivolution cost reduction stack?
EX1-033.answer:
Yes. Reduce the digivolution cost by 1 for each time that Digimon attacked during the same turn.
However, once you digivolve into a Digimon card that has [Insectoid] or [Ancient Insect] in its traits, the accumulated digivolution cost reductions from this effect will be reset.

EX1-033.question: Can I reduce the memory cost of digivolutions in my breeding area with this card's inherited effect?
EX1-033.answer: No, you can't reduce the memory cost of digivolutions performed in your breeding area with this card's inherited effect.

EX1-033.question: If I digivolve a Digimon with [Insectoid] or [Ancient Insect] in my battle area into another Digimon, does this card’s inherited effect reduce the memory cost of that digivolution by 1?
EX1-033.answer: No, it only reduces the memory cost by 1 when digivolving one of your Digimon into a Digimon card in your hand with [Insectoid] or [Ancient Insect].

EX1-035.question: I attack with [EX1-035 Kabuterimon] and digivolve into this card with its [When Attacking] effect. Can I then digivolve again on the same attack with this card's [When Attacking] effect?
EX1-035.answer: No, it is too late to trigger this card's [When Attacking] effect, since the Digimon didn't have it when the attack was declared.

EX1-035.question: I digivolve using this card’s [When Attacking] effect. If the Digimon I digivolve into has a [When Attacking] effect, does that effect activate?
EX1-035.answer: No, the time to trigger [When Attacking] effects has already passed, so the effect doesn't activate.

EX1-035.question: When digivolving with this card's [When Attacking] effect, paying the digivolution cost moves the memory gauge to 1 or more on my opponent’s side. What happens to the attack?
EX1-035.answer: The attack continues. The turn doesn’t switch over until the attack has ended.

EX1-035.question: I attack with [EX1-035 Kabuterimon] and digivolve into this card with its [When Attacking] effect. Can I then digivolve again during the same attack with this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
EX1-035.answer: No, the time to trigger [When Attacking] effects has already passed, so the effect doesn't activate.

EX1-038.question: I have a Digimon that gained <Security Attack +1> from another card’s effect, and which also gained <Piercing> from this card’s inherited effect. I attack an opponent's Digimon with it, and perform a security check with <Piercing>. The first card checked has a <De-Digivolve 1> [Security] effect, which trashes the top card of my attacking Digimon, turning it into a Digimon without [Free] in its traits or [Imperialdramon] in its name. This causes the Digimon to also lose <Piercing>. Do I still perform the second check?

EX1-040.question: When digivolving with this card's [When Attacking] effect, paying the digivolution cost moves the memory gauge to 1 or more on my opponent’s side. What happens to the attack?
EX1-040.answer:
The attack continues, but the turn doesn't switch over yet.
If the memory gauge is still at 1 or more on your opponent’s side after the attack has ended and all effects triggered by it have been activated, only then does the turn end.

EX1-040.question: I attack with [EX1-035 Kabuterimon] and digivolve into this card with its [When Attacking] effect. Can I then digivolve again during the same attack with this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
EX1-040.answer: No, the time to trigger [When Attacking] effects has already passed, so the effect doesn't activate.

EX1-040.question: If I have a card in hand with [Insectoid] or [Ancient Insect] in its traits, does this card’s [When Attacking] effect force me to digivolve when attacking?
EX1-040.answer: No. The effect reads, “This Digimon can digivolve,” so you can choose not to.

EX1-040.question: When digivolving into a Digimon card with [Insectoid] or [Ancient Insect] in its traits in my hand with this Digimon's [When Attacking] effect, can I ignore that card's digivolution requirements?
EX1-040.answer: No, you can’t ignore its digivolution requirements.

EX1-043.question: Can this Digimon's effect unsuspend this Digimon when any of my Digimon with [Insectoid] or [Ancient Insect] in their traits deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle and survives?
EX1-043.answer: Yes. It doesn't matter which of your Digimon is the one deleting the opponent's Digimon in battle and surviving. As long as it has [Insectoid] or [Ancient Insect] in its traits, you can unsuspend this Digimon.

EX1-044.question: Does “the same name as this Digimon” refer to Digimon with the name [Keramon]?
EX1-044.answer: No. It’s not referring to this card’s name, but the name of the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards.

EX1-048.question: Can I choose not to activate this card’s [When Digivolving] effect when digivolving?

EX1-051.question: Does “the same name as this Digimon” refer to Digimon with the name [Infermon]?

EX1-051.question: My opponent digivolves one of their Digimon into a level 5 or higher Digimon, and deletes this Digimon with its [When Digivolving] effect. Do I gain 1 memory from this Digimon's [Opponent's Turn] effect?

EX1-052.answer: No, the effect doesn’t activate for Digimon in breeding areas.

EX1-055.question: If a single effect deletes 2 of my opponent’s Digimon, do I draw 2 cards with this card's inherited effect?
EX1-055.answer: No. Even if multiple Digimon are deleted simultaneously, you can't draw more than 1 card per turn with this card's inherited effect.

EX1-056.question: Can this Digimon attack my opponent when I don't have a Digimon with [Myotismon] in its name in play?
EX1-056.answer: Yes, it can attack your opponent.

EX1-056.question: I attack my opponent with this Digimon while I don't have a Digimon with [Myotismon] in its name in play, and it’s blocked by an opponent’s Digimon. What happens?

EX1-058.question: Can this card's inherited effect return this card to its owner's hand?

EX1-058.answer: Yes, you must return a card to your hand.

EX1-060.question: Can I choose not to activate this card’s [When Digivolving] effect when digivolving?
EX1-060.answer: Yes. The effect reads, “You may,” so you can choose not to activate it.

EX1-061.question: This Digimon is in my breeding area. If I digivolve it into a Digimon card with [Myotismon] in its name in my hand, is the memory cost of the digivolution reduced by 1?
EX1-061.answer: No, the effect doesn’t activate for Digimon in breeding areas.

EX1-062.question: I attack my opponent with this Digimon and flip over [BT2-105 Spider Shooter] during the security check. The <De-Digivolve> trashes this card. Does this card’s [End of Attack] effect activate?
EX1-062.answer: No. This card is no longer in play at the end of the attack, so the [End of Attack] effect doesn't activate.

EX1-062.question: Can this card's [On Deletion] effect play an [Agumon Expert] or an [Agumon - Bond of Bravery] from my trash?
EX1-062.answer: No, this card’s [On Deletion] effect can only play cards whose names are specifically [Agumon].

EX1-063.question: Can this card's [When Attacking] effect play a purple level 4 or lower Digimon card with <Retaliation> as its inherited effect from my trash?

EX1-064.question: This Digimon's [On Play] effect deletes 4 of my opponent's Digimon. Does this Digimon’s [Your Turn] effect cause me to draw 4 cards?
EX1-064.answer: No. Even if multiple Digimon are deleted simultaneously, you can't draw more than 1 card per turn with this card's inherited effect.

EX1-065.question: I have this Digimon and a [Diaboromon] Token in my battle area. My opponent attacks with a Digimon, and deletes this Digimon with a [When Attacking] effect. Can I block the attack with my [Diaboromon] Token?
EX1-065.answer: No. If your [Diaboromon] was deleted by a [When Attacking] effect, your [Diaboromon] Token will have already lost <Blocker> by the time you reach blocker timing.

EX1-065.question: Can I play a Token with this card’s [Security] effect at the end of the battle even if this card loses the battle against the attacking Digimon?
EX1-065.answer: Yes. The [Security] effect activates as soon as the card is flipped during the security check, which means you can play the Token regardless of the battle's outcome.

EX1-065.question: This card is flipped over during a security check, but the attacking Digimon still has security checks remaining. Is the Token played off this Digimon’s [Security] effect first, or do I have to wait until my opponent finishes the rest of their security checks?
EX1-065.answer: The Token is played first. Once all [Security] effects and effects triggered by battle have been activated, proceed to the next security check.

EX1-066.question: One of my level 5 or higher Digimon with a digivolution card is deleted. Can I suspend this Tamer and gain 1 memory with this card's [All Turns] effect even if my breeding area isn't empty?
EX1-066.answer: Yes, you can. You can't hatch a Digi-Egg card, however.

EX1-068.question: My opponent uses [EX1-068 Ice Wall!] while one of my Digimon is affected by this card's "isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards" effect. If it becomes my next turn and this card's effect expires, will that Digimon have the "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory" effect?
EX1-068.answer: Yes, this card's "isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards" effect expires while the effect of [EX1-068 Ice Wall!] is still active, so that Digimon will have [EX1-068 Ice Wall!]'s "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory" effect.

EX1-068.question: My opponent uses [EX1-068 Ice Wall!] and I activate this card's "isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards" effect on one of my Digimon that has "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory". What happens with the "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory" effect in such cases?
EX1-068.answer: Since that Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards anymore, [EX1-068 Ice Wall!]'s "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory" effect ends.

EX1-068.question: If I use this card, do I lose 2 memory every time my opponent attacks with a Digimon?
EX1-068.answer: Your opponent loses the 2 memory. The memory marker will be moved 2 spaces towards you every time your opponent attacks with a Digimon.

EX1-068.question: I use this card. During my opponent’s next turn, if they play a new Digimon or move a Digimon from their breeding area to their battle area, will those Digimon have “[When Attacking] Loses 2 memory” from this card’s effect?
EX1-068.answer: Yes. The effect reads, “All of your opponent’s Digimon,” so any Digimon that enter the battle area after you use this card are still affected.

EX1-068.question: I use this card. During my opponent’s next turn, they attack me with their Digimon's <Blitz> effect while I have 1 or more memory. Does my opponent still lose 2 memory?
EX1-068.answer: Yes. Even if you have 1 or more memory, the attack with <Blitz> still takes place during your opponent's turn, which means that this card's effect is still active, and your opponent still loses 2 memory.

EX1-071.question: After using this card, I digivolve a red Digimon into a white Digimon card. What color card can I trash from my hand to reduce the memory cost of the digivolution?
EX1-071.answer:
You can trash a red Digimon card to reduce the digivolution cost.
The card you can trash with this effect must match the color of the Digimon performing the digivolution in your battle area.

EX1-071.question: I’m digivolving a Digimon in my breeding area. Can I reduce the digivolution cost by 4 with this card's effect?
EX1-071.answer: No, this effect can't reduce digivolution costs of Digimon in breeding areas.

EX1-071.question: During the turn I use this card, if I have a blue Digimon in my battle area with an effect that reads, “This Digimon is also treated as red,” can I trash a red Digimon card in my hand to reduce the digivolution cost by 4?

After using this card, I activate [BT7-085 Takuya Kanbara]’s [Main] effect. Can I use this card's effect specifically to trash cards with [Hybrid] in their traits from my hand, so that I can place them under [Takuya Kanbara] using its effect?
EX1-071.answer:
No, you can't.
You don't trash the card in your hand with this effect until you digivolve. [BT7-085 Takuya Kanbara]’s [Main] effect reads, “You may place 5 cards with [Hybrid] in their traits from your trash under this Tamer in any order,” and is used to digivolve into [EmperorGreymon]. As such, you place the cards under [Takuya Kanbara] before you begin digivolving, at which point you can trash a card in your hand with this card's effect.

EX1-071.question: When digivolving from a multicolor Digimon, what color cards can I trash with this card’s effect to reduce the digivolution cost?
EX1-071.answer:
The card you trash can match any one of the Digimon’s colors.
For example, when digivolving a blue/green Digimon, you can trash either a blue or a green card.

EX1-071.question: Can I reduce the memory cost of a DNA digivolution with this card's effect? If I can, what color cards can I trash with this card’s effect?
EX1-071.answer:
Yes, you can.
The card you trash can match any of the colors of either Digimon.
For example, when DNA digivolving a blue Digimon and green Digimon, you can trash either a blue or green card.

EX1-071.question: After using this card, can I reduce the digivolution cost of my digivolving Digimon by trashing 1 Digimon card in the hand with the same color when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?

EX1-072.question: I use this card, then attack my opponent. If an Option card with a [Security] effect is flipped over during the security check, does its effect activate?
EX1-072.answer: Yes. An Option card’s [Security] effect is not considered to be the same thing as using an Option card, so it activates normally.

EX1-072.question: My opponent uses this card and passes the turn back to me. Can I activate <Delay> on an Option card that was already placed in my battle area?
EX1-072.answer: Yes. Activating <Delay> on an Option card that was already placed in your battle area is not considered to be the same thing as using an Option card, so it activates normally.

EX1-073.question: Can you explain in detail which cards I can place in this card’s digivolution cards with this card’s [On Play] effect?
EX1-073.answer:
Cards that meet all of the conditions below and have unique card numbers can be placed in this card’s Digivolution cards with this card's [On Play] effect.
-The cards must be in your hand or trash.
-The cards must have [Cyborg] in their traits.
-The cards must be red or black Digimon cards.
-The cards must be level 5 Digimon cards.

EX1-073.question: When this card is deleted, can I choose not to trash 2 of its digivolution cards?
EX1-073.answer: Yes. The effect reads, “You may trash,” so you can choose not to trash any cards.

EX1-073.question: If a single effect would delete multiple Digimon, can I activate this card's "when [...] would be deleted" effect for each deletion?
EX1-073.answer:
Yes, you can.
For example, if your opponent activates an "if your opponent has as many or more total Digimon and Tamers as you, delete 1 of your opponent's highest level Digimon. Then, delete 1 of your opponent’s lowest level Digimon" effect, you can activate this card's "when [...] would be deleted" effect for the 1st deletion, then you can activate this card's "when [...] would be deleted" effect for the 2nd deletion that was activated by your opponent.

EX10-003.question: Can I trash just 2 digivolution cards for the conditions of this card's inherited effect?
EX10-003.answer:
No, you can't.
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.
The conditions for this inherited effect require you to trash the specified number of digivolution cards.

EX10-003.question: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
EX10-003.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

EX10-003.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
EX10-003.answer:
Yes, such attacks can be ended.
"End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

EX10-007.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to give DP to either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?

Both I and my opponent have 1 EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE] in our battle areas. If this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect gives +3000 DP to my opponent's EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE], what happens to the [All Turns] effects and DP of both our EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE]s?
EX10-007.answer:
The [All Turns] effects on both EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE]s activate and their DPs become 15000.
Because the DP of your opponent's EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE] becomes 15000, the [All Turns] effect on your EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE] will activate.
In turn, this causes the [All Turns] effect on your opponent's EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE] to activate, it can no longer be affected by the +3000 DP from this card's effect, and this [All Turns] effect will give it +3000 DP.
In addition, the conditions for both [All Turns] effects will still be met even after your opponent's turn ends and this card's effect is lost, and the DP becomes 15000 for both.

EX10-008.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to give <Collision> and "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
EX10-008.answer: You can give that effect to such Digimon, but if the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the gained effect won't trigger.

EX10-008.question: I chose my opponent's BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect. If BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] then attacks and is suspended at the start of the main phase, does its gained <Collision> activate?
EX10-008.answer:
No, <Collision> doesn't activate.
As soon as BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] suspends, its [All Turns] effect prevents it from being affected by your effects, and <Collision> doesn't activate.

EX10-009.question: My opponent has no Digimon. I activated this card's [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect, but none of my opponent's Digimon were deleted. At such times, is the "if this effect didn't delete" condition met?

My opponent only has 1 Digimon, and it has an effect that prevents deletion. I activated this card's [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect, but none of my opponent's Digimon were deleted. At such times, is the "if this effect didn't delete" condition met?

My opponent has 1 Digimon with 6000 DP and an effect that prevents deletion, and they have 1 Digimon with 6000 DP and no effects. Is the "if this effect didn't delete" condition met if I activate this card's [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect and delete their Digimon other than the Digimon with an effect that prevents deletion?
EX10-009.answer:
No, it isn't met.
The "if this effect didn't delete" condition is only met when no Digimon are deleted by this effect.
If even 1 Digimon is deleted, this condition isn't met.

EX10-009.question: Do [On Play] effects trigger for Digimon played into the breeding area by this card's [When Attacking] effect?
When my EX10-009 [Creepymon] attacks, in what order do that Digimon's [When Attacking] effect and this card's {Trash} [Your Turn] effect activate?
EX10-009.answer:
The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
However, if you use this card's {Trash} [Your Turn] effect to digivolve that Digimon before activating EX10-009 [Creepymon]'s [When Attacking] effect, you won't be able to activate that [When Attacking] effect.

EX10-010.question: Both I and my opponent have 1 EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE] in our battle areas. If this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect gives +3000 DP to my opponent's EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE], what happens to the [All Turns] effects and DP of both our EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE]s?
EX10-010.answer:
The [All Turns] effects on both EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE]s activate and their DPs become 15000.
Because the DP of your opponent's EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE] becomes 15000, the [All Turns] effect on your EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE] will activate.
In turn, this causes the [All Turns] effect on your opponent's EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE] to activate, it can no longer be affected by the +3000 DP from this card's effect, and this [All Turns] effect will give it +3000 DP.
In addition, the conditions for both [All Turns] effects will still be met even after your opponent's turn ends and this card's effect is lost, and the DP becomes 15000 for both.

EX10-010.question: What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
EX10-010.answer:
This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects.
For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

EX10-010.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
EX10-010.answer:
Yes, it can be chosen.
For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

EX10-010.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
EX10-010.answer:
Yes, it can.
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect.
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

EX10-010.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
EX10-010.answer: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

EX10-010.question: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
EX10-010.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

EX10-010.question: A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
EX10-010.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

EX10-010.question: My opponent only has 1 BT5-112 [Omnimon Zwart Defeat] in the battle area. If that BT5-112 [Omnimon Zwart Defeat] is deleted and this card is chosen as its [On Deletion] effect, is this card deleted?
EX10-010.answer:
Yes, it's deleted.
If this card's [All Turns] effect activates while your opponent has a Digimon with 13000 DP or more, as soon as that Digimon leaves, the effect will no longer be activated.

EX10-010.question: Both I and my opponent have 1 EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE] in our battle areas, and I have a Digimon with an original DP of 13000 or more. Since I have a Digimon with an original DP of 13000 or more, the [All Turns] effects on both EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE]s activate and their DPs become 15000. If my Digimon with an original DP of 13000 or more leaves the battle area, what happens to the [All Turns] effects and DP of both our EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE]s?
EX10-010.answer: The [All Turns] effects on both EX10-010 [BlackWarGreymon ACE]s remain activated and their DPs become 15000.

EX10-011.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
EX10-011.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

EX10-011.question: Can I use this card's {Trash} [Main] effect to delete just 1 of my Digimon?
EX10-011.answer:
No, you can't.
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.
In order for the conditions of this card's {Trash} [Main] effect to be met, you must delete 2 of your level 5 or higher Digimon with [Myotismon] in their texts.

EX10-011.question: Do I have to delete 2 other unsuspended Digimon for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect whenever possible, regardless of whether they're my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?

EX10-012.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
EX10-012.answer:
They become face-up security cards that remain revealed.
Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.

EX10-012.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
EX10-012.answer:
The check is performed with the card left revealed.
Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.

EX10-012.question: Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
EX10-012.answer:
Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards.
After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.

EX10-012.question: Do I delete the Digimon that was played by this card's {Hand} [Main] effect at the end of the turn?

EX10-012.question: What is the processing order for an effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion of this card played by its {Hand} [Main] effect?
EX10-012.answer: The pending processing for the effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion at the end of the turn are considered to be processing that triggers simultaneously. Therefore, the turn player can choose the processing order.

It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

EX12-030.question: Can I only return one specified card to the bottom of the deck with this card's inherited effect?
EX12-030.answer:
No, you can't.

EX12-030.question: Due to this card's effect, the DP on my opponent's Digimon become 0. At this point in time, are those Digimon with 0 DP immediately deleted?

EX12-032.question: What situations does "this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards" refer to?
EX12-032.answer:
It refers to any situation where 2 or more cards with the same level are found when looking at all of the stacked cards.
Example situations include a level 5 Digimon with a level 5 digivolution card, or a level 6 Digimon with 2 level 5 digivolution cards.

This card's [All Turns] effect affects all Digimon without having to choose them.

EX12-034.question: All of my Digimon get -10000 DP. I used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to play [Kotenken]. At such times, [Kotenken]'s DP will become 0 and it will be deleted. In what order can I activate this card's 1st [All Turns] effect and 2nd [All Turns] effect?
EX12-034.answer:
You can activate the 2nd [All Turns] effect first.
When [Kotenken] was played, this card's 1st [All Turns] effect triggered, but a rule check occurs before activation, and [Kotenken] becomes a target for deletion. The 2nd [All Turns] effect triggers immediately before this deletion, and you can interrupt and activate it.
In addition, if a Digimon with 10000 DP or less was played by this effect, a rule check will occur again and that Digimon will be deleted.
Once all of the rule checks are resolved, you then can activate this card's 1st [All Turns] effect.

EX12-034.question: All of my Digimon get -5000 DP. I used this card's [All Turns] effect to play a Digimon with 5000 DP or less. At such times, is the played Digimon deleted before the 1st [All Turns] effect activates?
EX12-034.answer:
Yes, it's deleted.
Even if it's deleted, you can activate this card's 1st [All Turns] effect.

EX12-035.answer:
Yes, you can.

An effect to activate is chosen, then the next effect to activate is chosen after the previous effect has been resolved.

The Digimon that gets additional DP from this effect must battle an opponent's Digimon if possible.

EX12-052.question: What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
EX12-052.answer:
This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects.
For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

EX12-052.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
EX12-052.answer:
Yes, it can be chosen.
For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

EX12-052.question: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
EX12-052.answer:
Yes, it can.
It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect.
However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

EX12-052.question: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
EX12-052.answer: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

EX12-052.question: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
EX12-052.answer: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

EX12-052.question: A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
EX12-052.answer: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

EX12-052.question: What does "may battle" mean, exactly?
EX12-052.answer:
This effect directly performs a battle.
If this effect is activated, the chosen Digimon battle, as with the standard rules.

EX12-052.question: If 2 Digimon including a Digimon that has an "effects don't affect" effect are chosen for a "may battle" effect, can those Digimon battle?
EX12-052.answer:
Yes, they can battle.
A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect can still be chosen for an effect. In addition, a battle itself is a rule that compares DP, not an effect. Therefore, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen, and then it can battle.
If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.

If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

EX13-065.question: All of my Digimon are currently getting -5000 DP, and I use this card's [Main] effect to play a Digimon with 5000 DP or less. At this time, is the played Digimon deleted before the portion of the effect that follows "Then" is processed?
EX13-065.answer:
No, it is not immediately deleted at this point in time.
All activated effects are resolved, after which a rule check occurs. At that point in time, all Digimon with 0 DP are deleted simultaneously.

EX13-065.question: I used [Divine Pierce (Awakened)] to play [Sistermon Blanc] which has an [On Play] effect. Afterwards, if I Arts Digivolve that [Sistermon Blanc] into this card, can I activate that Digimon's [On Play] effect?

EX13-066.question: I used [Mickey Bullet (Awakened)] to play [Sistermon Noir] which has an [On Play] effect. Afterwards, if I Arts Digivolve that [Sistermon Noir] into this card, can I activate that Digimon's [On Play] effect?

EX13-067.question: I currently have my own [Agumon] and two copies of this card in the battle area. I digivolve the [Agumon] into [Greymon]. At this time, can I activate the first copy of this card's [Your Turn] effect to play [Gabumon] and then activate the second copy of this card's [Your Turn] effect afterwards?
EX13-067.answer:
No.
The moment you activate the first copy of this card's [Your Turn] effect, you no longer have one or fewer Digimon, therefore the second copy's effect can't be activated.

EX13-068.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "after" in this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
EX13-068.answer:
No, you can't.
If you don't return this card to the bottom of your deck, you can't process the part after "after" in this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect.

EX13-069.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "after" in this card's [Your Turn] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
EX13-069.answer:
No, you can't.
If you don't suspend this card, you can't process the part after "after" in this card's [Your Turn] effect.

EX13-069.question: If a Digimon such as [BT5-021 Syakomon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and digivolve 1 of my Digimon into a specified card?
EX13-069.answer: You can activate the effect and digivolve, but its cost won't be reduced.

EX13-069.question: There are two copies of this card in the battle area. Can I activate both of their [Your Turn] effects and digivolve one specified card with its cost reduced by the combined amount from both effects?
EX13-069.answer:
No, you can't.
You can't simultaneously activate multiple effects that digivolve a card.

EX13-070.question: If a Digimon such as [BT5-021 Syakomon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect and digivolve 1 of my Digimon into a specified card?
EX13-070.answer: You can activate the effect and digivolve, but its cost won't be reduced.

EX13-070.question: There are two copies of this card in the battle area. Can I activate both of their [End of Your Turn] effects and digivolve one specified card with its cost reduced by the combined amount from both effects?
EX13-070.answer:
No, you can't.
You can't simultaneously activate multiple effects that digivolve a card.

EX13-071.question: If I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] effect to place a card under a Tamer with cards under it, in what order do I place the card?
EX13-071.answer: The card is placed on the bottom of the cards under the Tamer.

EX13-071.question: Can I change the stacking order of face-down cards under a Tamer?
Can I search/look at face-down cards under a Tamer?
EX13-071.answer:
Only the player of those cards can search/look at them.
The opponent player can't search/look at them.

EX13-071.question: What happens if a face-down card under a Tamer is trashed?
EX13-071.answer: It's placed face-up in the trash.

EX13-071.question: Can I trash only 2 specified cards or place only 1 of the specified cards as a digivolution card for the conditions of this card's [Main] effect?
EX13-071.answer:
No, you can't.
All of the conditions within "by doing X" must be fulfilled.
The conditions for this [Main] effect require you to trash 3 specified cards and place 1 each of the specified cards as digivolution cards.

EX13-071.question: My Tamer currently has three or more face-down cards under it, and my trash is empty. Can I activate this card's [Main] effect?
EX13-071.answer:
No.
You can't activate this card's [Main] effect unless you have three or more face-down cards under one of your Tamers and one of each specified card in your trash.
However, if you have all of those cards, you may activate this card's [Main] effect and place the cards trashed from under your Tamer under your [Kudamon].

EX13-071.question: If a Digimon such as [BT5-021 Syakomon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Main] effect and digivolve 1 of my Digimon into a specified card?
EX13-071.answer: You can activate the effect and digivolve, but its cost won't be reduced.

EX13-071.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve the specified card into a [Kentaurosmon] that doesn't meet the digivolution requirements, ignoring level?
EX13-071.answer:
No, you can't.
You can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements, with its Lv. being the only exception.

EX13-071.question: If a text says "XX card with AA or BB," does that mean AA and BB both have to be XX?
EX13-071.answer:
Yes, both have to be XX.
For example, "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait or that is yellow or black" means either "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait" or "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card that is yellow or black." In both cases, the card must be level 4 or lower.

EX13-072.question: There are 2 copies of this card in the battle area. Can I activate both of their [Your Turn] effects and use one specified card with its cost reduced by the combined amount from both effects?
EX13-072.answer:
No, you can't.
You can't simultaneously activate multiple effects that use a card.

EX13-074.question: If I use this card's [All Turns] effect to place a card under a Tamer with cards under it, in what order do I place the card?
EX13-074.answer: The card is placed on the bottom of the cards under the Tamer.

EX13-074.question: A Digimon with [Knightmon] in its text is deleted, and that Digimon's [On Deletion] effect and this card's [All Turns] effect trigger simultaneously. At such a time, in what order does this card's [All Turns] effect and the deleted card's [On Deletion] effect activate?
EX13-074.answer:
The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
However, if this card's [All Turns] effect is activated first and the deleted card is then placed under this card, the card pending activation has left the area, so its [On Deletion] effect can't activate.

EX13-076.question: What does "may battle" mean, exactly?
EX13-076.answer:
This effect immediately initiates a battle.
If this effect is activated, the chosen Digimon battle according to the standard rules.

EX13-076.question: If 2 Digimon including a Digimon that has an "effects don't affect" effect are chosen for a "may battle" effect, can those Digimon battle?
EX13-076.answer:
Yes, they can battle.
A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect can still be chosen for an effect. In addition, a battle itself is a rule that compares DP, not an effect. Therefore, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen, and then it can battle.
If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.

EX13-076.question: During an attack by my Digimon with <Piercing>, I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect and the attacking Digimon battles one of my opponent's Digimon, deleting it in battle. Then, if my attacking Digimon's attack target successfully becomes one of my opponent's Digimon and it is also deleted in battle, can I use my Digimon's <Piercing> effect to perform two checks?
EX13-076.answer:
No, you only perform one security check for <Piercing>.
Only one security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times.
However, if the number of cards checked is modified by <Security A.>, that modified number of cards will be checked during a single security check.

EX13-076.question: During an attack by my Digimon with <Piercing>, I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to have that Digimon battle one of my opponent's Digimon and delete it. Then, if my attacking Digimon's attack target successfully becomes one of my opponent's Digimon, and that Digimon loses the battle but an effect prevents it from being deleted, can I still activate my Digimon's <Piercing> effect?
EX13-076.answer:
Yes, you can.
The <Piercing> effect triggers and activates if the Digimon deletes one of the opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, and it is resolved immediately before the end of attack timing.
<Piercing> will still trigger even if another battle occurred during the attack in which the Digimon with <Piercing> successfully attacked and battled a Digimon.

EX13-076.question: When does "when this Digimon wins a battle" trigger?
EX13-076.answer:
It triggers when the battle is won.
When the Digimon with this effect wins a battle, the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted, then the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect can be activated.

EX13-076.question: Does a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect also trigger when a battle against a Security Digimon is won?

A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted. At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the effects that trigger upon the losing Digimon being deleted?
EX13-076.answer: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their effects first.

EX13-076.question: A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle. At such times, in what order can players activate the winning Digimon's "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the losing Digimon's effects such as "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects?
EX13-076.answer: The "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects can be activated first.

EX13-076.question: A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle. At such times, can the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect be activated even if an effect prevents the opponent's Digimon from being deleted?
For this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect, can I choose not to battle the opponent's Digimon after returning its digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck?

No.
You must battle the Digimon whose digivolution cards you returned to the deck with this effect if it's possible.

EX13-077.question: If 2 Digimon including a Digimon that has an "effects don't affect" effect are chosen for a "may battle" effect, can those Digimon battle?

EX13-077.question: Can I choose a Digi-Egg card for the card returned to the deck with this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

Yes.

EX13-077.question: Can I only return 4 cards from my opponent's trash to their deck to meet the conditions of this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
EX13-077.answer:
No, you can't.
All of the conditions within "by doing X" must be fulfilled.
The conditions for this [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect require you to return 5 cards from the opponent's trash to the bottom of their deck.

EX13-077.question: If an effect that activates another effect one time "for every XX" can activate multiple types of effects multiple times, can I activate the same effect multiple times and/or activate different effects?
If an effect that activates another effect one time "for every XX" can activate multiple types of effects multiple times, how is the effect activation order determined?
EX13-077.answer:
An effect to activate is chosen, then the next effect to activate is chosen after the previous effect has been resolved.
This is repeated one time for every XX.

EX13-077.question: If the number of XX changes during activation of effects by an effect that activates another effect one time "for every XX," does the number of activations also change?
EX13-077.answer:
No, it doesn't.
The number of XX is referenced at the point in time the effect that activates another effect one time "for every XX" is activated.

EX13-077.question: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect reference this card's own color as well?
EX13-077.answer:
Yes, it can.
Additionally, it can also reference the color gained by this card's [All Turns] effect.

EX13-077.question: My Digimon and Tamers' colors currently total four. I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect and choose the first effect to have it battle an opponent's Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect, and that Digimon gets deleted. If I then choose the second effect and return that deleted card to the bottom of the deck, will it prevent that returned card's [On Deletion] effect from activating?
EX13-077.answer:
Yes, it will prevent it from activating.
If a card with an effect pending activation leaves the area before the effect is activated, then the effect can't be activated.

EX13-077.question: When I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect and choose its first effect to have it battle one of my opponent's Digimon, my opponent plays a new Digimon with one of their Digimon's immediate-type effects. After that happens, can I use the chosen first effect to battle the opponent's newly played Digimon?

I have this card, 1 "red and blue Digimon," and 1 "red and yellow Tamer" in the battle area. If I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, how many times can I activate "activate 1 effect below"?
EX13-077.answer:
Two times.
In this situation, your Digimon and Tamers' colors are red, blue, yellow, and white, so you can activate it twice.

EX2-003.question: If the "when you use an Option card" effect triggers, what is the timing when it can activate?
EX2-003.answer: It can be activated after activating the used Option card's [Main] effect.

EX2-003.question: Does the "when you use an Option card" effect trigger if an Option card's effect activates by a method other than using the card?
EX2-003.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If an Option card's effect activates without using it, such as activation by a [Security] effect or <Delay>, the "when you use an Option card" effect doesn't trigger.

EX2-003.question: An Option card's use cost is 1 or less when used from the hand due to an effect such as BT2-099 [Glorious Burst] or BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s 1st effect. When such a card is used, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
EX2-003.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If a card's cost itself is reduced when it's used from the hand, it's considered to be using an Option card with a use cost after the reduction is applied. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect doesn't trigger.

EX2-003.question: An Option card has an original use cost of 2 or more, and I use it when the cost to pay is reduced to 1 or less. At such times, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
EX2-003.answer:
Yes, it triggers.
If the card's cost to pay is reduced and not the use cost itself, it's considered to be using an Option card with its original value as its use cost. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect triggers.

EX2-003.question: I used an effect to use an Option card with an original use cost of 2 or more without paying the cost. At such times, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?

EX2-004.question: Does this card’s inherited effect activate when my opponent suspends a Digimon by blocking?

EX2-007.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand?
EX2-007.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "return 1 of your other Digimon to its owner's hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

EX2-007.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand, then return up to 2 of my opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to their owners' hands?
EX2-007.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

EX2-007.question: Can I use this card's effect to place my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] on top of my security stack from the battle area?
EX2-007.answer:
No, you can't.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to place in the security stack, according to the rules it will be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the security stack.
A card isn't actually added to the security stack, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the security stack" don't trigger.

EX2-007.question: If I choose my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] or token that is treated as a Digimon in the battle area as the target for this card's effect, it isn't placed in the security stack. In such cases, do "when a card is removed from the security stack" effects trigger because a card wasn't added to the security stack even though it normally should have been added?
EX2-007.answer: No, they don’t trigger.

EX2-007.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper], and this card is the bottom card. Does the "you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper]s to set this Digimon's play cost to 0" effect activate when my [EX2-055 Reaper] is played?
EX2-007.answer: It can activate in such cases if you declare to trash 8 cards and then trash 7 cards except for [BT9-109 X Antibody].

EX2-007.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand?
EX2-007.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

EX2-007.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand, what happens for "return 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose level is less than or equal to the returned Digimon's level to the hand"?
EX2-007.answer: [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is a Digimon without a level, therefore your opponent can't return a Digimon to the hand.

EX2-007.question: Can this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect move a level 2 Digimon or cards like [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] or [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] from the breeding area to the battle area?
EX2-007.answer: It can't move level 2 Digimon or cards like [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] because cards without DP can't be moved to the battle area. It can move [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] because it has DP.

EX2-007.question: Does this card go in my deck, or my Digi-Egg deck?
EX2-007.answer: This card is a Digi-Egg card, so it goes in your Digi-Egg deck.

EX2-007.question: When I hatch this card during my breeding phase, do I place it in my breeding area, or my battle area?
EX2-007.answer: It’s placed in your breeding area as a level-less Digimon.

EX2-007.question: This card doesn't have a level. Can I still digivolve it into other cards?
EX2-007.answer: No. Cards that don't have levels can't be digivolved from. (Other than through special digivolutions.)

EX2-007.question: If this card is in my breeding area, how do I move it to my battle area?
EX2-007.answer:
It can be moved from your breeding area to your battle area like any other Digimon.
Level 2 Digimon don't have DP, and therefore can't be moved to your battle area. This card has DP, which means it can be moved to your battle area without digivolving it.

EX2-007.question: If this card is in my breeding area, can I activate its [Main] effect to place my [ADR-02 Searcher] in its digivolution cards?
EX2-007.answer: No, you can’t activate effects in the breeding area.

EX2-007.question: If this card is in my battle area, can it be attacked by my opponent’s Digimon with an effect that reads “This Digimon can also attack unsuspended Digimon”?
EX2-007.answer:
Yes, it can.
“This Digimon can also attack unsuspended Digimon” is an effect that only affects the Digimon that has it, so this card's “This Digimon [...] isn't affected by your opponent’s effects” effect can’t be used to prevent the attack.

EX2-007.question: This card is in my battle area. If an opponent’s Digimon attacks it, and this card’s DP is less than or equal to the opponent’s Digimon, is this card deleted?
EX2-007.answer: Yes, this card can be deleted as a result of battle.

EX2-007.question: Is this Digimon affected by effects like “Delete 1 of your Digimon,” or “Suspend 1 of your Digimon” that I activate?
EX2-007.answer: Yes, this card is affected by effects you activate.

EX2-007.question: If this card is in my battle area, can my own effects delete it or move it to my hand/deck/security stack?
EX2-007.answer:
Yes, you can.
However, since this card is a Digi-Egg card, note that if this card would be moved to your hand, deck, or security stack, it’s instead placed at the bottom of your Digi-Egg deck face down.

EX2-007.question: If I play two cards with [D-Reaper] in their traits, can I choose not to activate this card’s [Your Turn] effect for the first card, and activate it for the second?
EX2-007.answer: Yes, you can.

EX2-007.question: My opponent has [BT8-071 Psychemon] in play. Can this Digimon’s [Your Turn] effect still reduce the play cost of cards with [D-Reaper] in their traits when I would play them?
EX2-007.answer: No. [BT8-071 Psychemon]’s effect doesn’t target Digimon themselves, so you can’t activate this card's effect to reduce the play cost of cards.

EX2-007.question: If I use [BT4-105 Tactical Retreat!] on this card, can I place it on top of my security stack face down?
EX2-007.answer: No. This card is a Digi-Egg card, so if it would be moved to your security stack, it’s instead placed at the bottom of your Digi-Egg deck face down.

EX2-007.question: Can I specify my opponent’s [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] as the target of an effect?
EX2-007.answer: Yes, you can.

EX2-007.question: If an effect that targets multiple Digimon is also targeting my opponent's [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper], is the effect canceled, preventing it from affecting the other targeted Digimon?
EX2-007.answer: No. It’s only this Digimon that isn't affected. The other Digimon will be affected as normal.

EX2-007.question: I have an [ADR-02 Searcher] with 1 or more digivolution cards in play. If I place it in this Digimon's digivolution cards with this card's [Main] effect, do I also get to place [ADR-02 Searcher]’s digivolution cards under it as well?

EX2-007.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under this card, and [BT9-109 X Antibody] is the bottom card. EX3-065.question: One of my Digimon digivolved into a Digimon with [Rock Dragon], [Earth Dragon], [Machine Dragon], or [Sky Dragon] in its traits when I had 2 copies of this card in play. Can I suspend both copies of this card and activate the digivolved Digimon's [On Play] effects twice?
EX3-065.answer: Yes, you can. However, you can't activate 2 effects at the same time, so you must activate them 1 at a time. After you suspend the first card and activate 1 of the digivolved Digimon's [On Play] effects, then you may suspend the second card and activate the second [On Play] effect. Note that if the first effect or another effect triggers an effect that deletes the digivolved Digimon or otherwise removes it from the battle area, the second effect doesn't activate.

EX3-065.question: One of my Digimon digivolved into a [EX3-012 Volcanicdramon] when I had 2 copies of this card in play. I used the effects on the first copy of this card to activate [EX3-012 Volcanicdramon]'s [On Play] effect and deleted all of my opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP. EX3-066.question: What does "While you have a level 6 Digimon with [Machine] in its traits in play, you may use this card without meeting its color requirements." mean, exactly?

EX3-069.question: This card digivolved from [EX3-035 Goldramon]. This Digimon gains all effects of [Goldramon] in digivolution cards, but after [EX3-035 Goldramon]'s [When Digivolving] effect activates and I return [EX3-069 Trial of the Four Great Dragons] from the trash to the hand, can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use [EX3-069 Trial of the Four Great Dragons] from my hand?
EX3-069.answer:

EX3-069.question: I used this card's [On Deletion] effect to place a [EX3-069 Trial of the Four Great Dragons] from my hand in the battle area. Does [EX3-069 Trial of the Four Great Dragons]'s "[Main] <Draw 1>. Then, place this card in your battle area." effect activate?

EX3-069.question: Do I delete the Digimon that was played by this card's <Delay> effect at the end of my opponent's turn? And if it isn't deleted, is it still prevented from digivolving to level 7?

If it isn't deleted by another effect when it would be deleted by this effect, it's still prevented from digivolving to level 7.

EX3-069.question: What is the processing order for an effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion of a Digimon played by this card's <Delay> effect?
EX3-069.answer: The pending processing for the effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion at the end of the turn are considered to be processing that triggers simultaneously. Therefore, the turn player can choose the processing order.

EX3-070.question: Does this card's [Security] effect activate if I or my opponent don't have any Digimon in the respective battle areas?

EX3-074.question: I used this card's [Start of Opponent's Main Phase] to suspend my [EX3-044 Breakdramon] or [EX3-074 Examon] and had my opponent attack. EX7-052.question: What does "end that attack" mean, exactly?
EX7-052.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

EX7-061.question: I tried to delete my opponent's EX7-061 [Lilithmon (X Antibody)] using this card's 1st [All Turns] effect. ST15-15.question: When my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name isn't affected by my opponent's Digimon's effects from this card's [Main] effect, is it affected by [Security] effects on my opponent's Digimon?

ST15-16.question: Can I choose an opponent's Digimon with a "this Digimon can't attack" effect as the target for "[Start of Your Main Phase] Attack with this Digimon" when I activate this card's [Main] effect?

Yes, you can.

ST15-16.question: What happens if I use this card twice and 2 of my opponent's Digimon gain the "[Start of Your Main Phase] Attack with this Digimon" effect?
ST15-16.answer:
At the start of your opponent's main phase, the effects gained from this card's effect are triggered at the same time, and your opponent determines which one activates first. After effects such as [When Attacking] have activated, and before the counter timing occurs, it is time to activate the effect of the 2nd Digimon that was pending activation. However, since the 1st Digimon is already attacking, the effect ends without an attack made.
As a result, only the Digimon whose effect was activated first can attack.

ST15-16.question: Can I choose an opponent's Digimon with an "[Opponent’s Turn] This Digimon isn't affected by your opponent’s effects" effect as the target for "[Start of Your Main Phase] Attack with this Digimon" when I activate this card's [Main] effect?
ST15-16.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, as soon as it becomes your opponent's turn, the target opposing Digimon loses the "this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent’s effects" effect, and the attack occurs at the start of the main phase by this card's effect.

ST16-03.question: Does this card's effect activate even when my opponent only has a Digimon in their breeding area?

ST16-15.answer: Even if the Digimon becomes a Digimon without [Garurumon] in its name, as long as the conditions were met at the time of activation for this card's effect, the effect will persist until the end of your opponent's turn.

ST17-03.question: If I use this card's effect to give <Alliance> to a Digimon that originally had <Alliance>, can that Digimon activate <Alliance> twice for 1 attack?
ST17-03.answer:
Yes, it can.

ST7-12.question: Can I choose fewer cards than possible, even if the DP of the chosen cards adds up to less than 8000?

ST7-12.question: My opponent has a [BT4-066 Golemon] in play.
